66424.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆比周圍細胞大十倍以上的巨大巨核細胞，細胞質豐富，細胞核過度分葉、由許多小葉彼此重疊成團 (hyperlobulated/staghorn nucleus)，背景有血小板聚集，是本態性血小板增多症 (ET) 的典型巨核細胞。
features: Giant megakaryocyte many times the diameter of surrounding cells, with low N:C ratio
Hyperlobulated nucleus composed of numerous small, overlapping lobes clustered centrally (staghorn/cloud-like configuration)
Dense condensed chromatin without visible nucleoli
Abundant finely granular basophilic-to-violet cytoplasm with a fringed, platelet-shedding periphery
Background with platelet aggregates, erythroid and granulocytic precursors in a bloody, particle-rich aspirate
66424.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly enlarged mature megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular cytoplasm and a hyperlobulated nucleus formed by numerous overlapping lobes with condensed chromatin and no nucleoli. The cytoplasmic margin is fringed, and platelet clumps are present in the background. Surrounding hematopoietic cells show no obvious dysplasia in this field. The morphology is consistent with a giant hyperlobulated (staghorn) megakaryocyte, as seen in essential thrombocythemia; diagnosis requires the biopsy pattern, platelet count and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation testing.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with bulbous, cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei and high N:C ratio, forming dense clusters with fibrosis, rather than large mature cells with well-lobulated nuclei.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but normal in size and lobation without giant hyperlobulated forms or clustering.
CML megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated dwarf forms with BCR::ABL1, unlike this giant hyperlobulated cell.
Osteoclasts contain multiple separate round nuclei with nucleoli and coarse azurophilic granules rather than a single interconnected lobulated nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Giant hyperlobulated (staghorn) megakaryocyte — characteristic of essential thrombocythemia
pearls_zh: 考法：指著巨大多葉核的巨核細胞問名稱與代表疾病；答 staghorn megakaryocyte，essential thrombocythemia。
WHO ET 主要診斷要點：PLT ≥450×10⁹/L、骨髓以巨大成熟多葉巨核細胞增生為主且無明顯 granulopoiesis/erythropoiesis 增生、驗到 JAK2/CALR/MPL 或其他 clonal marker。
必須排除 CML：驗 BCR::ABL1；CML 巨核細胞偏小、核分葉少（dwarf megakaryocytes），與 ET 相反。
ET 需與 prefibrotic PMF 區分：後者巨核細胞呈緻密群聚、核深染、雲朵狀（cloud-like）且細胞密度高，預後較差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 單張抹片中的大巨核細胞也見於反應性血小板增多（缺鐵、發炎、脾切除），不能只憑一顆細胞診斷 ET；需結合切片分布、基因與排除次發原因。

quiz.q: 圖中巨核細胞的形態名稱為何？診斷其相關 MPN 前必須排除哪個融合基因？
quiz.a: Staghorn（giant hyperlobulated）megakaryocyte；BCR::ABL1。

66360.recognize_zh: 心包液抹片中央一群緊密相連的大型細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，部分為雙核或多核，細胞質濃密、邊緣有小泡狀突起，上方兩細胞之間可見窄窄的透明間隙（window）；背景有多顆嗜中性球與巨噬細胞，符合反應性間皮細胞。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and small nucleoli
Several binucleated/multinucleated cells with overlapping nuclei in the center of the cluster
Dense basophilic cytoplasm with a peripheral rim of surface blebs; narrow intercellular windows between the upper cells
Single mesothelial cells with similar cytoplasmic blebs at the lower left
Inflammatory background of segmented and band neutrophils, macrophages with pale cytoplasm, and red cells
66360.describe_en: Cytocentrifuged pericardial fluid shows an inflammatory background of neutrophils, macrophages, and red cells. There is a cohesive cluster of large mesothelial cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and small nucleoli, including binucleated and multinucleated forms; the cytoplasm is dense with a peripheral rim of surface blebs, and narrow windows separate adjacent cells. Similar single mesothelial cells are present at the lower left. Nuclear features are relatively uniform without marked pleomorphism or hyperchromasia. Findings are consistent with reactive mesothelial cells in an inflammatory effusion.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters are three-dimensional with community borders and no windows, and show a second population with pleomorphic nuclei, large nucleoli, and cytoplasmic vacuoles; immunostains (e.g., claudin-4, BerEP4) help.
Reactive and malignant mesothelial cells overlap morphologically; large papillary cell balls, marked atypia, BAP1 loss, or CDKN2A deletion favor mesothelioma.
Histiocytes have eccentric bean-shaped nuclei and foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm without dense peripheral cytoplasm or intercellular windows.

exam.answer_en: Reactive mesothelial cells (cohesive cluster with bi-/multinucleated forms) in an inflammatory pericardial effusion
pearls_zh: 考法：發炎背景下的間皮細胞團，問「多核是否代表惡性」；答否，反應性間皮細胞常見雙核、多核，關鍵看核是否一致、無明顯異型。
背景以中性球與巨噬細胞為主提示發炎或感染性心包膜炎，需搭配積液細胞數、生化（Light's criteria）與培養。
結核性心包膜炎常以淋巴球為主，ADA 升高有輔助價值；間皮細胞在結核積液中通常偏少。
體液報告中若無法區分反應或惡性，應註明並建議 cytology/cell block 做 calretinin、BerEP4 等 IHC。
exam.pitfall_zh: 成團、雙核、有核仁的反應性間皮細胞易被過度判為 mesothelioma 或轉移癌；反應性者核大小與染色質均勻、無明顯深染或巨大核仁。

quiz.q: 圖中背景主要發炎細胞為何？間皮細胞出現多核是否足以判為惡性？
quiz.a: 中性球與巨噬細胞；否，多核可見於反應性間皮細胞。

66232.recognize_zh: 高倍下成片的大型細胞，細胞質深藍、核偏心並有部分核周淡染區（hof），核質比高、染色質較開放、可見核仁，中央還有一個有絲分裂像；夾雜少數嗜酸性球。這種漿母細胞樣（plasmablastic）形態出現在 CSF 中，提示骨髓瘤侵犯中樞神經。
features: Sheets of large discohesive cells with high N:C ratio and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric round nuclei with open to moderately condensed chromatin and occasional nucleoli; some cells show a perinuclear hof
Central mitotic figure (metaphase) indicating proliferative activity
Irregular cytoplasmic borders with small blebs/projections
Scattered eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and orange granules; rare red cells in background
66232.describe_en: Cytospin preparation at high power shows a dense population of large, discohesive plasma cells with plasmablastic features, including high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, eccentric nuclei with open chromatin and occasional nucleoli, deeply basophilic cytoplasm with focal perinuclear hofs, and irregular cytoplasmic blebs. A mitotic figure is present, and a few eosinophils are admixed. Findings are consistent with involvement by plasma cell myeloma with plasmablastic morphology; confirmation of clonality by flow cytometry (cytoplasmic light chain restriction) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; PBL is frequently EBER-positive, MYC-rearranged and arises in immunocompromised patients without a preceding myeloma or serum paraprotein history.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia (myeloid or lymphoblastic) in CSF
ddx.vs: Blasts lack a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic abundant cytoplasm and express CD34/TdT/MPO rather than CD38/CD138 with light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / Burkitt lymphoma
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells express CD19/CD20 and surface light chain without prominent hof, and Burkitt cells show vacuolated cytoplasm with CD10+ phenotype.
Reactive plasma cells are small, mature with clock-face chromatin, no mitoses and polytypic light chains.

65848.recognize_zh: 視野中四顆嗜中性球（含兩顆帶狀核）的細胞質佈滿粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒，比正常嗜中性球的淡粉紅細顆粒明顯粗且深，即中毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），符合敗血症等感染狀態。
features: Four neutrophils, two segmented and two band/early segmented forms (left shift)
Cytoplasm densely filled with coarse, dark purple-black granules replacing the normal fine pink granulation
Nuclear chromatin clumped with normal lobulation; no hypersegmentation
No definite Döhle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuoles evident in this field
Background red cells show rouleaux-like stacking in thicker areas
65848.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several neutrophils, including band forms, with cytoplasm filled by coarse, dark purple azurophilic granules consistent with toxic granulation. Nuclear segmentation is appropriate for band and segmented forms, and definite Döhle bodies or toxic vacuolation are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with toxic granulation with left shift, a reactive change seen in sepsis and other severe inflammatory states or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are large and dark in all neutrophils, as well as in lymphocytes and monocytes, and persist without infection.
Chédiak-Higashi neutrophils contain a few giant, irregular pink-grey granules rather than many uniformly coarse fine dark granules.
Overstaining darkens granules in all cells including the background and red cells, whereas toxic granulation varies from cell to cell.
Basophil granules are larger, blue-black and overlie and obscure the nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Toxic granulation with left shift — neutrophils and bands with coarse dark azurophilic granules, reactive (sepsis/inflammation or G-CSF)
pearls_zh: 考法：指嗜中性球問「顆粒為何這麼深」：toxic granulation 是初級（嗜天青）顆粒在感染壓力下持續保留、染色變深，常與 Döhle bodies、cytoplasmic vacuoles 並列為 toxic changes。
臨床連結：常見於細菌感染、敗血症、嚴重發炎、燒傷，以及 G-CSF 治療後；細胞質空泡化較能提示菌血症。
與 CML 鑑別：leukemoid reaction 有 toxic changes、以帶狀核/後骨髓細胞為主、無嗜鹼性球增多、LAP score 高；CML 則 LAP 低、myelocyte bulge、嗜鹼性球增多。
若所有白血球系列（含淋巴球、單核球）都有粗大深色顆粒且與感染無關，應想到 Alder-Reilly anomaly（mucopolysaccharidoses）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Alder-Reilly anomaly 或染色過深：Alder-Reilly 影響所有白血球系列且持續存在；染色過深會讓背景與所有細胞一起變深，toxic granulation 則每顆細胞程度不一。

quiz.q: 這幾顆嗜中性球細胞質中深紫色粗顆粒稱為什麼？最常代表什麼臨床狀態？
quiz.a: Toxic granulation；細菌感染/敗血症等嚴重發炎（或 G-CSF 使用）

65784.recognize_zh: 六顆中型的母細胞樣（blastoid）淋巴細胞，核形不規則、有稜角或凹陷，染色質細緻略疏鬆，細胞質少到中等呈淡藍嗜鹼性且無顆粒；外觀像母細胞，但本例為肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤周邊血侵犯，需流式證實。
features: Medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells, about 1.5-2 times the diameter of red cells, with high N:C ratio
Irregular, angulated or notched nuclear contours
Fine to slightly open chromatin with small or indistinct nucleoli, imparting a blastoid appearance
Scant to moderate pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm, sometimes with a small cytoplasmic tail
No azurophilic granules; background red cells without significant abnormality
65784.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated to notched nuclei, fine to slightly open chromatin, indistinct nucleoli and scant to moderate pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm. The cells have a blastoid appearance, and cytoplasmic granules are not identified. Morphology alone cannot distinguish these from lymphoblasts or other blastoid lymphomas. Findings are consistent with circulating blastoid neoplastic lymphoid cells; in the context of TCR gamma-delta positive, CD4/CD8 double-negative T cells with isochromosome 7q, they represent peripheral blood involvement by hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: T-ALL blasts are TdT and often CD34 or CD1a positive with immature markers, whereas HSTCL cells are TdT/CD34/CD1a negative mature gamma-delta T cells.
T-LGL cells are mature with abundant cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules, not blastoid agranular cells.
Blastoid MCL is a B-cell neoplasm with CD19/CD20, CD5 and cyclin D1 expression.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts express CD34/CD117/CD13/CD33 and lack surface CD3 and TCR gamma-delta.

65656.recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球的核分成 6 個緊密排列的小葉、染色質濃縮，細胞大小正常；此圖與同系列 65651 看起來是同一視野，辨識重點同樣是單顆細胞 ≥6 葉。
features: Single neutrophil with six closely clustered nuclear lobes
Condensed mature chromatin
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine granules; no obvious toxic changes
Normal-sized cell relative to surrounding red cells
Background red cells mostly normocytic with occasional poikilocytes; platelets present
65656.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with six closely clustered nuclear lobes and condensed chromatin, in a cell of normal size with finely granular cytoplasm. No toxic granulation, Döhle bodies, or vacuoles are evident. Red cells are largely normocytic with occasional poikilocytes, and platelets are present. This field appears identical to image 65651 of the same series. Findings are consistent with neutrophil hypersegmentation.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia requires supporting macro-ovalocytes, raised MCV, and low B12 or folate beyond a single hypersegmented neutrophil.
The benign inherited trait is separated by normal vitamin studies and a family history.
Giant neutrophils are about twice normal size, whereas this cell is normal-sized.

exam.answer_en: Hypersegmented neutrophil — six clustered nuclear lobes with condensed chromatin, no toxic change
pearls_zh: 考法：小葉緊密成簇時考官測試你能否分辨出 6 個獨立小葉，並聯想到 megaloblastic anemia。
檢驗順序：CBC（MCV）、周邊抹片、B12、folate；B12 邊緣值時加驗 methylmalonic acid。
治療反應：補充後約數天內 reticulocyte 上升，hypersegmented neutrophils 可持續一段時間才消失。
補充 B12 初期可能出現 hypokalemia（造血快速利用鉀），重度貧血病人需監測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 小葉擠在一起時容易被看成 4 葉的正常成熟嗜中性球；要調焦看清每個核塊是否分離，避免漏判。

quiz.q: 此嗜中性球有何核異常？若病人 MCV 正常，是否可排除 B12 缺乏？
quiz.a: 6 葉分葉過多；不可，分葉過多可早於 MCV 上升（或合併缺鐵時 MCV 被抵消）。

64888.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央有一條細長、呈 S 形彎曲的蠕蟲狀構造，長度約為紅血球直徑的數十倍，身體均勻染成紫色、尾端逐漸變細，即微絲蚴（microfilaria）；此倍率看不清鞘膜與尾端核的分布，無法判定蟲種。
features: Single elongated, serpiginous worm-like organism many red-cell diameters long
Uniformly basophilic body with a rounded anterior end and a tapering tail
Sheath and column of somatic nuclei not resolvable at this magnification
Surrounding red cells crowded and crenated, consistent with a thick area of the smear
Occasional small lymphocyte and platelets in background
64888.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single elongated, serpiginous microfilaria with a uniformly basophilic body, a rounded head end, and a tapering tail, lying among crowded, crenated red cells in a thick area of the film. The presence or absence of a sheath and the arrangement of tail nuclei cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with microfilaremia; species identification (e.g., Wuchereria bancrofti versus Brugia malayi versus Loa loa) requires high-power examination of the sheath and tail nuclei, ideally on a thick film with Giemsa or hematoxylin stain and with attention to collection time.

ddx.dx: Fibrin strand or cotton fiber artifact
ddx.vs: Fibers and fibrin lack a defined head, tapering tail, and internal nuclei, and often lie in a different focal plane.
Trypanosomes are much smaller, about 2-3 red cell diameters long, with an undulating membrane, flagellum, and kinetoplast.
Borrelia are very thin, loosely coiled organisms roughly one to three red cell diameters long without a nucleated body.

exam.answer_en: Microfilaria in peripheral blood — serpiginous larva with tapering tail (species not determinable at this power)
pearls_zh: 考法：指著 S 形蟲體問名稱與如何分種；分種看有無 sheath 與尾端核分布。
Wuchereria bancrofti：有鞘、尾端無核；Brugia malayi：有鞘、尾端有 2 顆分離核；Loa loa：有鞘、核延伸至尾尖；Mansonella perstans：無鞘。
採血時間：W. bancrofti 與 Brugia 多為夜間週期性（約晚上 10 點至凌晨 2 點採血）；Loa loa 為白天週期性。
濃縮法（Knott technique、membrane filtration）與 thick film 可提高檢出；常合併 eosinophilia。
治療：diethylcarbamazine（DEC）；Loa loa 高蟲量時使用 DEC 可誘發 encephalopathy，需先評估蟲量。
exam.pitfall_zh: 低倍下易把纖維、棉絮或抹片上的人工條狀物當成微絲蚴；真蟲體有體核（somatic nuclei）排列、頭端鈍圓、尾端漸細。

quiz.q: 圖中長條形寄生蟲為何？要區分 W. bancrofti 與 Brugia malayi，需觀察哪兩個特徵？
quiz.a: Microfilaria；有無 sheath 與尾端核分布（Brugia 尾端有 2 顆分離核）。

65016.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中下肢皮膚可見多發暗紫紅色、表面光亮的隆起腫瘤結節，周圍伴隨較平坦的紅斑與浸潤性斑塊（patch/plaque），同時存在不同階段病灶，符合蕈狀肉芽腫腫瘤期（tumor stage mycosis fungoides）。
features: Clinical photograph of the lower limb with multiple violaceous, dome-shaped, shiny tumor nodules, some coalescent
Surrounding infiltrated erythematous plaques and flatter patches with fine scale
Coexistence of patch, plaque and tumor lesions of different stages on the same limb
Focal superficial erosion/crusting over the largest nodule; no deep ulceration evident
65016.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the lower extremity shows multiple violaceous to dusky red, dome-shaped tumor nodules, several coalescing into a larger indurated mass, arising on a background of infiltrated erythematous plaques and scaly patches. The simultaneous presence of patch, plaque and tumor lesions favors progression of a long-standing cutaneous T-cell lymphoma rather than a de novo nodular process. Histologic confirmation with assessment for large-cell transformation is required. Findings are consistent with tumor-stage mycosis fungoides.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Typically presents as solitary or grouped ulcerating nodules without a preceding patch/plaque background, and shows sheets of CD30+ large cells.
Violaceous nodules occur without an evolving patch-plaque stage and biopsy shows MPO/CD33+ myeloid or monocytic infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type
ddx.vs: Rapidly growing red-violaceous leg tumors without prior patches; biopsy shows CD20+, BCL2+, MUM1+ large B cells.
Violaceous plaques and nodules are vascular spindle-cell lesions positive for HHV8 (LANA) rather than atypical CD4+ T cells.

65464.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有數顆中等大小的芽細胞，染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍色無顆粒；黑色箭頭處細胞質向外伸出偽足狀突起，紅色箭頭處細胞膜下方有一排小空泡，像一串珍珠（string of pearls）。這兩個細胞質特徵在 BPDCN 的芽細胞中常見。
features: Medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Scant grey-blue, agranular cytoplasm
Tail-like cytoplasmic pseudopod/protrusion (black arrow)
Row of small submembranous cytoplasmic microvacuoles producing a string-of-pearls pattern (red arrow)
Background red cells show rouleaux-like stacking; platelets present
65464.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant grey-blue agranular cytoplasm. One blast shows a pseudopod-like cytoplasmic extension, and another shows a row of small submembranous vacuoles in a string-of-pearls arrangement; granules and Auer rods are not seen. Red cells show focal rouleaux-like stacking and platelets are present. The morphology is suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, which requires confirmation by flow cytometry (CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4/TCL1).

ddx.vs: Monoblasts have more abundant cytoplasm, sometimes fine granules or vacuoles and are NSE/CD14/CD64 positive, while BPDCN blasts are agranular and CD123-bright.
Lymphoblasts are TdT and B/T lineage positive and usually lack the submembranous microvacuoles and pseudopods.
AML-M0 blasts are CD34/CD117/CD13 positive and CD123-dim, not CD4+/CD56+/bright CD123 with lineage-negative profile.

ddx.dx: Large granular lymphocytes or NK-cell leukemia
ddx.vs: NK cells show azurophilic granules and express CD2/CD7/cCD3ε, which BPDCN blasts lack.

exam.answer_en: Circulating blasts suggestive of BPDCN — agranular grey-blue blasts with pseudopods and string-of-pearls submembranous vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：考官分別指黑箭頭（偽足）與紅箭頭（膜下成串小空泡），問形態名稱與可能診斷；答 pseudopodia 與 string of pearls vacuoles，提示 BPDCN。
形態本身不具特異性，必須以 flow 證實：CD4+、CD56+、CD123 bright、HLA-DR+，MPO 與系別標記陰性。
細胞化學：MPO、Sudan black B 與 nonspecific esterase 皆陰性，可與 AML 區分。
BPDCN 可與 CMML/MDS 等骨髓系腫瘤共存，常見 TET2 突變；預後差，適合者應考慮移植。
exam.pitfall_zh: 無顆粒、染色質細緻的 blasts 易被誤判為 lymphoblasts（ALL）或 monoblasts；BPDCN 空泡排成膜下串珠、MPO/NSE 陰性，需 flow 確認 CD123/CD56。

quiz.q: 紅色箭頭所指 blast 細胞膜下成排小空泡的形態稱為？需以哪項檢查確診？
quiz.a: String of pearls vacuoles；flow cytometry（CD4、CD56、CD123 等）。

65400.recognize_zh: 雖標題為切片，影像實為骨髓抹片：細胞稠密的區域中有大量核偏位、染色質粗、細胞質淡藍帶核周淡染區的漿細胞，部分體積大、染色質較開放，指向漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Hypercellular aspirate fields with a marked increase in plasma cells
Eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and pale blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Size variation, with some large plasma cells showing open chromatin
One plasma cell with a thick, dark-rimmed cytoplasm (ring-like appearance) in upper left panel
Admixed erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and fat spaces
65400.describe_en: Composite images show Romanowsky-stained bone marrow aspirate smears rather than histologic biopsy sections. Cellular particles and trails contain numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and pale to moderately basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof, including enlarged forms with more open chromatin. Residual erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and fat spaces are present. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; note the specimen type does not match the 'biopsy' description.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are fewer, uniformly mature and polytypic without large immature forms.
Composed of large cells with prominent central nucleoli and very high proliferation, often EBER-positive, rather than recognizable plasma cells with hof.
Erythroblasts have central round nuclei with deep blue cytoplasm lacking a hof, and show a maturation sequence to polychromatic forms.

65208.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片與抹片中組織球吞噬紅血球與其他血球（hemophagocytosis，箭頭），CD3 顯示大量 T 細胞浸潤，流式見 CD4−/CD8− 的 γδ T 細胞擴增；周邊血嗜中性球細胞質內可見小顆粒狀嗜鹼性桑椹體（morula），指向 Anaplasma 感染引發的 HLH。
features: Bone marrow biopsy: histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm containing engulfed red cells and nucleated cells (arrows)
Aspirate: large histiocyte with vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm phagocytosing red cells and cellular debris
CD3 immunostain: markedly increased interstitial T cells
Flow cytometry: CD3+CD5+ T cells with a CD4-/CD8- double-negative population that is 93.7% TCR-gamma/delta positive
Peripheral blood neutrophil with a small, stippled basophilic intracytoplasmic inclusion (morula)
65208.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy and aspirate show histiocytes with prominent hemophagocytosis of red cells and nucleated cells. CD3 immunostaining reveals a substantial interstitial T-cell infiltrate, and flow cytometry identifies an expanded CD4/CD8 double-negative T-cell population expressing TCR gamma/delta. The peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil containing a small basophilic granular intracytoplasmic inclusion consistent with a morula. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis secondary to granulocytic anaplasmosis, with a reactive gamma/delta T-cell expansion (no clonal TCR rearrangement).

ddx.vs: HSTCL also shows gamma/delta T cells but with sinusoidal marrow infiltration by monotonous medium cells, isochromosome 7q, and clonal TCR rearrangement, which was absent.
Ehrlichia morulae are found mainly in monocytes rather than neutrophils; PCR distinguishes the species.
Döhle bodies are pale blue, peripheral, homogeneous cytoplasmic patches, whereas morulae are dark, stippled, berry-like clusters.
Histiocytic sarcoma shows cytologically atypical, pleomorphic histiocytes forming sheets, whereas these histiocytes are bland with active phagocytosis.

exam.answer_en: Secondary HLH due to granulocytic anaplasmosis — marrow hemophagocytosis, reactive γδ T-cell expansion and neutrophil morula
pearls_zh: 考法：多圖組合——指吞噬血球的組織球問 hemophagocytosis，指中性球內桑椹狀包涵體問 morula（Anaplasma phagocytophilum），並串成感染誘發 HLH。
HLH-2004 需 ≥5/8：發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球低下、高 TG 或低 fibrinogen、hemophagocytosis、NK 活性低、ferritin ≥500、sCD25 ≥2400 U/mL。
Morula 位置：Anaplasma 在中性球，Ehrlichia chaffeensis 主要在單核球；皆經 tick 傳播，治療首選 doxycycline，懷疑即應開始。
γδ T 細胞擴增需排除 hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma（isochromosome 7q、骨髓竇狀浸潤）；以 TCR 基因重排克隆性檢測區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 骨髓見噬血現象常被直接等同 HLH，但輸血、敗血症也可見，需符合臨床與實驗室準則；morula 也易被誤認為 Döhle body 或毒性顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球內桑椹狀包涵體稱為什麼？指向哪一病原？首選治療藥物為何？
quiz.a: Morula；Anaplasma phagocytophilum；doxycycline。

65080.recognize_zh: 四格視野裡多是大型母細胞，細胞質豐富、淡灰藍、邊緣不規則並含小空泡，核圓到腎形或略摺疊、染色質細緻，部分細胞可見明顯核仁；伴隨少數核摺疊較明顯的前單核球，符合急性單核母細胞白血病的周邊血表現。
features: Four-panel composite with many large blasts showing abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and irregular cell borders
Round, reniform or gently folded nuclei with fine, lacy chromatin
Prominent single nucleoli in several cells
Scattered small cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods seen
Some smaller cells with more convoluted nuclei consistent with promonocytes
Background RBCs with occasional mature small leukocytes for size comparison
65080.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, shown as a four-field composite, demonstrates numerous large blasts with abundant pale grey-blue, focally vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular cytoplasmic outlines. Nuclei are round to reniform or slightly folded, with finely dispersed chromatin and one or more conspicuous nucleoli; a minority of cells show more convoluted nuclei in keeping with promonocytes. Auer rods are not identified. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia, to be confirmed by nonspecific esterase staining and flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal/without maturation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have less cytoplasm, may show Auer rods, and are MPO+ with negative monocytic esterase and monocytic flow markers.
AMML has a substantial granulocytic component (at least 20% neutrophils and precursors) alongside monocytic cells, which is not evident in these fields.
Mature monocytes have condensed, folded chromatin without nucleoli and the count lacks a blast population.
BPDCN cells have agranular cytoplasm with pseudopods and a characteristic CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCF4+ phenotype without CD14/CD64 monocytic expression or NSE positivity.

exam.answer_en: Acute monoblastic leukemia — numerous large monoblasts with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, with a minority of promonocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：同一片分別指核圓、核仁明顯的細胞與核摺疊、細胞質較灰的細胞，要求區分 monoblast 與 promonocyte；兩者計數時皆算 blast。
FAB 分型：monoblast 為主稱 M5a（acute monoblastic），promonocyte/monocyte 為主稱 M5b（acute monocytic）。
與 AMML（M4）鑑別：AMML 需 ≥20% 中性球系細胞；此圖幾乎全為單核系，支持 M5。
高白血球的單核系 AML 易出現 leukostasis、tumor lysis syndrome 與 DIC，需緊急降白血球並監測凝血功能。
exam.pitfall_zh: 少數核摺疊的 promonocyte 易被當成成熟單核球而低估 blast；成熟單核球染色質較粗、無核仁，promonocyte 染色質細緻且算 blast equivalent。

quiz.q: 圖中核圓、核仁明顯的大細胞與少數核摺疊細胞各是什麼？計算 blast 時如何處理？
quiz.a: Monoblast 與 promonocyte；兩者都計入 blast（equivalent）。

64696.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD3 免疫染色中，整片瀰漫浸潤的腫瘤細胞都呈強陽性（棕色），只有血管與纖維間隔不染色，證實這片單調浸潤是 T 細胞來源。
features: Diffuse, strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD3 staining in virtually all infiltrating cells
Sheet-like infiltrate effacing tissue architecture, interrupted only by negative vessels and fibrous septa
Uniform staining intensity consistent with a monotonous clonal-appearing T-cell population
Negative stromal and endothelial elements serve as internal negative control
64696.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain for CD3 shows diffuse, strong positivity in a sheet-like lymphoid infiltrate that effaces the intestinal wall. Only intervening blood vessels and fibrous septa are negative. The uniform staining supports a T-cell lineage for the infiltrate but by itself does not distinguish neoplastic from reactive T cells. Together with CD56 and TIA1 positivity and the monotonous epitheliotropic morphology, findings are consistent with monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: EATL is also CD3+ but usually CD56-/CD8- with pleomorphic cells and necrosis, whereas MEITL is characteristically CD8+ and CD56+ with MATK expression.
ENKTL expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and CD56 but is EBER-positive, while MEITL is EBV-negative.
Reactive infiltrates show a mixed CD4/CD8 population with retained architecture and polyclonal TCR, rather than a mass-like, monotonous CD3+ sheet with clonal TCR rearrangement.

64440.recognize_zh: 紅血球普遍呈卵圓形，許多細胞中央有一至兩條橫向裂隙或縱向狹縫（o：Melanesian/東南亞卵圓形紅血球，s：口形紅血球），另有形狀不規則、血紅素分布不均的細胞（c）；混合的形態提示不只一種膜蛋白或血紅素異常。
features: Many rigid-appearing oval/stomatocytic red cells with one or two transverse or longitudinal central slits (Melanesian ovalocytes, labeled o)
Stomatocytes with a single slit-like central pallor (labeled s)
Poorly defined red cell shapes with uneven, eccentric hemoglobin distribution (labeled c)
Mild anisocytosis with scattered elliptocytes and occasional folded forms
No obvious sickle cells, target-cell predominance or red cell agglutination
Platelets present in normal-appearing numbers
64440.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a heterogeneous red cell population dominated by ovalocytes, many of which contain one or two transverse bars or slits (stomatocytic ovalocytes), together with stomatocytes and irregular cells with uneven hemoglobin distribution. Scattered elliptocytes are present. Classic sickle cells are not identified. The combination of stomatocytic ovalocytes is characteristic of Southeast Asian ovalocytosis, while the admixed stomatocytes and irregular forms suggest additional membrane or hydration defects. In this patient, findings correlate with co-inherited SAO, dehydrated hereditary stomatocytosis (PIEZO1), SPTA1 elliptocytosis variant and HbS trait, confirmed by molecular testing.

ddx.vs: HE shows smooth elongated elliptocytes with normal central hemoglobin distribution, whereas SAO cells are rounder, rigid ovalocytes with one or two transverse slits.

Overhydrated stomatocytosis shows round macrocytic stomatocytes with single mouth-like slits rather than ovalocytes with double bars, and requires osmotic fragility/ektacytometry and genetics to separate.
Xerocytosis shows few stomatocytes, target cells and dense cells with a left-shifted ektacytometry curve and raised MCHC, while SAO gives a flat ektacytometry profile.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency or thalassemia with pencil/elliptical cells
ddx.vs: These show hypochromic microcytic cells with pencil forms and target cells without slit-like stomatocytic ovalocytes.

64376.recognize_zh: 低倍視野中，新生兒周邊血內可見多顆深藍色、細胞質少的胚芽球，並有核濃縮的有核紅血球與偏藍的多染性紅血球（polychromasia），在 Down 症候群背景下即符合 TAM。
features: Increased circulating blasts (about ten in one low-power field) of small to intermediate size with high N:C ratio
Blasts with scant basophilic cytoplasm, some with irregular outlines or cytoplasmic projections and occasional vacuoles
Nucleated red blood cell with a small dense, round pyknotic nucleus
Scattered polychromatic (bluish-gray) macrocytic red cells
Crowded red cell background typical of neonatal high hematocrit
64376.describe_en: Low-power view of a neonatal peripheral blood smear shows a markedly increased number of circulating blasts with high N:C ratios, basophilic cytoplasm and irregular cell borders, some with cytoplasmic projections suggestive of megakaryoblastic differentiation. A nucleated red blood cell and scattered polychromatic red cells are present in a crowded red cell background. Detailed chromatin and nucleolar features are not resolvable at this magnification. In a neonate with trisomy 21 and a GATA1 mutation, findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (ML-DS)
ddx.vs: ML-DS arises later in infancy or early childhood after a TAM or de novo, often with preceding cytopenias and dysplasia, whereas TAM presents within days of birth; morphology overlaps.
Stressed neonates show nucleated red cells and left-shifted granulocytes but not a population of blasts with megakaryoblastic cytoplasmic blebs.
Congenital AML or ALL in infants without trisomy 21 often has KMT2A rearrangement or other fusions and does not resolve spontaneously.
Mature lymphocytes have condensed chromatin and a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm, whereas blasts have finer chromatin, larger size and irregular basophilic cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis in a neonate with Down syndrome — markedly increased circulating blasts with cytoplasmic projections, NRBC and polychromasia
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍新生兒抹片問「這些深藍色細胞是什麼？可能的背景？」出生數天內周邊血 blasts 大增要想到 Down syndrome 的 TAM。
TAM 與 ML-DS 均以 trisomy 21 加上 GATA1 突變為特徵，WHO 5th 歸在 myeloid proliferations associated with Down syndrome。
TAM 的周邊血 blast 比例常高於骨髓（與胎兒肝臟造血有關），因此以周邊血判讀為主。
多數自行緩解，但約 20–30% 日後發展為 ML-DS，需定期追蹤 CBC 至約 4 歲。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把新生兒的有核紅血球或小淋巴球當成 blast（或反之）；blast 較大、染色質細、細胞質深藍不規則，NRBC 核小而濃縮、細胞質含血紅素。

quiz.q: 此新生兒的 blasts 帶有哪一個基因的突變，是 TAM 的定義特徵？
quiz.a: GATA1（合併 trisomy 21）。

64184.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多顆與紅血球差不多大的小型淋巴球，核質比極高、細胞質幾乎看不到，染色質呈粗塊狀、深淺交錯的「足球／龜殼狀」（soccer-ball）凝集，左上方並有一個 smudge cell，是典型 CLL 細胞。
features: Small lymphocytes approximately the size of a red cell
Very high N:C ratio with scant to barely visible cytoplasm
Round nuclei with coarse, block-like clumped chromatin (soccer-ball pattern)
No visible nucleoli
Smudge cell in the upper field; red cells normocytic and normochromic
64184.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous small mature lymphocytes, roughly the size of a red cell, with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round nuclei, and coarse, block-like clumped chromatin without nucleoli. A smudge cell is present. Prolymphocytes with prominent nucleoli are not seen in this field, and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry is required.

ddx.vs: Normal lymphocytes look similar individually; CLL is recognized by absolute monotonous lymphocytosis with smudge cells and a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
MCL cells typically have more irregular or notched nuclei and less clumped chromatin, and are cyclin D1-positive/CD23-negative.
Prolymphocytes are larger with moderately condensed chromatin and a single prominent central nucleolus, making up more than 15% in CLL/PL.
FL cells are small with deep nuclear clefts and are CD10-positive, CD5-negative.

exam.answer_en: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia — RBC-sized small lymphocytes with coarse block-like 'soccer-ball' chromatin and a smudge cell
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍指淋巴球問染色質特徵；答 coarse clumped、soccer-ball（龜殼狀）染色質、無核仁，為典型 CLL 細胞。
Flow 計分（Matutes score）：CD5+、CD23+、FMC7−、CD22/CD79b dim、surface Ig dim；高分支持 CLL，並常加 CD200+。
注意帶明顯核仁的較大 prolymphocyte：比例增加或淋巴結快速變大、LDH 上升，要警覺疾病進展或 Richter transformation。
CLL 常合併自體免疫血球減少（AIHA、ITP）與低 γ 球蛋白血症造成的感染。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與正常小淋巴球混淆：單看細胞難區分，需依絕對淋巴球數、flow clonality（light chain restriction）判定；MCL 細胞核不規則、CD23−、cyclin D1+ 也要排除。

quiz.q: 圖中淋巴球的染色質型態俗稱什麼？此類細胞 flow 典型為 CD5 與 CD23 如何表現？
quiz.a: Soccer-ball（龜殼狀）粗塊染色質；CD5+、CD23+。

64056.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖：箭頭標示 13、14、18、22 號染色體異常，單一條 8 號與 17 號染色體（-8、-17），並另排一組標記染色體（mar）；下方核型式寫明 t(14;18)(q32;q21)，這是濾泡性淋巴瘤的特徵易位（IGH::BCL2）。
features: GTG-banded karyogram at ~400 band resolution, male (XY), 50 metaphases analyzed
Arrows mark abnormal chromosomes 13, 14, 18 and 22
Only one chromosome 8 and one chromosome 17 are displayed (monosomy 8 and 17)
A separate 'mar' slot shows two unidentified marker chromosomes
64056.describe_en: Conventional G-banded chromosome analysis of 50 metaphases shows an abnormal clone in 15 cells and a normal male karyotype in 35 cells. The abnormal clone carries t(14;18)(q32;q21), additional material on 13q34, a 22q11 deletion and loss of chromosomes 8 and 17, and the karyogram displays two marker chromosomes that restore the modal number to 46; note that the written karyotype omits +2mar, which should be reconciled with the laboratory report. This is a non-morphologic figure. The t(14;18) indicates IGH::BCL2 rearrangement consistent with a follicular lymphoma-derived clone, and the complex secondary abnormalities (including 17/TP53 loss) support possible transformation to large B-cell lymphoma in the clinical context.

ddx.dx: De novo diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with BCL2 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Cytogenetics cannot separate de novo from transformed DLBCL; history or histologic evidence of a follicular component is required.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma additionally shows an 8q24 MYC rearrangement (e.g., t(8;14) or variant), which is not described here, and should be excluded by MYC FISH.
MCL carries t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH rather than t(14;18).
Burkitt lymphoma is defined by t(8;14)(q24;q32) or variants with a usually simple karyotype, not t(14;18).

exam.answer_en: Complex karyotype with t(14;18)(q32;q21) IGH::BCL2 plus secondary abnormalities incl. loss of 17 — follicular lymphoma-derived clone, suggests transformation
pearls_zh: 判讀：G-banding karyogram 先找成對染色體中長度或帶型不對稱者；14 號長臂與 18 號長臂互換即 t(14;18)(q32;q21)，使 BCL2 接到 IGH enhancer 下而過度表現。
ISCN 讀法：[15] 與 [35] 為分析的 metaphase 數；clone 定義為 ≥2 個細胞有相同結構異常或增加，≥3 個細胞有相同染色體缺失。
t(14;18) 見於大多數 follicular lymphoma，也見於部分 GCB-type DLBCL；檢測可用 FISH（IGH::BCL2 dual-fusion 或 BCL2 break-apart），健康人血中也可低量檢出。
Transformation 相關的附加異常包括 TP53/17p 缺失、CDKN2A 缺失與 MYC rearrangement；若同時有 MYC 與 BCL2 rearrangement，WHO 5th 歸為 DLBCL/HGBL with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 t(14;18) 與 t(11;14)（CCND1，mantle cell）或 t(8;14)（MYC，Burkitt）搞混：看夥伴染色體是 18 號；另外單有 t(14;18) 不等於 transformation，需依形態確認大細胞增生。

quiz.q: 此 karyogram 中 14 號與 18 號染色體間的轉位會造成哪一個基因融合？最典型相關的淋巴瘤是？
quiz.a: IGH::BCL2（BCL2 過度表現）；follicular lymphoma。

63992.recognize_zh: 低倍 Perls 鐵染色下，一個骨髓顆粒（particle）內多處細胞含藍色顆粒狀含鐵血黃素，背景為粉紅色對比染色；在 AML 情境中，這些吸收鐵染色的細胞對應類 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Low-power view of a bone marrow particle with pink counterstained cellular background
Multiple cells within the particle containing blue granular Prussian blue-positive material
Iron-positive cells clustered within the particle rather than free in the background
Fat vacuoles at the particle periphery
Cell-level morphology (Gaucher-like cytoplasm) cannot be resolved at this magnification
63992.describe_en: Perls' Prussian blue stain of the bone marrow aspirate at low power shows a marrow particle containing multiple cells with blue granular iron-positive cytoplasmic material against a pink counterstained background. The iron-positive cells are distributed throughout the particle, indicating readily identifiable storage iron. Individual cellular detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the context of AML with pseudo-Gaucher cells, these iron-laden cells correspond to macrophages/Gaucher-like cells that accumulate hemosiderin, a feature that helps separate pseudo-Gaucher cells from true Gaucher cells.

ddx.dx: Increased storage iron from transfusion or anemia of inflammation
ddx.vs: Iron-laden macrophages alone cannot identify Gaucher-like cells; correlation with Romanowsky-stained fibrillar macrophages is required.
True Gaucher cells may also show some iron positivity, so the distinction rests on the underlying leukemia and glucocerebrosidase activity rather than this stain.
Ring sideroblasts are erythroid precursors with perinuclear blue granules encircling the nucleus, which must be assessed at high power rather than in particle macrophages.

63928.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球一側有一道深凹的裂口，把細胞分成兩個突出的「鉗口」，形如蘑菇或鉗子（pincer / mushroom-shaped cell）；周圍其他紅血球大小與形狀大致正常，因此這是一個孤立但典型的形狀異常。
features: Single red cell (arrow) with a deep notch-like cleft on one side producing two knob-like projections (pincer/mushroom shape)
Remaining red cells largely normocytic and round, many with reduced central pallor
Mild anisocytosis without prominent schistocytes, spherocyte clusters or target cells
No red cell inclusions, parasites or nucleated red cells in this field
Leukocytes and platelets are not represented in this field
63928.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a background of mostly normocytic, round red cells with mild anisocytosis. A single red cell (arrow) shows a deep one-sided cleft producing two small projections, giving a pincer-like or mushroom-shaped appearance. Schistocytes, clusters of spherocytes, target cells and red cell inclusions are not evident in this field. This is an isolated pincer (mushroom-shaped) red cell; the finding is nonspecific and should be interpreted with the clinical context, here SARS-CoV-2 infection, and screened for hemolysis or a membrane disorder if frequent.

ddx.vs: Schistocytes are smaller fragments with sharp angular edges or horn-like points, whereas the pincer cell is a near-full-size cell with a single rounded central notch.
Bite cells have a semicircular peripheral bite with blister cells and Heinz bodies, not a narrow cleft between two knobs.
Stomatocytes have a slit-like central pallor and knizocytes a central bar, both lacking a cleft that reaches the cell margin.
Artifacts involve many cells in thick areas or show overlap, whereas a true pincer cell is isolated in a well-spread monolayer.

63800.recognize_zh: 中型淋巴細胞核圓或略凹、染色質細緻均勻、無明顯核仁，淡藍色細胞質沿整個細胞周邊伸出細長不規則的毛狀突起，這是毛細胞白血病（hairy cell leukemia）的毛細胞。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than small lymphocytes, with moderate N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with evenly dispersed, fine chromatin and no conspicuous nucleoli
Pale gray-blue cytoplasm with fine, irregular hair-like projections circumferentially
One small dark cell at bottom (platelet clump or pyknotic cell) for size comparison
Background red cells crenated (echinocytic drying artifact)
63800.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin without prominent nucleoli, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm bearing fine, irregular hair-like projections around the entire circumference. Background red cells show crenation artifact. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123 bright) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Short villi concentrated at one or two poles, more condensed chromatin, and usually CD103 and CD123 negative.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: Cells have a prominent central nucleolus, leukocytosis, and are CD25 negative and BRAF V600E wild-type.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes with broad-based projections and typically CD25, CD123 and annexin A1 negative.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and blunt pseudopods rather than fine hairs, and are CD14 positive.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — medium lymphoid cells with fine circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections
pearls_zh: 考法：指細胞問名稱，重點在整圈細毛狀突起、核圓或腎形、染色質細緻、無明顯核仁。
Flow：CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123 陽性，CD200 亮；IHC annexin A1 與 TRAP 陽性。
分子：幾乎全部帶 BRAF V600E；使用 IGHV4-34 或帶 MAP2K1 突變的類 HCL 疾病常為 BRAF 野生型。
臨床：全血球低下合併單核球減少、脾腫大；骨髓常 dry tap，切片呈 fried-egg 外觀；一線治療為 cladribine 等 purine analog。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 SMZL 的 villous lymphocyte：SMZL 絨毛短且集中於兩極、染色質較粗，CD103 與 CD123 陰性。

quiz.q: 此細胞所屬疾病最具特徵的分子異常為何？
quiz.a: BRAF V600E

63736.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為細長、兩端尖細、呈新月或鐮刀形的紅血球（drepanocytes），同一視野還有多個船形細胞與一顆有核紅血球，符合鐮刀型紅血球。
features: Elongated crescent-shaped red cells with pointed ends at both poles (arrows)
Additional boat-shaped and oat-shaped poikilocytes throughout the field
Nucleated red blood cell with dense pyknotic nucleus
Scattered target cells; many red cells show crenation (echinocytic change), likely a preparation artifact
Tiny dark punctate dots within many red cells, of uncertain significance at this resolution
Granulocytic precursor/myeloid cell with granular cytoplasm and adequate platelets
63736.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows multiple sickle cells (drepanocytes), characterized by elongated crescent shapes with pointed ends, together with boat-shaped poikilocytes and occasional target cells. A nucleated red blood cell and a granulocytic cell are present. Many red cells show crenation, most likely a drying or storage artifact, and small punctate dots are seen in some red cells whose nature cannot be confirmed at this resolution. Findings are consistent with a sickling disorder such as sickle cell anemia.

ddx.vs: Elliptocytes are oval with blunt rounded ends and even hemoglobin, lacking the sharp pointed tips of sickle cells.
Dacrocytes have a single tapered tail with a rounded body, whereas drepanocytes taper to points at both ends.
HbC and HbSC show intracellular hexagonal or blunt crystals and abundant target cells rather than classic thin crescent sickle cells; hemoglobin HPLC confirms.
Schistocytes are small angular fragments with straight cut edges and are usually accompanied by thrombocytopenia, not elongated intact crescents.

exam.answer_en: Sickle cells (drepanocytes) — elongated crescent red cells with pointed ends and a nucleated RBC, sickling disorder
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指新月形細胞問名稱，並說出與 teardrop cell（單尾）、elliptocyte（鈍端）的差別。
血片看到鐮刀細胞應以 HPLC 或電泳分型（HbSS、HbSC、HbS/β-thal）；sickle cell trait 的血片通常看不到鐮刀細胞。
有核紅血球與多染性反映慢性溶血下的骨髓代償；網狀紅血球突然下降要想到 parvovirus B19 aplastic crisis。
紅血球皺縮邊緣多為製片假影，作答時不要誤當成 acanthocyte。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為淚滴細胞（dacrocyte）：淚滴細胞只有一端尖尾、另一端圓鈍；sickle cell 兩端皆尖。

quiz.q: 箭頭細胞與淚滴細胞在形態上有何差別？
quiz.a: Sickle cell 兩端皆尖；teardrop cell 只有單一尖尾

63608.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞比旁邊的嗜中性球大，細胞核有明顯摺痕／凹陷（indented/folded nucleus），染色質細緻並隱約可見核仁，細胞質灰藍色帶細小嗜天青顆粒與少數小空泡，介於單核母細胞與成熟單核球之間，即前單核球（promonocyte）。
features: Large cell, larger than the adjacent neutrophil, with moderate N:C ratio
Nucleus with a prominent fold/indentation (cleft) giving a convoluted contour
Fine, delicate chromatin with a faint nucleolus
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and a few small vacuoles at the periphery
Background echinocytic (crenated) red cells, likely artifact, and scattered platelets
63608.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large mononuclear cell (arrow) with a folded, indented nucleus, fine delicate chromatin and a faint nucleolus. The cytoplasm is moderately abundant, grey-blue and contains fine azurophilic granules with a few small peripheral vacuoles. An adjacent segmented neutrophil provides a size comparison, and the background red cells are crenated, most likely as a preparation artifact. Findings are consistent with a promonocyte, which is counted as a blast equivalent in myeloid neoplasms with monocytic differentiation.

ddx.vs: Mature monocytes have more condensed, lacy but clumped chromatin without nucleoli and more vacuolated cytoplasm.
Monoblasts have a round to oval nucleus with one or more prominent nucleoli and abundant basophilic cytoplasm with few or no granules.
Abnormal monocytes have more condensed chromatin than promonocytes and are not counted as blast equivalents.
Hypogranular promyelocytes have bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei and strong MPO positivity, whereas promonocytes are nonspecific esterase positive.

exam.answer_en: Promonocyte — large cell with folded nucleus, fine chromatin and gray-blue granular cytoplasm; counted as a blast equivalent
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指旁邊嗜中性球做大小對照的核摺疊大細胞，問名稱與計數規則；答 promonocyte，與 monoblast 一起算入芽細胞，異常成熟單核球則不算。
臨床影響：CMML 以芽細胞加 promonocyte 比例分級（CMML-1/CMML-2），達 ≥20% 即為 AML，判讀錯誤會直接改變診斷。
WHO 5th CMML 門檻：持續單核球 ≥0.5×10⁹/L 且占白血球 ≥10%。
細胞化學：nonspecific esterase 陽性並可被 NaF 抑制；flow 單核球成熟可看 CD14、CD64、CD11b 表現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與成熟單核球或 CMML 的異常單核球混淆：成熟單核球染色質較凝集、無核仁、細胞質空泡較多；把異常單核球誤算成 promonocyte 會把 CMML 高估為 AML。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指的核摺疊大細胞是什麼？在計算芽細胞比例時如何處理？
quiz.a: Promonocyte（前單核球）；算作芽細胞等價，與 monoblast 合計

63544.recognize_zh: 高倍下右半部為卵圓至紡錘形核、胞質豐富的細胞，CD25 呈棕色細胞膜與細胞質陽性；左側小圓核的淋巴球則完全陰性，顯示肥大細胞異常表現 CD25。
features: Oval to elongated spindle-shaped nuclei with fine chromatin and abundant cytoplasm in the positive population
Moderate granular cytoplasmic and membranous CD25 staining outlining cell borders
Sharp demarcation from an adjacent cluster of small round CD25-negative lymphocytes
Positive cells arranged in a loose streaming sheet along the edge of the core
Occasional strongly stained small round cells (likely nonspecific or other positive cells)
63544.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow trephine immunostained for CD25 shows a sheet of cells with oval to spindled nuclei and abundant cytoplasm displaying moderate membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD25 positivity. The positive population is sharply demarcated from an adjacent cluster of small round lymphocytes that are CD25 negative, serving as an internal negative control. Aberrant CD25 expression by spindled cells in this distribution is consistent with neoplastic mast cells of systemic mastocytosis, provided mast cell lineage is confirmed by tryptase or CD117 staining.

ddx.vs: Hairy cell leukemia is CD25 positive but consists of round-oval B cells (CD20, annexin A1 positive) in an interstitial fried-egg pattern and is tryptase negative.
CD25-positive T cells are small to medium lymphoid cells that coexpress CD3, lacking spindle morphology and tryptase.
Stromal spindle cells are CD25 and tryptase negative and have wavy, thin nuclei without abundant granular cytoplasm.

63480.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一顆比紅血球大的巨大血小板，細胞質淡藍、含細顆粒且邊緣有芽狀突起，周圍另有多顆淡藍色、顆粒稀少的異常血小板，配合 CML 病史，提示巨核母細胞急變（megakaryoblastic crisis）。
features: Giant platelet larger than adjacent red cells with granular blue-gray cytoplasm and a budding bleb
Several additional platelets that are large, pale blue, and hypogranular/agranular
No nucleus in the central giant platelet (distinguishing it from a micromegakaryocyte)
Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with scattered echinocytes and a teardrop cell
No blasts or granulocytes in this field
63480.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with scattered crenated cells and an occasional teardrop cell. A giant anucleate platelet, larger than surrounding red cells, is present with granular blue-gray cytoplasm and a peripheral cytoplasmic bleb, accompanied by several large, pale, hypogranular platelets. No blasts are present in this field, although they predominate elsewhere per the clinical data. In a patient with known Ph-positive CML and megakaryoblasts by flow cytometry, these abnormal giant platelets are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in megakaryoblastic blast crisis of CML.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes and megakaryoblasts contain a nucleus, whereas this giant platelet is anucleate.
Inherited giant platelets occur with lifelong thrombocytopenia and normal WBC, and MYH9 disorders show Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils, rather than a leukemic picture.
These MPNs can show giant platelets but are BCR::ABL1 negative and lack an increase in blasts.
Gray platelet syndrome has uniformly agranular large platelets with marrow fibrosis in the absence of CML or blasts, and alpha-granule deficiency is confirmed by electron microscopy.

63416.recognize_zh: 低倍薄層血片中，在大量大小正常的紅血球之間只見一個香蕉形／新月形的寄生蟲，中央有聚集的深色染色質與色素，兩端較尖，這種新月形配子體指向惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）；倍率較低，雌雄分型僅供參考。
features: Single crescent/banana-shaped gametocyte among numerous normal-sized red cells
Central compact dark chromatin with pigment granules
Relatively slender body with tapering ends, favoring a female macrogametocyte
Host red cell outline largely inapparent
Low magnification limits evaluation of fine chromatin detail; no ring forms clearly seen
63416.describe_en: Thin blood smear at low magnification shows a single crescent-shaped gametocyte with centrally aggregated dark chromatin and pigment lying among normal-sized red cells. The body is slender with tapered ends, a configuration usually attributed to the female macrogametocyte, although sex determination is unreliable at this magnification. No ring forms are clearly identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium falciparum gametocyte.

ddx.vs: Microgametocytes are broader and sausage-shaped with more diffuse chromatin and pigment, whereas macrogametocytes are slender with compact central chromatin.
P. vivax gametocytes are round and fill an enlarged red cell with Schüffner stippling rather than being crescentic.
Trypanosomes are extracellular with a flagellum and kinetoplast, while artifacts lack organized chromatin and pigment.

63352.recognize_zh: 較高倍下可見數顆小型淋巴球各含一個邊界清楚的圓形透明球狀包涵體，並有嗜中性球與塗抹細胞作為對照；包涵體只見於淋巴球。
features: Small lymphocytes with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin and a thin rim of blue cytoplasm
Single sharply circumscribed, round, clear globular inclusion in each affected lymphocyte, indenting the nuclear contour
Inclusion-free lymphocytes present alongside affected cells
Segmented neutrophil without inclusions and a smudge cell in the field
Normocytic, normochromic red cells with scattered platelets
63352.describe_en: Higher-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows small mature lymphocytes with coarsely clumped chromatin, several of which contain a single sharply circumscribed, round, clear globular cytoplasmic inclusion that indents the nucleus. A segmented neutrophil lacks inclusions, and a smudge cell is present. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with globular lymphocyte cytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.dx: Mott cell / Russell body plasma cell
ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei, a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, with PAS-positive immunoglobulin globules.
Storage disease vacuoles are multiple, small and punched-out rather than a single large globule.
An overlying platelet is granular and purple, whereas these inclusions are clear and sharply circumscribed within the cytoplasm.

63288.recognize_zh: CD61 免疫染色中，棕色陽性的巨核細胞數量多、大小不一，包含許多單核小型巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte）及一顆核分離成兩個圓核的巨核細胞，顯示巨核細胞異生，支持 AML-MRC。
features: Numerous CD61-positive megakaryocytic cells with granular cytoplasmic brown staining
Marked size variation, including many small mononuclear forms (micromegakaryocytes) only slightly larger than surrounding cells
Megakaryocyte with two widely separated round nuclei (center right), a dysplastic feature
Loose clustering of megakaryocytes and CD61-positive cytoplasmic fragments/platelets in the interstitium
Background CD61-negative cells with blue counterstained nuclei, including immature cells with open chromatin
63288.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostained for CD61 highlights increased megakaryocytic cells with marked size variation. Many are small mononuclear forms (micromegakaryocytes) with single round nuclei, and one megakaryocyte shows two widely separated round nuclei, both dysplastic features. Megakaryocytes are loosely clustered, with scattered CD61-positive cytoplasmic fragments. The CD61-negative background includes immature cells with open chromatin. Findings demonstrate megakaryocytic dysplasia, supporting acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: In AMKL most CD61-positive cells are blasts with scant cytoplasm and high N:C ratio forming sheets, often with fibrosis, rather than scattered dysplastic megakaryocytes with abundant cytoplasm.
MPN megakaryocytes are typically large to giant with hyperlobated or bulbous nuclei rather than small mononuclear forms with separated nuclei.
Reactive megakaryocytes show a range of normal lobation without micromegakaryocytes or widely separated nuclei, and no increase in blasts.

63224.recognize_zh: Giemsa 厚片中紅血球已溶解，背景散布多個帶紅色染色質點與破碎藍色胞質的小型滋養體；右上方一顆較大、圓形、含棕色色素顆粒的蟲體可視為配子體（gametocyte），兩顆白血球可作大小參考。
features: Lysed red cell background with faint pink stippled ghost outlines
Multiple small trophozoites with red chromatin dots and irregular, fragmented blue cytoplasm
Larger round, compact parasite at upper right with dispersed golden-brown pigment, interpreted as a gametocyte
Two leukocytes (lobulated nuclei) for scale; no banana-shaped gametocytes
Resolution does not allow reliable separation of a gametocyte from a mature trophozoite
63224.describe_en: Giemsa-stained thick blood film shows a lysed erythrocyte background with numerous malaria parasites and two leukocytes. Most parasites are small trophozoites with red chromatin dots and irregular, fragmented blue cytoplasm, some within faint stippled ghost red cells. At the upper right, a larger round, compact parasite containing dispersed golden-brown pigment is consistent with the gametocyte described, although at this resolution it cannot be firmly separated from a mature trophozoite. No crescentic falciparum gametocytes are seen. This image is identical to a companion thick-film image. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax, with species confirmation best made on the thin film.

ddx.vs: Falciparum gametocytes are banana-shaped and asexual stages in blood are usually limited to small compact rings.
Malariae shows compact trophozoites with coarse dark pigment and no Schüffner's stippling of ghost cells; thin film shows small, non-enlarged infected cells.
White cells have large lobulated nuclei and platelet clumps are granular without discrete chromatin dots or hemozoin pigment.

63096.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片（A–C）中大型早幼粒球樣細胞，核折疊或雙葉，細胞質內有粗大、深紫黑色、類似嗜鹼性球的顆粒；流式（D）大部分細胞 CD34 陰性、側向散射高；FISH（E）見 der(15) 與 der(17) 上的 PML::RARA 融合訊號，確認為 APL。
features: Panels A-C: large promyelocyte-like cells with folded, bilobed or irregular nuclei
Abundant cytoplasm with coarse, dark purple-black granules resembling basophil granules, heavier in some cells (panel C)
Admixed cells with finer azurophilic granules; no definite faggot cell visible
Panel D: CD34 vs side scatter plot with a dominant CD34-negative, high side-scatter population and a minor CD34+ myeloblast cluster
Panel E: metaphase FISH with fusion signals on der(15) and der(17)
63096.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show sheets of abnormal promyelocyte-like cells with folded or bilobed nuclei and abundant cytoplasm containing coarse, dark granules that resemble basophil granules. Flow cytometry shows a dominant CD34-negative population with high side scatter and only a minor CD34-positive myeloblast population. Metaphase FISH demonstrates PML::RARA fusion signals on der(15) and der(17). Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA, with an unusual basophil-like granulation pattern.

ddx.vs: Basophilic blasts are CD34+/CD123+/CD203c+ with metachromatic toluidine blue granules and lack PML::RARA.
Mast cells are CD117 bright, tryptase-positive and often CD25+, with round or oval nuclei and no PML::RARA fusion.

ddx.dx: AML with t(8;21) or other granular AML
ddx.vs: These are usually CD34/HLA-DR positive with blasts rather than a CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative promyelocyte population.
Recovery promyelocytes have round nuclei with a perinuclear hof and orderly maturation, without folded nuclei or PML::RARA.

63032.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片以 lambda 輕鏈染色（深藍黑色訊號）標示出大量胞質強陽性的漿細胞，沿著血管周圍與間質散在或小群分布；在 POEMS 症候群中，漿細胞幾乎一律為 lambda 限制型（lambda-restricted），是重要的診斷線索。
features: Numerous cells with strong cytoplasmic lambda light chain signal (dark blue-black chromogen)
Positive cells scattered interstitially and concentrated around a small vessel
Positive cells have the size and eccentric outline of plasma cells
Background of negative hematopoietic cells, adipocytes and a bony trabecula
Kappa comparison stain not shown in this image
63032.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section stained for lambda light chain (likely in situ hybridization with a dark chromogen) shows numerous positive plasma cells distributed interstitially and in small perivascular clusters. Positive cells display strong cytoplasmic signal, while the surrounding hematopoietic elements and megakaryocytes are negative. Lambda restriction cannot be confirmed without a paired kappa stain, but in context the pattern supports a lambda-predominant plasma cell population. Findings are consistent with the monoclonal lambda plasma cell component of POEMS syndrome.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells show a kappa:lambda ratio of roughly 2:1 on paired stains, whereas POEMS shows lambda predominance.

Myeloma usually shows sheets or large interstitial aggregates with a higher plasma cell burden and CRAB features, whereas POEMS typically has a low-level lambda clone with osteosclerotic lesions and polyneuropathy.
LPL contains a clonal B-lymphocyte and lymphoplasmacytoid component, MYD88 L265P, and typically IgM, rather than an isolated lambda plasma cell population.

62968.recognize_zh: 抹片中為小至中型、核有切跡或凹陷（cleaved/notched）的淋巴細胞；流式第一次以 CD45 亮陽性設門時 B 細胞為多株（kappa 與 lambda 皆有），第二次在 CD45 陰性區設門才找到 kappa 限制型的 B 細胞群，說明這例濾泡性淋巴瘤細胞不表現 CD45，若只圈 CD45+ 會漏診。
features: Small to medium lymphoid cells with clumped chromatin and notched or cleaved nuclear contours (A-D)
Scant pale cytoplasm; no granules; occasional neutrophils for size comparison (B, C)
Flow E-F: conventional CD45-bright lymphocyte gate shows polytypic CD19+ B cells (kappa and lambda both present)
Flow G-H: lymphocyte gate placed on the CD45-negative/dim low-SSC region reveals a kappa-restricted CD19+ B-cell population
Teaching point: neoplastic cells lie outside the usual CD45-positive lymphocyte gate
62968.describe_en: Composite figure. Smears show small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with condensed chromatin, scant cytoplasm and notched to cleaved nuclei (A-D). Flow cytometry with a standard CD45-bright/low side scatter lymphocyte gate identifies polytypic CD19-positive B cells expressing both kappa and lambda (E, F). When the gate is redrawn to include CD45-negative events with low side scatter, a distinct kappa light chain-restricted CD19-positive B-cell population is revealed (G, H). Findings are consistent with involvement by a CD45-negative follicular lymphoma and illustrate that CD45-based gating can miss a clonal B-cell population.

ddx.vs: B-lymphoblasts are often CD45-dim/negative but are surface immunoglobulin-negative with CD34/TdT expression and fine blastic chromatin, whereas these cells carry kappa-restricted sIg.
Plasma cells are commonly CD45-negative but lack CD19 and surface light chains, expressing cytoplasmic light chains with CD38/CD138 bright.
MCL cells have irregular nuclei too but are CD5+ CD10-, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, whereas follicular lymphoma is CD10+ BCL6+ CD5- with t(14;18).
CD45-negative carcinoma cells lack CD19 and surface immunoglobulin and form cohesive clusters on smears.

62840.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片的羽狀邊緣可見一片黏在一起的細胞群：核為卵圓形、染色質均勻、無明顯核仁，胞質淡藍且邊界不清，呈平鋪的片狀排列；上方只有正常的嗜中性球。這種外觀溫和、成片出現的細胞是抽血時刮下的血管內皮細胞，不是白血病細胞。
features: Cohesive sheet-like cluster of cells lying within the red cell monolayer at the feathered edge
Medium-to-large cells with oval to elongated nuclei, some indented or grooved
Evenly distributed, finely granular chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders forming a syncytial arrangement
One elongated spindle-shaped nucleus within the cluster; admixed platelets and a few neutrophils
Uninvolved background shows normal neutrophils and red cells
62840.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows, near the feathered edge, a cohesive sheet of medium-to-large cells with oval to elongated, occasionally grooved nuclei, fine evenly dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and ample pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders. The cells lack the high N:C ratio, fine blastic chromatin, or nucleoli of leukemic blasts and lack the basophilic cytoplasmic skirt of reactive lymphocytes. The background contains unremarkable neutrophils and red cells. Findings are consistent with endothelial cells dislodged during venipuncture, a benign artifact.

ddx.vs: Blasts circulate as discrete, non-cohesive cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and nucleoli, not as bland syncytial sheets with abundant pale cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes are single cells whose deeply basophilic cytoplasm hugs adjacent red cells, rather than cohesive clusters of oval-nucleated cells.
Tumor cells show nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, prominent nucleoli and increased N:C ratio, whereas these nuclei are uniform and bland.
Megakaryocytic nuclei are dense and lobulated with granular cytoplasm and attached platelets, unlike the uniform oval nuclei here.

62776.recognize_zh: 嬰兒周邊血中許多小型成熟淋巴球的核有明顯裂隙或凹陷（cleaved / 臀狀核），染色質緻密、胞質稀少，配合一個月大嬰兒的顯著淋巴球增多，指向百日咳（Bordetella pertussis）。
features: Small mature lymphocytes, roughly 1-1.5 times red cell diameter, with high N:C ratio
Nuclei with deep clefts, notches, or cleaved (buttock-like) indentations
Dense, clumped mature chromatin without nucleoli
Scant pale basophilic cytoplasm without granules
Normocytic red cells and scattered platelets; no blasts
62776.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increased number of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with high N:C ratio, dense clumped chromatin, and scant agranular cytoplasm. Many lymphocyte nuclei display a distinct cleft or notch, imparting a cleaved or buttock-like appearance. No blasts, prolymphocytes, or large atypical reactive lymphocytes are identified in these fields. In a 1-month-old infant with marked lymphocytosis, findings are suggestive of Bordetella pertussis infection; PCR testing of a nasopharyngeal specimen is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leukemic FL shows cleaved buttock cells but occurs in adults and is a clonal CD10+ BCL2+ B-cell population, whereas pertussis lymphocytosis is polyclonal and predominantly T cells in an infant.
Lymphoblasts have finer dispersed chromatin, occasional nucleoli, and express CD34/TdT, unlike these mature clumped-chromatin cleaved lymphocytes.
Viral reactive lymphocytes are larger with abundant basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, rather than small cells with cleaved nuclei.
ATLL cells show multilobated flower-shaped nuclei in HTLV-1-positive adults and are clonal CD4+ CD25+ T cells.

exam.answer_en: Pertussis-associated lymphocytosis in an infant — small mature lymphocytes with cleaved/notched nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：嬰兒顯著淋巴球增多，考官指「核有裂隙的小型成熟淋巴球」問最可能病因（Bordetella pertussis），而非白血病。
機轉：pertussis toxin 抑制淋巴球遷出血管進入組織，使血中淋巴球堆積（非骨髓增生）。
Flow 顯示多株性、成熟 T 與 B 細胞混合，無 CD34/TdT 母細胞，可排除白血病。
臨床：小嬰兒白血球極度升高與肺高壓、死亡風險相關；嚴重時可考慮 exchange transfusion 或 leukoreduction。
診斷：鼻咽檢體 PCR；治療首選 macrolide，<1 個月嬰兒以 azithromycin 為主（erythromycin 與 infantile hypertrophic pyloric stenosis 相關）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 裂核小淋巴球易被誤判為 leukemic follicular lymphoma（buttock cells）；年齡為一個月嬰兒、細胞為多株性，支持百日咳反應性淋巴球增多。

quiz.q: 一個月大嬰兒淋巴球顯著增多，抹片見圖中裂核成熟淋巴球，最可能病因？首選確診檢查？
quiz.a: Bordetella pertussis 感染；鼻咽檢體 PCR

62712.recognize_zh: 原始細胞閘門內的 cCD22 對 cCD79a 流式圖：一群原始細胞（M 閘門，綠色）胞質 CD79a 明顯陽性（約 10⁴–10⁵），其餘原始細胞（紅色）CD79a 陰性到弱；cCD22 在兩群皆為陰性到弱陽性，顯示 B 系標記集中在部分原始細胞上。
features: Gated on blasts; cytoplasmic CD22-APC700 (x-axis) versus cytoplasmic CD79a-APC (y-axis)
Gated subset 'M' (green) with bright cytoplasmic CD79a (about 10^4 to 1.5x10^5)
Remaining blasts (red) cytoplasmic CD79a negative to dim (below 10^4)
Cytoplasmic CD22 negative to dim on both subsets, with only scattered events above 5x10^3
Two separable blast populations defined by CD79a intensity
62712.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis gated on blasts displays cytoplasmic CD22 versus cytoplasmic CD79a. A distinct subset of blasts (gate M, green) shows bright cytoplasmic CD79a, while the remaining blasts (red) are CD79a negative to dim. Cytoplasmic CD22 is negative to dim across the blast population. Bright cCD79a on a subset that also expresses strong CD19 fulfills B-lineage criteria, while the CD79a-negative subset corresponds to the MPO-positive myeloid component; the findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid with bilineal blast populations.

ddx.dx: AML with aberrant cytoplasmic CD79a (e.g., APL, AML with t(8;21))
ddx.vs: CD79a can be expressed in some AML, but without strong CD19 it does not assign B lineage.
cCD79a can be positive in some T-ALL, but blasts express cytoplasmic CD3 and lack CD19.
Blasts typically co-express CD79a and cCD22 uniformly without an MPO-positive CD79a-negative blast subset.

62584.recognize_zh: CD20 免疫染色：瀰漫密集的中至大型腫瘤細胞呈清楚的細胞膜陽性，上方區域可見少數陰性的小血管與間質細胞；證明腫瘤為 B 細胞來源，是濾泡性淋巴瘤基本免疫表型的一部分。
features: Diffuse strong membranous CD20 staining in densely packed tumor cells
Positive cells are medium to large with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Occasional larger positive cells with vesicular nuclei (centroblast-like)
Negative endothelial and stromal cells in the upper field
62584.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 shows strong membranous staining of the densely packed medium to large neoplastic cells, including scattered larger centroblast-like cells, with negative endothelial and stromal cells in the upper portion of the field. The staining confirms a B-cell lineage of the neoplastic population. CD20 alone does not separate follicular lymphoma from other B-cell lymphomas and must be combined with CD10, BCL6, BCL2 and architectural assessment. Findings are consistent with a B-cell lymphoma, in this case follicular lymphoma grade 3a.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is also CD20 positive but lacks follicular architecture and CD21/CD23-positive follicular dendritic cell meshworks.
Reactive follicles are CD20 positive as well but show BCL2-negative germinal centers and preserved polarization.
MCL is CD20 positive but composed of small monotonous cells that are CD5+, cyclin D1+ and CD10 negative.

62520.recognize_zh: 左側為大片淡粉紅、細空泡狀的壞死物質，右側為朝壞死區呈放射狀排列的上皮樣組織球，外緣接纖維組織；壞死與柵欄狀組織球的交界是辨認壞死性肉芽腫的重點。
features: Large area of pale, finely vacuolated necrotic material with scant nuclear debris
Palisading epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated nuclei at the interface
Collagenous fibrous tissue with scattered lymphocytes at the periphery
No giant cells, organisms or atypical cells visible
62520.describe_en: Intermediate-power H&E shows a broad area of pale, finely vacuolated necrotic material with scant nuclear debris, bordered by a zone of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated nuclei arranged radially toward the necrosis. Collagenous fibrous tissue with scattered lymphocytes lies at the periphery. No multinucleated giant cells, atypical cells or organisms are identified on H&E. Findings are consistent with a necrotizing granuloma, as seen in cat scratch disease; special stains and microbiologic studies are needed to exclude mycobacterial and fungal infection.

ddx.vs: Caseating granulomas often have Langhans giant cells and acid-fast organisms, without neutrophilic centers.
GMS or PAS stains reveal yeasts or hyphae within the necrosis or histiocytes.
Kikuchi shows abundant karyorrhexis with crescentic histiocytes and no palisading granuloma or neutrophils.

62456.recognize_zh: 左上方為一顆小淋巴球，染色質緻密、核輪廓略不規則，細胞質極少並有小突起；右下方則是一顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富淡藍且邊緣不規則、貼附紅血球，核橢圓染色質較細，較像反應性大淋巴球或單核球，本圖未見典型腦回狀（cerebriform）核，單憑此圖不足以判定 Sézary 細胞。
features: Upper left: small lymphocyte with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin, slightly irregular nuclear contour, and scant cytoplasm with a small bleb
Lower right: large mononuclear cell with an oval, eccentric nucleus with finer chromatin and no distinct nucleolus
Lower right cell has abundant pale blue cytoplasm with irregular, spreading borders indenting around adjacent red cells
No clearly cerebriform or deeply grooved nuclei in this field
Background red cells largely normocytic; scattered platelets
62456.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small lymphocyte with dense, clumped chromatin, a slightly irregular nuclear outline, and scant cytoplasm, and a separate large mononuclear cell with an oval nucleus and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with irregular borders molding around adjacent red cells. Neither cell shows an unequivocal cerebriform nuclear configuration at this magnification. The large cell has the appearance of a reactive lymphocyte or monocyte, and the small cell may represent a small Sezary-type cell but is not diagnostic by morphology alone. In the context of mycosis fungoides, blood involvement should be established by flow cytometry (CD4:CD8 ratio, CD7 and CD26 loss) and T-cell clonality studies rather than morphology.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have abundant blue cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and a polyclonal T-cell phenotype without CD7/CD26 loss.
Monocytes have grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules or vacuoles and folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, and are CD14 positive.
Sezary cells show cerebriform, grooved nuclei with scant cytoplasm and a CD4+ CD7- CD26- clonal phenotype.
Normal small lymphocytes have round smooth nuclei, and small Sezary cells are separated only by subtle nuclear grooves and flow cytometry.

62392.recognize_zh: CD138 染色下，反應性濾泡的生發中心內與濾泡間區都有成群棕色膜染陽性漿細胞，生發中心內出現漿細胞是 IgG4 相關淋巴結病變的線索之一。
features: Multiple reactive follicles with CD138-negative mantle zones
Increased CD138-positive plasma cells within germinal centers
Clusters and small aggregates of CD138-positive plasma cells in interfollicular areas
Membranous staining pattern in individual small round cells
No sheets of CD138-positive cells effacing the architecture
62392.describe_en: CD138 immunostain on a lymph node shows preserved follicular architecture. Plasma cells are increased and are present both within germinal centers and as clusters in the interfollicular region, with relative sparing of mantle zones. Quantitation with IgG and IgG4 stains and kappa/lambda assessment is needed for classification. Findings are supportive of a plasma-cell-rich reactive process such as IgG4-related lymphadenopathy in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Castleman disease shows sheet-like interfollicular plasmacytosis with atretic follicles and onion-skin mantles, whereas intragerminal-center plasma cells favor IgG4-related disease.

ddx.dx: Nodal involvement by plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: A plasma cell neoplasm forms monotypic sheets that efface nodal architecture and show light-chain restriction by kappa/lambda ISH.
These show follicular hyperplasia with interfollicular plasmacytosis but lack elevated IgG4/IgG ratios; syphilis shows capsular fibrosis, vasculitis, and spirochetes on IHC.

62072.recognize_zh: 低倍下在大量紅血球背景中有一團黏合的細胞群，核呈橢圓至細長、方向大致一致、分布均勻，細胞質淡而邊界不清，邊緣附著血小板，外觀溫和，是抽血帶入的內皮細胞團。
features: Single cohesive, loosely organized cell cluster among abundant red cells at low power
Oval to elongated nuclei with fairly uniform size and even spacing
Pale, indistinct cytoplasm forming a sheath-like syncytial sheet
Platelets adherent along and within the cluster
No marked pleomorphism, nuclear crowding, or molding appreciated at this magnification
62072.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a single cohesive cluster of cells lying among abundant red cells. The cluster consists of evenly spaced oval to elongated nuclei within pale, poorly demarcated cytoplasm in a sheath-like arrangement, with adherent platelets. No significant nuclear pleomorphism, crowding, or molding is appreciated, although cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a cluster of endothelial cells, a benign venipuncture-related contaminant.

ddx.vs: Metastatic clusters show crowded, overlapping, pleomorphic nuclei with high N:C ratio and prominent nucleoli on high power.
Stromal fragments have more spindled nuclei in collagenous matrix, whereas endothelial sheets show oval nuclei in pale cytoplasm with adherent platelets.
Platelet clumps are granular purple masses with occasional lobulated leukocyte nuclei, not a sheet of uniform oval nuclei.

62008.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆巨核細胞，細胞核分成多個彼此分離的圓形核葉（separated nuclear lobes），而非正常相連的分葉核；這種多個分離圓核的巨核細胞是 MDS 巨核細胞發育不良的典型形態。
features: Megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes
Megakaryocyte cytoplasm abundant, pale, with fine granules
Cellular particle with trilineage hematopoiesis
Maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors in background, some granulocytes hypogranular
No increase in blasts evident at this magnification
62008.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with trilineage hematopoiesis. A megakaryocyte displays multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes, a recognized form of dysmegakaryopoiesis. Maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements are present in the background, and blasts are not appreciably increased at this magnification. The findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia, supporting MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia in the referenced case.

ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes have connected, overlapping lobes rather than discrete, widely separated round nuclei.
Osteoclasts have many uniform, separate oval nuclei with single nucleoli and more basophilic, coarsely granular cytoplasm, and lie near bone.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytes post-chemotherapy or in HIV
ddx.vs: Separated-lobe megakaryocytes can occur reactively; persistence with multilineage dysplasia and clonal studies support MDS.

exam.answer_en: Dysmegakaryopoiesis in MDS — megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes
pearls_zh: 考法：指巨核細胞問屬於哪種發育不良：multiple widely separated nuclei；其他典型型態有 micromegakaryocyte 與低分葉/不分葉核。
del(5q) 相關 MDS 的典型為小型單葉或低分葉巨核細胞，與本圖多個分離核不同，常被拿來對比。
巨核細胞發育不良建議至少評估 30 顆巨核細胞，≥10% 異常才計入。
分離核巨核細胞也可見於化療後或 HIV 等反應性狀況，需結合多系發育不良與克隆性證據判斷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）；蝕骨細胞核多、大小一致且各有明顯核仁，細胞質較粗顆粒，巨核細胞核葉大小不一。

quiz.q: 圖中央巨核細胞的核有何異常？代表什麼？
quiz.a: 多個分離的圓形核葉；megakaryocytic dysplasia

61944.recognize_zh: 高倍可見小淋巴球、中型細胞與大型免疫母細胞混雜成連續的大小譜系，並見核分裂像與漿細胞樣細胞，沒有單一形態的腫瘤細胞片狀排列，符合EBV再活化的多形性反應。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate spanning small lymphocytes, intermediate cells and large immunoblasts
Large cells with oval vesicular nuclei and single prominent nucleoli
Scattered plasmacytoid cells and occasional mitotic figures
Interspersed histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and small vessels
No monotonous sheets of atypical large cells
61944.describe_en: High-power view shows a polymorphous lymphoid population ranging from small round lymphocytes to intermediate cells and large immunoblasts with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli. Plasmacytoid cells, histiocytes and occasional mitotic figures are present. The large cells are scattered within the mixed background rather than forming cohesive sheets. Findings are consistent with an EBV-associated reactive immunoblastic proliferation, pending EBER ISH and immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is a monotonous sheet of large B cells with loss of the small-lymphocyte background, unlike this mixed continuum.
PTCL shows atypical small-to-large T cells with nuclear irregularity and aberrant antigen loss, whereas reactive immunoblasts are cytologically bland and B and T cells are both represented.
These show architectural effacement, necrosis and clonality studies demonstrating a monoclonal population, which a self-limited reactive EBV proliferation lacks.

61880.recognize_zh: 視野中央只有一個中大型淋巴樣細胞，核圓至略有凹陷、染色質較疏鬆、胞質量中等淡藍；但核仁在此解析度下不明顯，且背景紅血球普遍皺縮成棘狀並有染劑沉澱，單一細胞不足以確認前淋巴細胞（prolymphocyte）。
features: Single medium-to-large lymphoid cell with a round to slightly indented nucleus
Moderately condensed but relatively open chromatin; a prominent central nucleolus is not clearly resolved
Moderate rim of pale grey-blue agranular cytoplasm
Diffuse crenated red cells (echinocytes) consistent with drying or storage artifact
Scattered blue stain precipitate and small platelets in the background
61880.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single medium-to-large lymphoid cell with a round to slightly indented nucleus, relatively open chromatin and a moderate rim of pale basophilic, agranular cytoplasm. A single prominent nucleolus, the hallmark of a prolymphocyte, is not clearly resolved at this resolution. The background red cells show widespread crenation consistent with drying or delayed-processing artifact, and there is blue stain precipitate. A single cell cannot establish a monomorphic prolymphocytic population; the morphology is only partially consistent with a circulating prolymphocyte, and correlation with the full smear, lymphocyte count and flow cytometry is required.

ddx.vs: CLL has predominantly small lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and smudge cells, with prolymphocytes forming a minority and a CD5+/CD23+ phenotype.
T-PLL cells are small to medium with cytoplasmic blebs and a less conspicuous nucleolus and express CD7, CD4 and TCL1 with inv(14)/t(14;14).
MCL cells often have irregular nuclear contours and are CD5 positive with cyclin D1/SOX11 and t(11;14).
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm hugging adjacent red cells, rather than a monomorphic population with central nucleoli.

61816.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片可見多顆顆粒稀少（hypogranular）的嗜中性球，其中數顆為雙葉、核葉以細橋相連的假 Pelger-Huët 型，另有大型未成熟單核球系／母細胞樣細胞，呈現顆粒球系發育不良。
features: Hypogranular neutrophils and bands with pale grey-pink cytoplasm
Bilobed pseudo-Pelger-Huet nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin
Large immature cells with fine chromatin, nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm (blasts/promonocytes)
Myelocyte-like cells with eccentric round nuclei and grey cytoplasm lacking normal granulation
Small lymphocyte and scattered red cells; platelet-poor background
61816.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows granulocytic precursors and neutrophils with markedly reduced cytoplasmic granulation and abnormal nuclear segmentation, including bilobed pseudo-Pelger-Huet forms. Admixed are several large immature cells with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, representing blasts or promonocytes. Dysgranulopoiesis is evident, and blast percentage should be determined on a 500-cell differential. Findings are consistent with a myelodysplastic/myeloid neoplasm in the setting of germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Congenital Pelger cells are normally granulated and uniformly affect nearly all neutrophils without blasts or cytopenias.
Drug-related changes lack increased blasts and clonal abnormalities and resolve after withdrawal.
