ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes
ddx.vs: Requires at least 20% blasts on a formal count, which cannot be established from this single field.

61752.recognize_zh: 低倍脾臟 H&E 下，藍色的淋巴細胞浸潤瀰漫散布於充血的紅髓中，並圍繞中央一條粉紅色纖維小樑或血管，未見正常清楚的白髓濾泡；脾臟邊緣區淋巴瘤可呈這種白髓擴張合併紅髓浸潤的樣式，但此倍率無法評估細胞細節。
features: Low-power splenic section with a mottled pattern of blue lymphoid cells and red blood cell-rich areas
Lymphoid infiltrate diffusely involves the red pulp cords and sinuses rather than being confined to white pulp
Vague, poorly delineated nodular lymphoid areas without identifiable germinal centers or mantle zones
Central pink fibrous trabecula/vessel surrounded by lymphoid cells
Cytologic detail (cell size, marginal zone pale cytoplasm) is not assessable at this magnification
61752.describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows a diffuse lymphoid infiltrate permeating the congested red pulp, with vague nodular aggregates and a central fibrous trabecula. Normal white pulp architecture with distinct germinal centers and mantle zones is not recognizable in this field. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification. In combination with the monotypic plasmacytic component and immunostains in this case, the pattern is consistent with splenic marginal zone lymphoma with red pulp involvement.

ddx.vs: Diffusely infiltrates red pulp forming blood lakes while effacing white pulp, with cells having abundant clear cytoplasm and CD103/CD25/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positivity.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Involves red pulp diffusely without white pulp nodularity and lacks the biphasic marginal zone pattern.
Shows white pulp expansion with proliferation centers and CD5/CD23/LEF1 positivity.
Retains well-formed white pulp follicles with germinal centers and polytypic B cells without diffuse red pulp lymphoid infiltration.

61688.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（CD5 對 CD7，淋巴球閘門），非形態影像；主要藍色族群同時表現 CD5 與強 CD7（約 10^2），與另一群 CD5 較弱、CD7 較弱的洋紅色族群分開，符合 T-PLL 的 CD7 強表現。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD5-PB (x-axis) versus CD7-APC700 (y-axis), gated on [Lymphs]
Dominant blue population with uniform CD5 (about 10^1) and bright CD7 (about 10^1.5 to 10^2) forming a compact cluster
Separate magenta population with dimmer CD5 and dimmer, more heterogeneous CD7
Scattered red events within and below the blue cluster
Small green CD5-negative, CD7-negative population near the origin
61688.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the lymphocyte gate displays CD5 versus CD7 expression. The predominant population (blue) is tightly clustered and co-expresses CD5 with bright CD7, whereas a smaller magenta population shows dimmer and more heterogeneous CD5 and CD7, and a green population is double-negative. The colour legend is not shown, so population assignments are inferred from their relative size and uniformity. Retention of CD5 and bright CD7 on the dominant expanded population is characteristic of T-prolymphocytic leukemia.

61624.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見多個大型、染色質呈細顆粒至點狀的紅血球前驅細胞（原紅血球與嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞）與部分核型不規則的成熟細胞，提示紅血球系增生；但環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts）需鐵染色才能確認，本圖 Wright 染色無法直接看到。
features: Increased erythroid precursors including large pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts
Erythroid nuclei with finely stippled, somewhat open (megaloblastoid) chromatin
Deeply basophilic to gray-blue cytoplasm; occasional vacuoles and irregular nuclear outlines
Scattered maturing granulocytes, including a band neutrophil
Background with smeared/crushed cells; ring sideroblasts not assessable without iron stain
61624.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased erythroid precursors, including large pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts with finely stippled, somewhat megaloblastoid chromatin, admixed with maturing granulocytic elements. Mild nuclear irregularity is seen, but definitive dysplasia is limited in this field and many cells are smeared. Blasts are not increased. Ring sideroblasts cannot be evaluated on a Romanowsky stain; correlation with a Prussian blue iron stain (≥15% ring sideroblasts, or ≥5% with SF3B1 mutation) is required to support MDS with ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: B12/folate deficiency gives nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and lacks ring sideroblasts; serum levels distinguish.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows ≥80% erythroid cells with ≥30% pronormoblasts, far exceeding the mixed erythroid and granulocytic population here.
Morphology overlaps; ALAS2 mutation, copper/zinc levels, and clinical history are needed to separate from clonal MDS-RS.

61496.recognize_zh: 背景中散布許多大小不一、圓形、淡藍灰色且無顆粒、邊緣平滑的細胞質碎片（淋巴腺小體，lymphoglandular bodies），旁邊為中型淋巴樣細胞，與血小板相比顏色較淡、無紫紅色顆粒，提示淋巴細胞性病變侵犯骨髓。
features: Numerous small round pale blue-gray agranular cytoplasmic fragments with smooth borders and variable size in the background
Fragments lack the purple granular centers of platelets, allowing distinction from platelets
Cluster of lymphoid cells, mostly small-to-intermediate with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Occasional larger cells with more open chromatin and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Thick aspirate background with red cells; one segmented/band granulocyte present
61496.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a group of lymphoid cells, predominantly small to intermediate in size with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with occasional larger cells with more open chromatin. The background contains numerous round, pale blue-gray, agranular cytoplasmic fragments of variable size with smooth contours, consistent with lymphoglandular bodies; these are distinguished from platelets by their lack of azurophilic granules and paler color. Lymphoglandular bodies are nonspecific but indicate a lymphoid population and are more frequent in marrows involved by B-cell lymphoma. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by a lymphoproliferative disorder; flow cytometry and biopsy correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelets contain central purple azurophilic granules (granulomere) and are more uniform in size, while lymphoglandular bodies are pale, agranular and variable.
Smudge cells are disrupted nuclear material with purple chromatin strands, not smooth-bordered blue cytoplasmic globules.
ALL may also shed cytoplasmic fragments but its cells are blasts with fine chromatin and high N:C ratio, unlike the mostly mature-appearing lymphocytes here; flow cytometry confirms.

61432.recognize_zh: 穿刺切片（A、B）可見大型異型淋巴細胞瀰漫性片狀浸潤、核多形且深染；C–F 為瀰漫強陽性的膜/胞質染色、G–I 為核染色，符合免疫表型組合圖中的瀰漫性大B細胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）。面板未標註抗體名稱，無法從圖中指認哪一格是 CD31。
features: Core biopsy with diffuse, sheet-like effacement by atypical lymphoid cells (A, x100)
Large cells with pleomorphic, hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei and scant to moderate cytoplasm; scattered crush artifact (B, x400)
Panels C-F: diffuse, strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining in nearly all tumor cells, sparing vessels
Panels G-I: nuclear stains of variable intensity and extent (G weak-moderate, H strong in many cells, I patchy)
Antibody names are not labeled on the panels, so specific markers (including CD31) cannot be assigned from the image
61432.describe_en: Needle core biopsy shows diffuse effacement by sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with pleomorphic, hyperchromatic nuclei (A, B). Immunohistochemistry panels show diffuse strong membranous/cytoplasmic reactivity in the tumor cells (C-F) and nuclear staining of variable extent (G-I); the individual antibodies are not labeled in this figure. Per the provided history, the tumor shows strong aberrant CD31 expression with an activated B-cell (non-germinal center) profile. Findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, with aberrant CD31 expression.

ddx.vs: CD31 positivity may suggest a vascular neoplasm, but the discohesive lymphoid sheets with CD20/PAX5 and CD45 expression and absence of ERG/vasoformative channels support lymphoma.
ALCL shows hallmark cells with uniform strong CD30 and loss of B-cell antigens, whereas DLBCL expresses CD20/PAX5.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests and is keratin-positive and CD45/CD20-negative.
Myeloid sarcoma consists of blasts with fine chromatin expressing MPO, CD117 or lysozyme rather than B-cell markers.

61368.recognize_zh: CD34 免疫染色把竇狀血管內皮勾勒成棕色細線，可見巨核細胞與造血細胞團位於擴張的竇狀血管腔內（intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis），間質中另有散在的 CD34 陽性小型母細胞。
features: CD34 highlights sinusoidal endothelium outlining dilated, branching sinusoids
Megakaryocytes and clusters of hematopoietic cells located within sinusoidal lumens
Scattered small CD34-positive mononuclear cells (blasts) in the interstitium, some in small clusters
Megakaryocytes themselves CD34-negative with hyperchromatic nuclei
Cellular marrow with interspersed adipocytes
61368.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights prominent, dilated sinusoids lined by CD34-positive endothelium. Megakaryocytes and small groups of hematopoietic precursors are present within the sinusoidal lumens, consistent with intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis. Scattered CD34-positive blasts are increased in the interstitium, including small clusters. These findings are typical of fibrotic-phase myeloproliferative neoplasm and warrant blast quantification and reticulin assessment to evaluate for disease progression.

ddx.dx: Extramedullary hematopoiesis in liver or spleen
ddx.vs: Intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis in EMH occurs within spleen or liver sinusoids rather than in a bone marrow biopsy with bony trabeculae and adipocytes.
Blast phase is defined by CD34-positive blasts reaching 10-19% or ≥20% with sheets or large clusters, beyond the scattered blasts seen here.
Autoimmune myelofibrosis also shows intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis but lacks atypical clustered megakaryocytes and driver mutations and shows lymphoid aggregates.

61240.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆比周圍細胞大的雙核細胞，兩個圓形細胞核互相對稱、染色質細緻，細胞質淡藍而豐富，形成類似「鷹眼」的雙核形態，符合 Reed-Sternberg 細胞，但本圖解析度下核仁不明顯。
features: Central binucleate large cell, roughly 2-3 times the diameter of adjacent lymphocytes
Two round, mirror-image nuclei with finely granular chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved at this resolution
Moderate to abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Background of mixed marrow cells including lymphocytes, plasma cells, granulocytic precursors and segmented neutrophils
Crowded, distorted red cells indicating a thick aspirate area
61240.describe_en: Wright-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large binucleate cell with two symmetric, round nuclei with fine chromatin and moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm, set in a mixed background of lymphocytes, plasma cells and maturing granulocytes. The prominent inclusion-like nucleoli typical of Reed-Sternberg cells are not clearly discernible at this image resolution. The appearance is suggestive of a Reed-Sternberg-type cell in classical Hodgkin lymphoma involving marrow, but aspirate findings alone are not diagnostic; trephine biopsy with CD30, CD15 and PAX5 (weak) immunohistochemistry is required.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated nucleus with granular pink cytoplasm and demarcation membranes rather than two discrete nuclei with large nucleoli.

ddx.dx: Binucleate plasma cell or erythroid precursor
ddx.vs: These have smaller size, clock-face or condensed chromatin, a perinuclear hof or deep blue cytoplasm, and lack macronucleoli.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or metastatic tumor
ddx.vs: ALCL shows horseshoe 'hallmark' nuclei and sheets of CD30+/ALK+ cells without a reactive milieu, and carcinoma forms cohesive clusters.

61176.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑（下方粉紅色）旁的骨髓腔被大型腫瘤細胞取代，細胞核呈泡狀、核仁明顯，細胞質豐富偏嗜酸性，背景是淡粉紅色纖維網狀的神經氈（neuropil），提示神經分化，符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤（neuroblastoma）。
features: Marrow space adjacent to a bony trabecula replaced by a tumor infiltrate with loss of normal hematopoiesis
Large pleomorphic tumor cells with round vesicular nuclei and conspicuous, often single, nucleoli
Moderate to abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm; some cells polygonal and ganglion-like
Pale eosinophilic fibrillary background matrix consistent with neuropil
Scattered mitotic figures and occasional bizarre nuclei
No Homer Wright rosettes identified in this field
61176.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows marrow spaces adjacent to a bony trabecula replaced by a metastatic tumor with effacement of normal hematopoietic elements. The tumor cells are large, with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and moderate to abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, set within a pale fibrillary neuropil-like background. Mitotic figures are present; Homer Wright rosettes are not identified. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma with differentiating features; confirmation with PHOX2B, synaptophysin, or chromogranin immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Rhabdomyoblasts have dense eosinophilic cytoplasm with cross-striations and no fibrillary neuropil, and are desmin/myogenin positive.
Ewing sarcoma consists of uniform small round cells with scant clear cytoplasm lacking neuropil and ganglionic differentiation, and is CD99/NKX2.2 positive.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with desmoplastic stroma rather than neuropil and is cytokeratin positive.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia or megakaryocytic hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and are CD61/CD42b positive, without fibrillary neuropil.

61112.recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血中的淋巴球體積稍大、核質比高、染色質較細，核有明顯凹陷或裂溝（clefted nuclei），胞質少而淡藍、無顆粒，看似母細胞但仍保有些許染色質凝集且無核仁，屬嬰幼兒正常淋巴球變異。
features: Small to intermediate lymphocytes with high N:C ratio and a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Nuclear clefts, indentations and lobulated (cloverleaf-like) contours
Relatively fine but still slightly coarse, stippled chromatin without a smooth blastic texture
No distinct nucleoli
Background red cells unremarkable; no accompanying immature myeloid cells in these fields
61112.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from a newborn shows lymphocytes of small to intermediate size with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm, and nuclei with prominent clefts and indentations. The chromatin is somewhat finer than in adult lymphocytes but retains slight condensation, and nucleoli are not evident. No blasts with open chromatin and prominent nucleoli are seen in these fields. In the context of normal platelet counts, these features are consistent with physiologic neonatal lymphocyte morphology rather than acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have finely dispersed homogeneous chromatin, often visible nucleoli and are accompanied by cytopenias, whereas neonatal lymphocytes retain some chromatin clumping in a child with normal counts; flow cytometry resolves doubt.
FL cells show deep narrow nuclear clefts with dense mature chromatin in adults with lymphocytosis, and neonatal clefted lymphocytes occur in a completely different clinical setting.
Pertussis produces an absolute lymphocytosis of small mature lymphocytes with cleaved nuclei and dense chromatin, whereas physiologic neonatal lymphocytes appear without marked lymphocytosis.
ATLL cells show deeply polylobated flower-shaped nuclei with condensed chromatin in HTLV-1-positive adults.

61048.recognize_zh: 此視野只見紅血球背景中一個疊在紅血球上、帶深紫色點狀構造的小體，以及一顆深藍小圓體；沒有看到充滿無鞭毛體（amastigotes）的巨噬細胞，也難以確認核與動基體（kinetoplast），僅能部分支持利什曼原蟲。
features: Field dominated by red cells with rouleaux-like overlapping at the edges
One small oval body overlying a red cell with a dense purple dot, possibly a single extracellular amastigote but nucleus and kinetoplast not clearly resolved
A separate small, uniformly dark blue round body (possibly a small nucleus fragment or platelet)
No macrophages or clusters of intracellular organisms in this field
Few scattered tiny purple dots in the background
61048.describe_en: Smear field composed mainly of red cells with scattered small debris. A single small oval body overlying a red cell contains a dense purple chromatin dot and could represent a free amastigote, but a distinct nucleus plus rod-shaped kinetoplast cannot be resolved at this magnification. No macrophages containing organisms are seen in this particular field. Therefore the image only partially supports the stated diagnosis of leishmaniasis; examination of histiocyte-rich areas for clusters of amastigotes with a nucleus and kinetoplast, or PCR/culture, is needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Platelets are granular without an organized nucleus and bar-like kinetoplast, which define an amastigote.
Histoplasma yeasts are intracellular with a clear halo and a crescent nucleus but no kinetoplast.
These parasites are inside red cells as ring forms with blue cytoplasm, rather than free oval bodies with a kinetoplast.

60984.recognize_zh: 三色染色（trichrome）下骨小樑呈藍色，小樑間髓腔內也可見藍色膠原纖維束穿行，造血細胞稀少、只剩散在紅色細胞與脂肪空泡，代表成熟膠原沉積的晚期骨髓纖維化（collagen grade ≥2）。
features: Bony trabeculae stain blue, irregular and somewhat thickened
Intertrabecular spaces contain wavy blue collagen fibers forming streaming bundles and a loose meshwork
Sparse hematopoietic elements (red-staining cells) and scattered fat vacuoles; overall hypocellular
Streaming, fibrotic architecture without recognizable normal marrow organization
60984.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy stained with Masson trichrome shows irregular blue-staining trabeculae and intertrabecular marrow replaced by a loose to streaming meshwork of blue collagen fibers. Hematopoietic elements are sparse, appearing as scattered red-staining cells among adipocytes. The presence of trichrome-positive mature collagen indicates advanced fibrosis (collagen grade 2 or higher in the WHO/ESMO scheme), consistent with long-standing, fibrotic-stage myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Early fibrosis is highlighted by reticulin stain but shows no blue collagen on trichrome, unlike this case.
Collagenous stroma would surround cohesive keratin-positive tumor nests, which are not seen here.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or systemic mastocytosis with fibrosis
ddx.vs: These show an interstitial neoplastic infiltrate (CD20/annexin A1 or CD117/tryptase-positive) within the fibrosis rather than hypocellular collagenous stroma.
Morphologically similar; distinguished by treatment history and absence of an MPN driver mutation.

exam.answer_en: Advanced myelofibrosis on Masson trichrome — blue mature collagen bundles streaming through a hypocellular intertrabecular marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指髓腔內藍色波浪狀纖維問「這個染色看到的是什麼」→ trichrome 顯示成熟 type I collagen（藍/綠色），代表晚期、較難逆轉的纖維化。
Reticulin（銀染）顯示 type III reticulin 纖維，對早期纖維化敏感；trichrome 陽性的 collagen 出現在較高等級（MF-3 的定義包含粗大 collagen 束）。
判讀原則：只評估造血區，勿把骨小樑旁或血管周圍原本就有的 collagen 算進去；WHO 建議可另外報告 collagen grade 與 osteosclerosis grade。
意義：collagen 纖維化與較差預後、dry tap 相關；在 JAK inhibitor 或移植後可追蹤纖維化程度變化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把正常骨小樑與血管壁的藍染誤判為髓腔 collagen 纖維化；也要注意轉移性癌的促纖維反應，需找 keratin 陽性腫瘤細胞巢排除。

quiz.q: 此 trichrome 染色中髓腔內的藍色纖維代表什麼成分？與 reticulin 染色相比，它代表較早期還是較晚期的纖維化？
quiz.a: 成熟 collagen（type I）；較晚期的纖維化

60920.recognize_zh: 大型單核芽細胞核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍，細胞質內含單一顆大型、圓形、粉紅色（嗜天青性）的包涵體，有時周圍有透明暈（箭頭），即急性單核芽球白血病中的假 Chediak-Higashi 巨大顆粒。
features: Large blasts with round to folded nuclei, fine lacy chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm, consistent with monoblasts
Single large, round, pink-to-orange (azurophilic) cytoplasmic inclusion in many blasts (arrows)
Some inclusions surrounded by a clear halo or appearing vacuolated
Low-power field with increased circulating blasts among red cells; occasional neutrophil
60920.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased circulating large blasts with round to folded nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm consistent with monoblasts. Many blasts contain a single large, round, pink-orange azurophilic cytoplasmic inclusion, some surrounded by a clear halo. Residual neutrophils do not contain giant granules. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia with pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules; the inclusions represent abnormal fused primary granules and should be confirmed with cytochemistry (nonspecific esterase, MPO) and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: The inherited disorder shows giant granules in all mature granulocytes, monocytes and lymphocytes with albinism and infections, rather than inclusions confined to leukemic blasts.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei and heavy fine granules or bundles of Auer rods rather than a single large round inclusion, and are strongly MPO positive.

ddx.dx: Auer rods in AML with maturation
ddx.vs: Auer rods are slender, needle-shaped crystalline rods rather than large round globules.
Engulfed red cells or debris sit in a vacuole with RBC-like size and staining, whereas pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules are MPO/esterase-reactive granule aggregates.

60856.recognize_zh: 放大後的痰液抹片可見一條 S 形彎曲、身體均勻細長、尾端漸細的線蟲幼蟲，體內可見細顆粒狀內部構造，位於淡藍色黏液團中；痰液中出現此種幼蟲符合糞小桿線蟲（Strongyloides stercoralis）的播散性感染。
features: Single S-shaped nematode larva with uniform slender body, rounded anterior end and tapering posterior end
Purple-staining body with granular internal cellular structure and visible cuticle outline
Larva embedded in a pale blue mucoid/fibrinous aggregate
Sparse background inflammatory cells
Tail tip morphology (notched vs pointed) and esophageal length not definitively resolvable
60856.describe_en: Higher-magnification view of a sputum cytology preparation shows an S-shaped nematode larva with a slender, uniform body, rounded anterior end, tapering posterior end and granular internal structure, lying within a pale mucoid aggregate. The background contains sparse inflammatory cells. Fine anatomic features used for speciation, such as the notched tail of filariform larvae or the short buccal cavity of rhabditiform larvae, are not clearly resolved in this image. Findings are consistent with Strongyloides stercoralis larva in sputum, indicating pulmonary involvement and possible hyperinfection syndrome.

ddx.vs: Filariform hookworm larvae have a pointed tail and rhabditiform larvae a long buccal cavity, whereas Strongyloides filariform larvae have a notched tail and rhabditiform larvae a short buccal cavity with prominent genital primordium.
Microfilariae are narrower, often sheathed, and show a column of discrete nuclei with species-specific tail nuclei, typically in blood rather than sputum.
Ascaris larvae are larger and occur only during early pulmonary migration, often with marked eosinophilia and Löffler syndrome.

exam.answer_en: Strongyloides stercoralis larva in sputum — S-shaped slender nematode larva with tapering tail, consistent with hyperinfection
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍圖，考官指蟲體問「辨識哪些構造可分辨 Strongyloides 與 hookworm？」→ rhabditiform 看 buccal cavity 長短與 genital primordium，filariform 看尾端是否 notched。
Strongyloides rhabditiform 幼蟲：buccal cavity 短、genital primordium 明顯；hookworm 則 buccal cavity 長。糞便中通常見到的是 rhabditiform 幼蟲（hookworm 多為蟲卵）。
HTLV-1 共同感染是 hyperinfection 的重要危險因子；台灣為 HTLV-1 盛行區之一，免疫抑制前應留意。
Hyperinfection 時要同時處理可能的 Gram-negative 敗血症，並儘可能減少免疫抑制劑；治療藥物為 ivermectin。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 microfilaria：microfilaria 更細、常有鞘、體內可見一列分離細胞核且多見於血液；本圖為痰液中較粗的 S 形幼蟲，符合 Strongyloides。

quiz.q: 圖中痰液幼蟲若為 filariform larva，哪個尾端特徵支持 Strongyloides 而非 hookworm？
quiz.a: 尾端有缺口（notched tail）；hookworm 絲狀幼蟲尾端尖

60792.recognize_zh: A 格積液細胞學為大型免疫母細胞／漿母細胞樣細胞，核仁明顯、胞質深藍，B 格 HHV-8（LANA）核點狀陽性支持原發性滲出性淋巴瘤；同一病人小腿皮膚紫色斑塊（C、D）、切片梭形細胞增生（E）與 HHV-8 陽性（F）為卡波西肉瘤。
features: Panel A: effusion cytology with large pleomorphic immunoblastic/plasmablastic cells, prominent nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Panel B: nuclear stippled HHV-8 (LANA) immunostaining in lymphoma cells (labeled PEL)
Panels C-D: clinical photographs of the lower leg with progressive violaceous plaques and hyperpigmented, edematous skin
Panel E: fascicles of spindle cells with slit-like vascular spaces and extravasated red cells (Kaposi sarcoma)
Panel F: nuclear HHV-8 staining in the spindle cells (labeled KS)
Panel G: low-power H&E section of a thick-walled tubular structure surrounded by a cellular infiltrate (arrowheads); specific detail is limited at this magnification
60792.describe_en: Composite figure from a patient with two HHV-8-associated neoplasms. Effusion cytology (A) shows large pleomorphic lymphoid cells with immunoblastic to plasmablastic features, and these cells show nuclear HHV-8 LANA positivity (B), consistent with primary effusion lymphoma. Clinical photographs (C, D) show progressive violaceous lesions of the lower leg, and biopsy (E) reveals a spindle-cell proliferation with slit-like vascular channels that is HHV-8 positive (F), consistent with Kaposi sarcoma. The low-power section (G) shows a thick-walled tubular structure with a surrounding cellular infiltrate marked by arrowheads, whose precise nature cannot be determined from this image alone. Findings are consistent with primary effusion lymphoma with concurrent progressive Kaposi sarcoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with effusion (secondary)
ddx.vs: Cells are CD20/PAX5 positive and HHV-8 negative, and usually a solid mass is present.
Morphology and CD138/MUM1 phenotype overlap, but it is HHV-8 negative (usually EBV+) and forms solid masses.

ddx.dx: HHV-8 positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Arises from HHV-8+ multicentric Castleman disease as solid nodal disease with IgM lambda expression and is typically EBV negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or mesothelioma in effusion
ddx.vs: Forms cohesive clusters and is cytokeratin/calretinin positive and HHV-8 negative.

60792.stain: Wright-Giemsa; IHC: HHV-8 LANA; H&E; clinical photo

60600.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片骨小樑旁有一群中等大小、核卵圓、染色質細緻、細胞質淡嗜酸的細胞結節；免疫染色 CD123 強陽性、CD4 弱陽、CD68 散在，流式顯示 CD123 亮陽、CD4+ CD56− CD34− 的族群，為 CMML 相關的成熟漿細胞樣樹突細胞增生。
features: Hypercellular marrow biopsy with a dense paratrabecular/interstitial nodule of monotonous cells
Medium-sized cells with oval to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Peripheral blood inset: monocytes and monocytoid cells (arrows) consistent with CMML
IHC: nodule CD45+, CD123 strongly positive, CD4 weak, CD68 scattered positive
Flow cytometry: CD123-bright, low-SSC population that is CD4+, CD56-negative, CD34-negative and CD117-negative
60600.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular and contains a discrete nodular aggregate of medium-sized cells with oval nuclei, fine chromatin and pale cytoplasm adjacent to bony trabeculae; the peripheral blood shows monocytosis. Immunohistochemistry shows that the nodule is CD45 and strongly CD123 positive, with weak CD4 and only scattered CD68 staining. Flow cytometry of blood identifies a CD123-bright, low side-scatter population that is CD4 positive and negative for CD56, CD34 and CD117. Findings are consistent with nodular proliferation of mature plasmacytoid dendritic cells in chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: BPDCN cells are blastic and CD56-positive with TCL1 and TdT variable expression and skin involvement, whereas these mature pDCs are CD56-negative.
AML blasts express CD34/CD117 or MPO and lysozyme with high proliferation, which are absent in this CD34-/CD117- CD123-bright nodule.
Benign lymphoid aggregates are composed of small round CD3/CD20-positive lymphocytes rather than CD123-bright cells with oval nuclei and pale cytoplasm.
Mast cell aggregates are spindled, tryptase and CD117 positive with CD25 aberrancy, not CD123-bright.

60600.stain: H&E; Wright-Giemsa; IHC: CD45, CD4, CD68, CD123; flow

60664.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片骨小樑旁的纖維間質中（圓圈）可見一群卵圓形寄生蟲卵，具有折光性的厚卵殼，內含嗜鹼性顆粒狀的毛蚴（miracidium），周圍少量發炎反應，符合血吸蟲卵（Schistosoma eggs）。
features: Low power (A): bone trabecula with adjacent fibrous marrow stroma containing a focal cluster of ova (circled)
High power (B): four to five oval eggs, roughly 100-150 µm long, each with a thin, refractile, eosinophilic shell
Egg contents with basophilic granular/cellular material consistent with developing miracidia
Surrounding fibrous stroma with scattered spindle cells and minimal inflammation; no well-formed granuloma or calcification visible in this field
A lateral or terminal spine is not clearly identified in these sections
60664.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a bone trabecula with adjacent fibrotic, hypocellular stroma in which a cluster of parasitic ova is present (panel A). At higher magnification (panel B), the ova are oval with thin refractile eosinophilic shells enclosing basophilic granular miracidia, surrounded by fibrous tissue with only a mild inflammatory reaction. A diagnostic spine is not appreciated in this plane of section, so species assignment is not possible on morphology alone. Findings are consistent with schistosomal eggs deposited in the bone marrow; correlation with travel history, serology, and stool/urine examination is recommended.

ddx.vs: Paragonimus eggs are operculated with a thickened abopercular shell and are brown, whereas schistosome eggs lack an operculum and carry a lateral or terminal spine.
Coccidioides spherules are thick-walled round structures filled with small uniform endospores, not oval eggs containing a multicellular miracidium.
Fungal sporangia are round with numerous small spores and are GMS/PAS positive, lacking the ciliated larval structure of a miracidium.
Degenerated debris lacks a uniform oval shell with internal nucleated larval content and does not occur as a cluster of identical ova.

60728.recognize_zh: 周邊血可見香蕉形（新月形）配子體（箭頭頭）、大量細小環狀體，且同一紅血球內含多個環狀體（大箭頭）及貼附紅血球邊緣的 appliqué 型（小箭頭），受感染紅血球大小正常，為惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）的典型表現。
features: Crescent/banana-shaped gametocyte with blunt ends and central pigment (A, arrowhead)
Numerous small, delicate ring forms with thin cytoplasm and one or two chromatin dots
Multiply infected red cells containing two or more rings (B, large arrow)
Appliqué (accolé) forms at the red cell margin (B, small arrow)
Infected red cells normal in size without Schüffner stippling; no mature trophozoites or schizonts seen; scattered echinocytes
60728.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows a high density of intraerythrocytic parasites composed predominantly of small delicate ring forms, many red cells harboring multiple rings and several appliqué forms at the cell periphery. A characteristic crescent-shaped gametocyte is identified. Infected red cells are not enlarged and lack stippling, and no late trophozoites or schizonts are seen. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria; parasitemia should be quantified urgently as it guides severity assessment and treatment.

ddx.vs: These infect enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots, show amoeboid trophozoites and schizonts in blood, and have round rather than crescent gametocytes.
Although rings can resemble P. falciparum, they show band-form trophozoites and schizonts in blood and lack banana-shaped gametocytes.
Babesia forms pleomorphic rings and Maltese cross tetrads without pigment, gametocytes or schizonts, often after tick exposure or splenectomy.

ddx.dx: Platelets overlying red cells or stain artifact
ddx.vs: Superimposed platelets have a halo, granular purple texture and lie in a different plane, lacking the ring cytoplasm with a discrete chromatin dot.

captions: Banana-shaped P. falciparum gametocyte (arrowhead) with scattered ring forms
Multiple rings within single red cells (large arrow) and appliqué form (small arrow)

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum malaria — high parasitemia of delicate rings with multiply infected, non-enlarged RBCs, appliqué forms and a crescent gametocyte
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指香蕉/新月形的 gametocyte，或單一紅血球內多個 ring，問「哪一種瘧原蟲？」→ P. falciparum。
判讀：thick smear 偵測敏感度高，thin smear 用來判定種別與計算 parasitemia；初次陰性但臨床懷疑時應每 12–24 小時重複抹片。
P. falciparum 周邊血通常只見 ring 與 gametocyte，因成熟期寄生紅血球黏附於微血管（sequestration）；看到大量 schizont 表示病況嚴重。
急症：重症瘧疾（意識改變、高 parasitemia、嚴重貧血、腎衰竭、酸中毒等）首選 IV artesunate；parasitemia 需每日追蹤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 Babesia 混淆：Babesia 可見四聯體 Maltese cross、紅血球外寄生體，無 gametocyte 與色素；falciparum 有新月形 gametocyte 且有疫區旅遊史。

quiz.q: 圖中新月形的寄生蟲期別是什麼？它指向哪一種瘧原蟲？
quiz.a: Gametocyte；Plasmodium falciparum

60536.recognize_zh: 四格 H&E：低倍可見腸壁全層被淋巴瘤浸潤並有表面潰瘍（箭頭），高倍中大型多形性淋巴細胞穿插於平滑肌纖維之間；右下格鄰近黏膜上皮內有大量上皮內淋巴球（箭頭），代表背景腸病變，符合 EATL。
features: Low power: transmural, mass-forming lymphoid infiltrate of the bowel wall with mucosal ulceration (arrow)
Medium power: sheets of tumor cells dissecting and splaying bundles of muscularis propria
High power: medium-to-large pleomorphic lymphoid cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei, distinct nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm infiltrating between smooth muscle fibers
Admixed inflammatory cells in the infiltrate
Adjacent mucosa: increased intraepithelial lymphocytes within surface columnar epithelium (arrow), indicating enteropathy
60536.describe_en: Sections of small intestine show a transmural lymphoid infiltrate forming a mass with overlying mucosal ulceration. The infiltrate is composed of sheets of medium-to-large pleomorphic lymphoid cells with irregular vesicular nuclei, conspicuous nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm that dissect through and separate smooth muscle bundles of the muscularis propria, accompanied by admixed inflammatory cells. The adjacent mucosa shows increased intraepithelial lymphocytes within the surface epithelium. Findings are consistent with enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma (classic type, formerly type I), to be confirmed by T-cell immunophenotyping (CD3+, CD4-/CD8-, CD56-, often CD30+).

ddx.vs: MEITL shows monotonous small-to-medium round cells with marked epitheliotropism and a CD8+/CD56+ phenotype, not large pleomorphic cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the intestine
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are CD20+/PAX5+ B cells and lack an adjacent T-cell intraepithelial lymphocytosis.
Carcinoma is cohesive and cytokeratin positive, whereas this discohesive infiltrate is CD45/CD3 positive.
ENKTL shows angiocentric destruction with necrosis and is EBER-positive and CD56-positive.

60472.recognize_zh: BCL2 免疫染色下，幾乎所有中至大型腫瘤細胞都呈強烈細胞質與核周陽性，只剩少數血管內皮與間質細胞陰性；腫瘤性生發中心細胞表現 BCL2 是與反應性濾泡（BCL2 陰性）區分的關鍵。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium to large cells with strong cytoplasmic BCL2 staining
Perinuclear and granular cytoplasmic pattern outlining round to irregular nuclei
Nearly all tumor cells positive with uniform intensity
Negative endothelial cells lining small vessels and a few stromal cells
Follicle boundaries not discernible in this field
60472.describe_en: BCL2 immunohistochemical stain shows strong, uniform cytoplasmic positivity in nearly all medium to large neoplastic cells, with only endothelial and stromal cells negative. Follicle boundaries are not discernible at this magnification. Aberrant BCL2 expression in germinal center-type B cells distinguishes neoplastic from reactive follicles and, together with CD10/BCL6 positivity and sheets of centroblasts, is consistent with follicular lymphoma, grade 3B.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal center B cells are BCL2-negative, with BCL2 staining limited to mantle zone B cells and T cells.
Burkitt lymphoma is characteristically BCL2-negative or weak, with a starry-sky pattern and near 100% Ki-67.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC/BCL2 can look similar and is BCL2+, requiring FISH for MYC to separate it.

ddx.dx: Small T-cell infiltrate masking BCL2 status
ddx.vs: BCL2 is expressed by normal T cells, so correlation with CD3 is needed to ensure the positivity is in the neoplastic B cells rather than admixed T cells.

60152.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小相近、色素正常，但可見多顆一端拉長成尾巴狀的淚滴形紅血球（dacrocytes），另有兩顆含粗大嗜鹼性點彩（basophilic stippling）的紅血球，提示骨髓纖維化造成的髓外造血與紅血球生成異常。
features: Several dacrocytes (teardrop cells) with single tapered tails
Normocytic normochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis and ovalocytes
Two red cells with coarse basophilic stippling
Scattered platelets of normal size
No nucleated red cells or immature granulocytes in this field
60152.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis, including several dacrocytes and ovalocytes. Two red cells display coarse basophilic stippling. Platelets are present and unremarkable, and no leukocytes, nucleated red cells or immature granulocytes are present in this field. Findings are consistent with a myelofibrotic process, compatible with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis in the given context; confirmation requires assessment for leukoerythroblastosis and marrow reticulin fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Blood findings are identical, so the distinction rests on a documented prior history of polycythemia vera.
Also causes teardrop cells and a leukoerythroblastic picture, but marrow biopsy shows keratin-positive tumor cells.
Show basophilic stippling with microcytic hypochromic red cells rather than normocytic cells with prominent teardrops.

exam.answer_en: Post-polycythemic myelofibrosis, peripheral blood — dacrocytes (teardrop cells) with basophilic stippling, supporting a myelofibrotic process
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著一端拉尾巴的紅血球問名稱（dacrocyte/teardrop cell）與意義——骨髓纖維化或骨髓浸潤、髓外造血時紅血球被擠壓變形。
Post-PV MF 診斷（IWG-MRT）：必須有 PV 病史與骨髓纖維化 grade 2–3（0–3 分級）；再加至少 2 項：貧血或不再需要放血、leukoerythroblastosis、脾臟持續變大、≥2 項全身症狀。
周邊血完整評估：找 leukoerythroblastosis（有核紅血球 + 未成熟顆粒球）、circulating blasts 比例；blasts 增加提示加速期或轉化為 AML。
治療與預後：JAK inhibitor（如 ruxolitinib）改善脾腫大與症狀；allogeneic HSCT 是唯一可能治癒的方式，可用 MYSEC-PM 作預後分層。
exam.pitfall_zh: 淚滴細胞易被當成抹片推片假象；假象的尾巴方向一致且常斷裂，真正的 dacrocytes 尾巴方向隨機，並需搭配 leukoerythroblastosis 與骨髓 reticulin 染色才能歸因於纖維化。

quiz.q: 圖中一端呈尾巴狀的紅血球叫什麼？PV 病人出現此變化，要診斷 post-PV myelofibrosis 必須有哪一項骨髓證據？
quiz.a: Dacrocyte（teardrop cell）；骨髓 reticulin 纖維化 grade 2–3。

60088.recognize_zh: 端粒長度（flow-FISH）報告中，淋巴球、顆粒球、naive/memory T、B 與 NK 細胞的端粒長度點全部落在第 1 百分位紅線以下，表格判讀皆為 VL（very low）；多種白血球亞群一致極短端粒，支持先天性端粒病如先天性角化不良症。
features: Table of median telomere length (kb) in six leukocyte subsets compared with age-matched normal medians
Patient values 2.7–4.7 kb versus normal medians 7.9–9.5 kb
All subsets interpreted as VL (very low, <1st percentile)
Nomograms plot patient values (dots, near age 12) below the red 1st-percentile curve in every subset
Uniform shortening across lymphoid and granulocytic lineages, including naive T cells
60088.describe_en: This figure is a telomere length report by flow-FISH showing median telomere length in lymphocytes, granulocytes, naive (CD45RA+) and memory (CD45RA-) T cells, B cells and NK cells, each plotted against age-specific percentile curves. The patient, plotted at approximately 12 years of age, has values of 2.7–4.7 kb compared with normal medians of 7.9–9.5 kb, falling below the 1st percentile in every subset. Uniformly very low telomere length across multiple lineages, particularly in naive T cells, is highly sensitive for a telomere biology disorder. Together with the reported TERC mutation, findings are consistent with dyskeratosis congenita.

ddx.vs: Telomeres may be modestly short in granulocytes, but not below the 1st percentile across all lymphocyte subsets.
Telomeres can be mildly shortened, but diagnosis requires increased chromosomal breakage with DEB/mitomycin C.
SDS shows exocrine pancreatic insufficiency and SBDS mutations without uniformly very short lymphocyte telomeres.

30264.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有數個芽細胞，細胞質嗜鹼性且邊緣呈不規則泡狀或尖狀突起（blebs/pseudopods），核仁可見，另有一個有核紅血球；帶突起的芽細胞是巨核芽細胞線索，在唐氏症新生兒提示暫時性異常骨髓增生（TAM）。
features: Blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio, round nuclei, fine chromatin and one or more visible nucleoli
Basophilic cytoplasm with irregular cytoplasmic blebs, budding and pointed pseudopod-like projections
Some blasts with fine cytoplasmic granularity and irregular cell outline
A small nucleated red cell with pyknotic nucleus
Red cells with slit-like stomatocytic pallor and occasional teardrop/fragment forms
30264.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa, oil immersion) shows several circulating blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm exhibiting irregular blebs and pseudopod-like projections, compatible with megakaryoblasts. A nucleated red cell is present, and red cells show stomatocyte-like forms with occasional teardrop and fragmented cells. Auer rods are not seen. In a neonate with Down syndrome, findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis; flow cytometry (CD41, CD61, CD42b, CD34, CD117) and GATA1 mutation studies confirm the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: ML-DS has similar megakaryoblasts but presents later in infancy with persistent disease and often a preceding myelodysplastic phase.
Monoblasts have abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase and CD14/CD64 positive rather than CD41/CD61.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm without blebs and express TdT with B- or T-lineage markers.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant blue cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and mature chromatin without nucleoli.

exam.answer_en: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis — circulating megakaryoblasts with nucleoli and irregular cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopods, with a nucleated red cell
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指有尖狀或泡狀胞質突起的母細胞，問系別與可能臨床背景；答 megakaryoblast，於唐氏症新生兒為 TAM。
診斷要點：TAM 以臨床（唐氏症或 trisomy 21 mosaic 新生兒）＋周邊血母細胞＋GATA1 突變確立，不需要骨髓檢查即可診斷。
Mosaic 陷阱：表型不明顯的 trisomy 21 mosaic 新生兒也可發生 TAM，因此非唐氏症外觀的新生兒出現此血象，應做 trisomy 21 與 GATA1 檢測。
併發症：嚴重 TAM 可有肝纖維化、肝衰竭、水腫與 DIC，早期死亡率不低，需評估是否給低劑量 cytarabine。
exam.pitfall_zh: 容易誤判為急性單核球白血病：單核母細胞胞質較豐富、灰藍帶細空泡、核折疊且 NSE 陽性；megakaryoblast 胞質深藍帶 blebs、MPO 與 NSE 陰性、CD41/CD61 陽性。

quiz.q: 外觀無唐氏症特徵的新生兒周邊血出現這種帶 blebs 的母細胞，應做哪兩項檢查以確認 TAM？
quiz.a: Trisomy 21（含 mosaicism）染色體/FISH 檢查與 GATA1 突變分析。

24184.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片紅血球之間可見一條細長、呈規則波浪狀捲曲的螺旋菌（spirochete），位於細胞外、長度約 1–2 個紅血球直徑，配合高燒與低血壓，即為回歸熱螺旋體（Borrelia）菌血症。
features: Single thin, extracellular, loosely coiled spiral organism between red cells
Organism length roughly 1-2 red cell diameters with regular undulations, staining lightly purple
Red cells show mild anisocytosis without significant fragmentation
A band/segmented neutrophil without intracellular organisms
Platelets not prominent in this field
24184.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with mild anisocytosis and an occasional neutrophil. A thin, extracellular spirochete with regular, loose coils is present in the plasma between red cells. No intraerythrocytic parasites or intracellular inclusions are identified in this field. In a febrile, hypotensive patient, findings are consistent with spirochetemia due to relapsing fever Borrelia (e.g. Borrelia hermsii).

ddx.dx: Fibrin strand or stain precipitate artifact
ddx.vs: Artifacts are irregular, variably thick and lack the uniform regular coils of a spirochete.
Trypanosomes are larger with a visible nucleus, kinetoplast and undulating membrane, unlike this slender coiled organism without internal structure.
Leptospires are finer with tightly wound coils and hooked ends and are rarely seen on Wright-stained smears.
Microfilariae are much larger (many red cells long) with a column of nuclei.

exam.answer_en: Relapsing fever borreliosis (Borrelia hermsii) — thin, loosely coiled extracellular spirochete between red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指著紅血球間的細長螺旋狀物問「這是什麼病原？」→ spirochete，relapsing fever Borrelia；要與纖維蛋白絲等假影區分。
Tick-borne relapsing fever 由 Ornithodoros 軟蜱傳播（如 B. hermsii）；louse-borne 型為 B. recurrentis。
發燒期血中菌量高，血片可直接看到菌體，這與 Lyme disease 幾乎看不到不同；表面抗原變異造成反覆發燒。
治療用 doxycycline 或 penicillin 類；首劑後可能發生 Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction（寒顫、發燒、低血壓），需密切監測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被當成纖維蛋白絲或染料沉澱假影；螺旋菌粗細均勻、捲曲規則，假影則粗細不一、形狀不規則。

quiz.q: 紅血球之間這條規則捲曲的細長微生物是什麼？抗生素治療後需注意哪種急性反應？
quiz.a: Borrelia（relapsing fever spirochete）；Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction

1784.recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血抹片中可見大量有核紅血球（各成熟階段的正染/多染性紅血球母細胞），加上缺乏中央淡染的小圓形球形紅血球（箭頭）與多染性大紅血球，呈現免疫性溶血與骨髓代償性增生，符合胎兒紅血球母細胞增多症（新生兒溶血病）。
features: Markedly increased nucleated red blood cells at polychromatic and orthochromatic stages
Small, dense round red cells lacking central pallor (spherocytes, arrows)
Polychromasia with large bluish-gray macrocytic red cells (reticulocytes)
Occasional neutrophils and a myeloid precursor (left shift)
No schistocytes or target cells as a dominant finding
1784.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked erythroblastosis with numerous nucleated red blood cells at various stages of maturation, predominantly polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts. There are scattered spherocytes and prominent polychromasia with large polychromatophilic red cells. Occasional neutrophils and an immature granulocyte are present. In a newborn, findings are consistent with immune hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (erythroblastosis fetalis); ABO/Rh typing and a direct antiglobulin test are needed to define the antibody.

ddx.vs: HS also shows spherocytes but is DAT negative with a family history and lacks the striking erythroblastosis of alloimmune hemolysis in a neonate.
Healthy newborns have a few nucleated red cells and macrocytes, but not this degree of normoblastemia with spherocytes.
Stress-related normoblastemia lacks spherocytes and has a negative DAT.
These show circulating blasts, often in Down syndrome, rather than predominantly maturing normoblasts.

exam.answer_en: Hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (erythroblastosis fetalis) — marked normoblastemia with spherocytes and polychromasia
pearls_zh: 考法：新生兒血片中大量有核紅血球加上球形紅血球，考官問「最先做什麼檢查」；答案是 DAT 與母嬰 ABO/Rh 血型與抗體篩檢。
ABO HDFN（常見於 O 型母親、A 或 B 型嬰兒）球形紅血球較明顯、DAT 可能僅弱陽性，臨床通常較輕；anti-D 所致 Rh HDFN 可嚴重至胎兒水腫。
臨床急症：間接膽紅素快速上升有 kernicterus 風險，需照光治療，嚴重者換血；溶血持續可造成晚發性貧血。
預防：RhD 陰性孕婦於懷孕 28 週及分娩後 72 小時內（嬰兒 RhD 陽性時）給予 Rh immune globulin。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 hereditary spherocytosis 或正常新生兒的有核紅血球；本圖 NRBC 數量明顯偏多、多染性顯著，靠 DAT 陽性與母嬰血型不合確認免疫性溶血。

quiz.q: 新生兒血片如圖（大量 NRBC、球形紅血球），為確認免疫性溶血，第一個要做的檢查是什麼？
quiz.a: Direct antiglobulin test（DAT，直接 Coombs test），並做母嬰 ABO/Rh 血型。

22648.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中漿細胞增加，B 圖一顆核偏位的漿細胞細胞質內塞滿許多針狀、棒狀的淡紫色結晶，形似 Auer rods，為輕鏈結晶沉積（crystal-storing）的漿細胞，配合蛋白尿提示輕鏈骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm (panel A), including a large binucleate/multinucleate form
Panel B: plasma cell with a round eccentric nucleus and abundant pale cytoplasm
Numerous needle-shaped to rod-like, lavender cytoplasmic crystalline inclusions resembling Auer rods
Crystals radiate beyond the main cytoplasmic mass in a haphazard array
Background of maturing myeloid cells and erythrocytes
22648.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in plasma cells, including atypical binucleate forms. Some plasma cells contain abundant cytoplasm filled with numerous slender, needle-like and rod-shaped crystalline inclusions resembling Auer rods. No myeloblasts with Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with intracytoplasmic immunoglobulin light chain crystals; correlation with light chain restriction, serum free light chains and renal evaluation (e.g., light chain Fanconi syndrome) is recommended.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: Auer rods occur in MPO-positive blasts with fine chromatin and high N:C ratio, not in plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and clock-face chromatin.
In crystal-storing histiocytosis the crystals lie within CD68-positive histiocytes rather than CD138-positive plasma cells.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm and small central nuclei rather than discrete refractile needles.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal, extracellular or within eosinophils, and associated with eosinophil degranulation.

18488.recognize_zh: 這是 E4402（RESORT）臨床試驗流程圖（非形態學影像）：先給 rituximab 375 mg/m² 每週一次共 4 劑，達 CR 或 PR 者隨機分為每 3 個月維持治療，或疾病進展時再治療，持續至治療失敗。
features: Induction with rituximab 375 mg/m2 weekly for 4 doses
Patients achieving CR or PR are randomized
Arm 1: rituximab maintenance 375 mg/m2 every 3 months
Arm 2: rituximab re-treatment at progression, 375 mg/m2 weekly for 4 doses
Treatment continues until failure: no response to retreatment or progression within 6 months, need for cytotoxic therapy, or inability to complete therapy
18488.describe_en: This non-morphologic figure shows the schema of the ECOG E4402 (RESORT) trial in low-tumor-burden follicular lymphoma. Patients received rituximab induction at 375 mg/m2 weekly for four doses, and those achieving complete or partial response were randomized to scheduled maintenance rituximab every 3 months or to rituximab re-treatment only at progression, each continued until treatment failure. Treatment failure was defined as no response to retreatment or progression within 6 months of rituximab, initiation of cytotoxic therapy, or inability to complete treatment. The trial found that maintenance did not prolong time to treatment failure compared with re-treatment at progression, supporting the retreatment strategy with less rituximab exposure.

18360.recognize_zh: 這是一張純文字投影片（非形態學影像），說明期中 PET 以 ΔSUVmax 評估的方法：取基期與期中 PET 最活躍病灶的 SUVmax 計算下降百分比，ROC 決定的切點為 PET0-2 下降 66%、PET0-4 下降 72.9%。
features: Text slide describing delta SUVmax assessment for interim PET in DLBCL
Baseline PET0: SUVmax in the most active lesion
Interim PET: SUVmax in the most active lesion if positive, or in the PET0 tumor area if negative
Percent SUVmax reduction calculated per Lin et al, J Nucl Med 2007
ROC-derived optimal cut-offs: 66% for PET0-2 and 72.9% for PET0-4
18360.describe_en: This non-morphologic text slide describes the semiquantitative delta SUVmax method for interim PET assessment in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. The SUVmax of the most active lesion is measured at baseline and at interim PET (or in the region of the baseline tumor if the interim scan is negative), and the percentage reduction is calculated. ROC-derived cut-offs of 66% after two cycles and 72.9% after four cycles separate good from poor responders, offering a more reproducible alternative to purely visual interpretation in patients receiving R-CHOP.

13496.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片幾乎全被中至大型未成熟細胞取代，核圓、染色質細緻、胞質深藍，胞質內可見多個清楚的圓形空泡（常沿核周或邊緣排列），並夾雜少數較成熟紅母細胞；以原始紅血球為主且胞質空泡，是純紅血球白血病的典型表現。
features: Near-total replacement by intermediate to large immature cells in sheets
Round central to slightly eccentric nuclei with finely granular chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with multiple sharply punched-out vacuoles, often at the cell periphery
Occasional binucleate forms and scattered more mature erythroblasts with condensed chromatin
Few granulocytic precursors in the field; red cells and smudged cells in the background
13496.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular and composed predominantly of sheets of intermediate to large immature cells with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin, occasional nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous discrete punched-out vacuoles. Scattered later-stage erythroblasts are present, while granulocytic precursors are sparse. Myeloblasts with granules or Auer rods are not seen. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia (pure erythroid leukemia), which requires erythroid predominance of at least 80% with at least 30% proerythroblasts; confirmation with E-cadherin, CD71 and glycophorin A, PAS staining and TP53 testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts show cytoplasmic blebbing and CD41/CD61 positivity and are negative for E-cadherin and glycophorin A.
Burkitt cells also have basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are smaller, CD19/CD10 positive B cells with MYC rearrangement and lipid-positive (oil red O) vacuoles.
Megaloblastic marrow shows a full spectrum of maturing erythroid cells with open chromatin, giant metamyelocytes and response to B12/folate, not a proerythroblast-predominant block.
Parvovirus shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions amid erythroid hypoplasia rather than sheets of vacuolated proerythroblasts.

exam.answer_en: Pure erythroid leukemia — sheets of proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and punched-out vacuoles replacing the marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：一片深藍胞質、帶空泡的原始細胞，問是哪一系 → 紅系（proerythroblast）；需與 Burkitt、megakaryoblast 區分，型態無法單獨定系。
診斷門檻：WHO 5th acute erythroid leukaemia 為紅系前驅細胞 ≥ 80% 且其中 proerythroblasts ≥ 30%；ICC 2022 多將此類歸入 AML with mutated TP53。
表型：E-cadherin、CD71、glycophorin A（較成熟者）陽性，CD34 與 MPO 通常陰性；PAS 可見粗大塊狀或球狀陽性。
分子與預後：常有 biallelic TP53 突變與複雜核型，預後極差；化療反應不佳，需評估臨床試驗或移植。
exam.pitfall_zh: 空泡化深藍原始細胞最易被誤判為 Burkitt leukemia；Burkitt 為 CD19/CD10+ B 細胞、MYC 轉位，胞質空泡為脂質（Oil red O +），紅系原始細胞則 E-cadherin/CD71 陽性。

quiz.q: 這些胞質深藍帶空泡的原始細胞屬於哪一系？最常伴隨的基因突變為何？
quiz.a: 紅系（proerythroblasts）；TP53

3320.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，大量大型細胞呈強而完整的棕色細胞膜陽性，成片或叢狀分布，周圍小型造血細胞為藍色陰性；圖中未標示抗體，在 ALCL 的情境下最符合 CD30 膜染色。
features: Numerous large cells with strong, crisp membranous brown staining and occasional dot-like paranuclear accentuation
Positive cells form confluent sheets and clusters replacing large areas of marrow
Hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei of positive cells appear large and irregular
Interspersed small negative (blue) hematopoietic and stromal cells
Antibody not labeled in the image
3320.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow core biopsy shows extensive sheets and clusters of large cells with strong, uniform membranous immunoreactivity, with small negative hematopoietic cells in between. The antibody is not specified in the image; the membranous pattern with paranuclear accentuation is typical of CD30 in anaplastic large cell lymphoma, though a pan-leukocyte or T-cell membrane marker could produce a similar pattern. In the context of the title, the findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CD30-positive Hodgkin cells are sparse and scattered in a mixed inflammatory background rather than forming confluent sheets.

ddx.dx: CD30-positive DLBCL or other large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These express CD20/PAX5 and lack ALK, whereas ALCL is B-cell marker negative.
Embryonal carcinoma is CD30-positive but also keratin, OCT4 and SALL4 positive and CD45 negative.
CD30 expression in PTCL-NOS is usually heterogeneous and weaker rather than strong and uniform in nearly all tumor cells.

6520.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中出現一團彼此黏附的大型非造血細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻，淡藍色細胞質邊緣布滿小空泡，這種「成團、黏聚」的排列提示轉移性小圓藍細胞腫瘤（此例為胚胎型橫紋肌肉瘤 embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma）。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells, several times the diameter of adjacent red cells, with focal nuclear molding
Moderate to high N:C ratio with round to oval, slightly eccentric nuclei
Finely granular to smooth chromatin with small, inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale grey-blue cytoplasm with ragged, frayed borders
Numerous small discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, concentrated at the cell periphery
Background of red cells with a small platelet clump; no normal hematopoietic precursors within the cluster
6520.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large, non-hematopoietic-appearing cells set in a background of red cells. The cells have round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin and small nucleoli, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm with frayed borders and numerous small peripheral vacuoles. Nuclear molding and tight cell-to-cell cohesion favor a metastatic solid tumor over acute leukemia. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a small round blue cell tumor; in this context, metastatic embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma, to be confirmed by desmin and myogenin (MyoD1) immunohistochemistry on the biopsy.

ddx.vs: Morphology on aspirate cannot reliably separate the subtypes; alveolar RMS shows diffuse strong myogenin staining and PAX3/PAX7::FOXO1 fusion, whereas embryonal RMS is fusion-negative with patchy myogenin.
Neuroblastoma cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and form Homer Wright rosettes around neurofibrillary material, rather than showing vacuolated cytoplasm with frayed borders.
Ewing cells form similar clusters with vacuoles (PAS-positive glycogen) but are CD99 and NKX2.2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement and lack desmin/myogenin.
Burkitt cells lie singly rather than in cohesive molded clusters and have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with vacuoles, expressing CD19/CD20 and surface light chain.

2360.recognize_zh: 中倍下擴張的淋巴竇中聚集大量淡粉紅色、細胞質豐富的大型組織球，其中數顆可見包含多個淋巴球（emperipolesis），周邊為富含漿細胞與淋巴球的深染條索，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Dilated sinuses packed with large histiocytes having abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Several histiocytes contain multiple intact lymphocytes (emperipolesis)
Histiocyte nuclei round and vesicular
Intervening dense cords of small lymphocytes and plasma cells
Sinus-predominant distribution with preserved lymphoid cords
2360.describe_en: Lymph node section (H&E) at intermediate power shows sinuses distended by clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei. Several histiocytes contain multiple intact lymphocytes within their cytoplasm, indicating emperipolesis. The intervening cords are rich in small lymphocytes and plasma cells. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease; the histiocytes are expected to be S100 and CD68 positive and CD1a negative.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved nuclei with eosinophils and express CD1a/langerin, without prominent emperipolesis.
Reactive histiocytes are smaller, S100 negative and lack conspicuous emperipolesis.
HLH histiocytes ingest and degrade erythrocytes and nucleated cells rather than harboring intact lymphocytes in clear vacuoles.
Carcinoma forms cohesive atypical epithelial clusters that are keratin positive.

exam.answer_en: Rosai-Dorfman disease — dilated sinuses packed with large pale histiocytes showing emperipolesis, beside plasma cell-rich medullary cords
pearls_zh: 考法：中倍圖，考官指竇內大型組織球內含淋巴球者，問現象名稱，並指周邊深染條索問富含何種細胞（漿細胞與淋巴球）。
必考 IHC：RDD 組織球 S100+、CD68+、CD163+，但 CD1a−、langerin（CD207）−；S100 染色可清楚勾勒出被包入的淋巴球（emperipolesis）。
RDD 可含大量 IgG4+ 漿細胞，但一般不符合 IgG4-related disease 的其他組織學特徵（如閉塞性靜脈炎、席紋狀纖維化），勿僅憑 IgG4 計數改診。
經典臨床：年輕人雙側無痛性巨大頸部淋巴結腫大、發燒、ESR 升高、多株高γ球蛋白血症；也可結節外侵犯（皮膚、鼻竇、眼眶、CNS）；多數病程良性或自限。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 LCH：LCH 細胞核有溝、較小、伴嗜酸性球、CD1a+/langerin+；RDD 組織球核圓泡狀、胞質豐富淡染、emperipolesis、CD1a−。

quiz.q: 圖中竇內大型組織球包含淋巴球，要用哪一個 IHC 組合與 LCH 區分？
quiz.a: S100+（兩者皆可陽性），但 RDD 為 CD1a−、langerin−，LCH 為 CD1a+、langerin+。

1656.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中綠色箭頭指向一團緊密重疊、深染、比周圍造血細胞大且形態不同的黏聚細胞團，細胞界線不清、核深黑，與散在的正常紅系與顆粒球前驅細胞明顯不同，提示外來（非造血）腫瘤細胞。
features: Cohesive, three-dimensional cluster of large overlapping cells (green arrow) distinct from surrounding hematopoietic cells
Hyperchromatic, crowded nuclei with high N:C ratio and indistinct cell borders
Scant to moderate grey-blue cytoplasm at the edge of the cluster; adjacent clear vacuolated spaces
Background of normal maturing granulocytic precursors, erythroblasts, and lymphocytes
Detail of nucleoli and chromatin obscured by cluster thickness and image resolution
1656.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive clump of large, overlapping, hyperchromatic cells (arrow) that differ in size, staining, and arrangement from the surrounding trilineage hematopoietic precursors. Cell borders are indistinct and nuclei are crowded, with a high N:C ratio. Nuclear detail is limited by the thickness of the cluster and image resolution. Findings are suggestive of metastatic non-hematopoietic tumor cells; correlation with the core biopsy and immunohistochemistry (e.g. cytokeratin, neuroendocrine or lineage-specific markers) is recommended.

ddx.vs: A megakaryocyte is a single cell with a lobulated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm, not a cluster of many separate overlapping nuclei.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei, abundant blue cytoplasm with a hof set away from the nucleus, and form loose rows rather than dense overlapping clumps.

ddx.dx: Clumped leukemic blasts or lymphoma cells
ddx.vs: Hematopoietic neoplastic cells are typically discohesive, whereas true cohesion with nuclear crowding favors epithelial or other non-hematopoietic tumor, confirmed by CD45-negative/cytokeratin-positive staining.

1272.recognize_zh: 整個視野幾乎被形態一致的母細胞佔滿，核圓、染色質細緻、胞質少，只有極少數帶顆粒的細胞，缺乏往下成熟的顆粒球；這種單調的母細胞片狀分布符合無成熟的急性骨髓性白血病（AML without maturation）。
features: Monotonous sheets of intermediate-sized blasts effacing the aspirate
High N:C ratio with round to slightly irregular nuclei and finely dispersed chromatin
Small nucleoli in some blasts; scant pale basophilic cytoplasm, mostly agranular with occasional fine azurophilic granules
Very few maturing granulocytes (promyelocytes onward) and rare erythroid precursors
A single residual megakaryocyte at the left edge
1272.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly cellular and composed predominantly of a monotonous population of intermediate-sized blasts. The blasts have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round nuclei with fine chromatin, inconspicuous to small nucleoli, and scant basophilic cytoplasm that is largely agranular, with occasional cells showing fine granules. Maturing granulocytic elements beyond the blast stage are scarce, and residual erythroid precursors and megakaryocytes are rare. No Auer rods are identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia without maturation, pending MPO/flow cytometric confirmation of myeloid lineage.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts can look identical when agranular, so lineage is resolved by MPO positivity in >=3% of blasts or flow expression of myeloid markers versus CD19/cCD3.
AML with maturation has >=10% maturing granulocytes (promyelocytes to neutrophils), whereas here maturing forms are scarce.
Minimally differentiated AML is MPO-negative (<3%) by cytochemistry and needs flow to prove myeloid lineage, while AML without maturation has >=3% MPO-positive blasts.

exam.answer_en: Acute myeloid leukemia without maturation — monotonous sheets of agranular myeloblasts effacing the marrow with scant maturing granulocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：整片單調母細胞時，考官會問「如何分辨 AML without maturation、AML with minimal differentiation 與 ALL？」；答以 MPO（≥3% 陽性 vs <3%）與 flow lineage 標記區分。
典型 flow：CD34+、CD117+、CD13+、CD33+、HLA-DR+，cytoplasmic MPO 陽性；lymphoid 標記（cCD3、CD19/cCD79a）應為陰性，否則考慮 MPAL。
診斷前需完成 karyotype/FISH 與 NGS 以排除 AML with defining genetic abnormalities（如 NPM1、KMT2A、MECOM 重排）；診斷分類與 ELN 風險都取決於遺傳結果。
高白血球、母細胞大量的病人須注意 leukostasis 與 tumor lysis syndrome，治療前給水分與 allopurinol/rasburicase 預防。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 ALL 或 lymphoma：單看形態無法區分無顆粒母細胞，必須以 MPO 染色或 flow 證明 myeloid lineage，不可僅依核仁或胞質量判斷。

quiz.q: 圖中單調母細胞若 MPO 陽性率 <3% 但 flow 顯示 CD13/CD33/CD117 陽性，應分類為何？
quiz.a: AML with minimal differentiation

1080.recognize_zh: 數顆漿細胞核偏位、細胞質淡藍色，細胞質內堆滿粗大、紅紫色的桿狀至圓形嗜天青顆粒，清楚呈現Snapper-Schneid顆粒。
features: Clustered plasma cells with eccentric round to oval nuclei and coarse chromatin
Pale blue cytoplasm filled with coarse reddish-purple, rod-like to round azurophilic granules
Granules densely packed in some cells and partly surrounding the nucleus
Occasional binucleate or lobulated plasmacytoid nucleus
Scattered free granules and a neutrophil in the background
1080.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, and pale blue cytoplasm. Many cells contain abundant coarse reddish-purple azurophilic granules, some rod-shaped, that fill much of the cytoplasm. Free granules are scattered in the background, and a segmented neutrophil is present. Findings are consistent with Snapper-Schneid granules in plasma cells, a feature described in plasma cell neoplasms.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei, fine chromatin, Auer rods/faggot cells, and are CD138 negative/MPO strongly positive.
Mast cells have round central nuclei with dense purple-black metachromatic granules and express tryptase/CD117.
Crystal-storing cells show sharply angular needle- or rhomboid-shaped inclusions rather than numerous small azurophilic granules.

1144.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆母細胞，核染色質細緻，核的一側有凹陷（箭頭），凹陷處對應一塊淡染的細胞質，形成像被拇指壓過的「杯狀」核（cup-like/thumbprint），常見於NPM1突變AML。
features: Blast about 2-3 times red cell diameter with fine, open chromatin
Nuclear invagination along one margin (arrow) producing a cup-like/thumbprint indentation
Pale cytoplasmic zone filling the nuclear indentation
Moderate rim of blue-grey cytoplasm without visible Auer rods
Adjacent monocytoid cell with folded nucleus and vacuolated cytoplasm; background red cells unremarkable
1144.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a blast with fine chromatin, a moderate rim of blue-grey cytoplasm, and a prominent nuclear invagination (arrow) filled by pale cytoplasm, giving a cup-like or thumbprint appearance. No Auer rods are seen. A monocytoid cell with a folded nucleus and a lymphocyte are also present. Cup-like blasts are a morphologic clue to AML, particularly with NPM1 and/or FLT3-ITD mutations; molecular testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL cells have bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei with fine granules and Auer rods, and are CD34/HLA-DR negative with PML::RARA.
Promonocytes have delicately folded or convoluted nuclei with grey vacuolated cytoplasm rather than a single sharp invagination with a pale zone.

ddx.dx: Cleaved lymphoma cells or reactive lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Lymphoid cells show condensed chromatin with a narrow cleft and no pale cytoplasmic pocket, and are MPO negative.

exam.answer_en: AML, favor NPM1-mutated — cup-like (thumbprint) blast with nuclear invagination filled by pale cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：指箭頭處核凹陷、凹陷內為淡染細胞質的母細胞，問形態名稱與應送的分子檢查。答 cup-like/thumbprint blast，送 NPM1 與 FLT3-ITD。
Cup-like blasts 常為 CD34−、HLA-DR− 的表型；NPM1 突變可用 IHC 看到 NPM1 蛋白異常位於細胞質（cytoplasmic delocalization）作佐證。
WHO 5th 的 AML with NPM1 mutation 不設 blast 門檻；ICC 2022 則要求 blasts ≥10%。
ELN 2022 預後：NPM1 突變且無 FLT3-ITD 屬 favorable；合併 FLT3-ITD 為 intermediate，induction 可加 FLT3 inhibitor（如 midostaurin）。
exam.pitfall_zh: CD34−/HLA-DR− 的 cup-like blasts 易被誤認為 microgranular APL；APL 核呈雙葉蝴蝶狀、細顆粒且有 Auer rods，須以 PML::RARA 排除，懷疑 APL 時先給 ATRA。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指母細胞的核型態稱為什麼？最常與哪個基因突變相關？
quiz.a: Cup-like（thumbprint）nucleus；NPM1 突變（常合併 FLT3-ITD）

4216.recognize_zh: 淋巴結免疫染色中，絕大多數淋巴樣細胞呈強烈的細胞核棕色陽性，瀰漫分布；圖上未標示抗體，若為 FOXP3 或高 Ki-67 則支持 ATLL 的腫瘤性 T 細胞浸潤。
features: Diffuse nuclear immunoreactivity in the majority of lymphoid cells
Strong, crisp brown nuclear staining with little cytoplasmic signal
Negative cells include endothelial and stromal cells along vessels
Diffuse architecture without follicular compartmentalization
Specific antibody not identified in the image
4216.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of lymph node shows strong nuclear staining in the large majority of the diffusely infiltrating lymphoid cells, with negative stromal and endothelial cells outlining vessels. The antibody is not indicated on the image; a nuclear marker such as FOXP3 or Ki-67 would give this pattern. Interpreted together with morphology and a CD4+/CD25+ phenotype with HTLV-1 positivity, findings support nodal involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS is usually FOXP3-negative or only focally positive and lacks HTLV-1 integration.
AITL neoplastic cells express TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS) with expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks.

ddx.dx: Reactive node with regulatory T cells
ddx.vs: Reactive nodes show only scattered FOXP3+ cells rather than diffuse sheets.

4088.recognize_zh: 成片黏著生長的大型細胞，核圓到卵圓、染色質空泡狀、核仁明顯、胞質豐富嗜雙色，並有多個分裂象；外觀像上皮或 ALCL，但需靠 CD20/PAX5 陽性證明為 B 細胞才能判定為 anaplastic 型 DLBCL。
features: Sheets of large cells, 3–4 times the size of small lymphocytes, with a cohesive growth pattern
Round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli
Moderate to abundant amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Frequent mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies
Only mild nuclear pleomorphism in this field; delicate intervening capillaries
4088.describe_en: Section shows diffuse sheets of large atypical cells with a somewhat cohesive growth pattern. The cells have round to oval vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily identified. Marked bizarre pleomorphism or hallmark horseshoe-shaped nuclei are not conspicuous in this field. The morphology is that of a high-grade large-cell lymphoma; with B-cell lineage confirmed (CD20/PAX5+), findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant, which may be CD30-positive and mimic ALCL or carcinoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30 and T-cell/cytotoxic markers but lacks CD20/PAX5.
Carcinoma is cytokeratin-positive and CD45/CD20-negative despite similar cohesive sheets.
cHL cells are CD15+/CD30+ with weak PAX5 and absent CD45/CD20, set in an inflammatory background.
Plasmablastic lymphoma lacks CD20/PAX5 and expresses CD138/MUM1, often EBER-positive.

4152.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結免疫染色中，多個濾泡的套區呈寬大深棕色、中央小型退化生發中心也著色，濾泡間區陰性，呈 B 細胞標記分布；其中可見一套區包兩個生發中心（twinning）及穿入的小血管，支持 Castleman 病。標記未標示。
features: Numerous B-cell follicles with broad, strongly positive mantle zones
Small, atretic germinal centers, some with twinning (two germinal centers within one mantle)
Vessels penetrating into germinal centers
Negative interfollicular (T-cell) zones
Low-power pattern only; cytology not assessable
4152.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified, distribution typical of a B-cell marker such as CD20) on a lymph node shows numerous follicles with expanded, strongly positive mantle zones surrounding small, regressed germinal centers, while the interfollicular zones are negative. One follicle contains two germinal centers within a shared mantle, and penetrating vessels are seen within germinal centers. The preserved follicular architecture with expanded mantles and atretic centers is consistent with hyaline-vascular Castleman disease, and the absence of sheets of positive cells in interfollicular areas argues against a B-cell lymphoma effacing the node.

ddx.vs: FL shows crowded back-to-back follicles with BCL2-positive germinal centers and thin or absent mantles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL shows expanded mantles composed of cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, CD5-positive monoclonal B cells.
Reactive follicles have large active germinal centers with thinner, non-onion-skinned mantles.

4152.stain: IHC: marker not specified (B-cell pattern, likely CD20), DAB

3896.recognize_zh: 腹水抹片裡粗箭頭指的是胞質深藍、核偏位並有核旁淡染區的漿細胞，和周圍胞質滿是空泡的巨噬細胞（雙箭頭）形成對比；小箭頭則是一顆小淋巴樣細胞，用來比較大小。
features: Plasma cells (large arrow) with abundant dense basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nucleus and paranuclear clearing
Other plasmacytoid cells with deep blue cytoplasm scattered among macrophages
Vacuolated macrophages with foamy cytoplasm and reniform nuclei (double arrow)
Small lymphocyte for size comparison (small arrow); occasional neutrophils
3896.describe_en: Cytospin of ascitic fluid shows numerous foamy, vacuolated macrophages (double arrow) with scattered plasma cells characterized by abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and paranuclear hofs (large arrow). A small lymphocyte (small arrow) and occasional neutrophils are present. No clusters of epithelial malignant cells are seen. In the clinical setting of plasma cell myeloma, findings are suggestive of myelomatous peritoneal effusion, to be confirmed by CD138 and kappa/lambda studies.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cells in inflammatory ascites
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are sparse, mature-appearing and polytypic, while myeloma cells are clonal with light chain restriction.
Mesothelial cells have central nuclei, peripheral cytoplasmic fringe and cohesive groupings and stain for calretinin/WT1 rather than CD138 with light chain restriction.
Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma or marginal zone lymphoma shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes to plasma cells with a CD20-positive B-cell component.

3960.recognize_zh: 血片中可見多個兩端尖細的鐮刀狀紅血球（sickle cells，雙箭頭），加上許多含 Howell-Jolly 小體的紅血球與標靶細胞，提示鐮刀型貧血合併脾功能低下。
features: Numerous elongated, crescent-shaped sickle cells with pointed ends (double arrow)
Frequent Howell-Jolly bodies within red cells, indicating functional asplenia
Scattered target cells and polychromatophilic red cells (single arrow at left)
Anisopoikilocytosis with small dense cells (arrow at right)
Platelets adequate; a single small nucleated cell at upper right
3960.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous sickle cells (drepanocytes) having elongated, pointed ends. Many red cells contain Howell-Jolly bodies, and target cells and polychromatophilic cells are present. Scattered small dense cells are also seen. Platelets are adequate in number. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease with evidence of hyposplenism (autosplenectomy).

ddx.vs: HbSC shows fewer classic sickle cells and more target cells with blunt, crystal-containing 'SC' poikilocytes, confirmed by hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC.
Sickle beta-thalassemia adds prominent microcytosis and hypochromia, with elevated HbA2 on HPLC.
Elliptocytes are oval with rounded ends and lack the pointed crescent shape and Howell-Jolly bodies of sickle cell disease.
Howell-Jolly bodies and target cells occur after splenectomy but true sickle cells are absent.

exam.answer_en: Sickle cell disease with autosplenectomy — numerous pointed sickle cells, frequent Howell-Jolly bodies, target and polychromatophilic cells
pearls_zh: 考法：此視野 sickle cell 數量多，考官常問「irreversibly sickled cell」：即使重新給氧也無法恢復圓盤狀的膜損傷細胞。
機轉：HBB 第 6 個密碼子 Glu→Val（HbS），去氧狀態下聚合；HbF 會抑制聚合，因此 HbF 高者症狀較輕。
HPLC 判讀：HbSS 以 HbS 為主、無 HbA、HbF 不等；若 HbS 伴 HbA2 上升與小球性則考慮 HbS/β-thalassemia；輸血後會出現 HbA 干擾判讀。
Target cell＋polychromasia 反映慢性溶血與網狀紅血球增加；網狀紅血球驟降要想到 parvovirus B19 aplastic crisis。
輸血病人需注意 alloimmunization 與遲發型溶血輸血反應，應盡量做擴展表型配血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 HbSC；HbSC 典型 sickle cell 少、target cell 多並有鈍端有稜角的 SC 結晶，本圖為大量尖端新月形細胞並伴 Howell-Jolly body。

quiz.q: HbS 的分子缺陷是 β-globin 第幾個胺基酸由什麼換成什麼？
quiz.a: 第 6 個胺基酸 glutamic acid → valine

3576.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中，箭頭指的顆粒球系細胞有兩個分開的核，核染色質粗糙，細胞質淡、顆粒稀少；雙核化與低顆粒化是顆粒球系發育不良（dysgranulopoiesis）的表現。
features: Granulocytic cell (arrow) with two separate, oval to kidney-shaped nuclei (binucleation)
Coarse, clumped chromatin in both nuclei
Pale, hypogranular cytoplasm with only sparse fine granules
Surrounding immature myeloid cells and larger precursors with more basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered RBCs and granular debris in background
3576.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a granulocytic cell (arrow) with two separate nuclei with clumped chromatin and pale, hypogranular cytoplasm. Adjacent myeloid precursors are present at various stages of maturation. Binucleation and hypogranularity of granulocytic precursors are features of dysgranulopoiesis. Correlation with blast percentage, other lineages, cytogenetics, and exclusion of nutritional or drug-related causes is needed before attributing this to myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Pelger cells have two lobes joined by a thin chromatin bridge, whereas this cell has completely separate nuclei.
Megaloblastic precursors are enlarged with open chromatin and giant bands or metamyelocytes and have normal granulation.
Two overlapping cells show two cytoplasmic borders, while here both nuclei share one continuous cytoplasm.

3640.recognize_zh: 兩顆淋巴球的核有多條彎曲細溝、表面像腦迴一樣起伏（cerebriform），染色質緻密、細胞質只有一圈淡藍色；背景紅血球皺縮成棘狀。這是 Sézary 細胞的高倍表現。
features: Two lymphocytes slightly larger than small lymphocytes, with high N:C ratio
Nuclei with multiple curved grooves and overlapping folds (cerebriform)
Dense, hyperchromatic chromatin; nucleoli not evident
Thin rim to small crescent of pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Background RBCs with crenation (echinocytic artifact)
3640.describe_en: High-power peripheral blood smear shows two lymphocytes with high N:C ratios and nuclei showing multiple curved grooves and folds, giving a cerebriform appearance. The chromatin is dense without visible nucleoli, and the cytoplasm is a thin rim of pale-blue agranular material. Background red cells show crenation artifact. Findings are consistent with Sézary cells.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells show deeper polylobation into flower-like petals, and HTLV-1 serology is positive.

ddx.dx: Mycosis fungoides-like reactive cells in dermatitis
ddx.vs: Occasional cerebriform cells can appear in benign erythroderma, but they are few and lack a clonal TCR rearrangement or CD7/CD26 loss.
Follicular lymphoma cells have deep single clefts (buttock cells) and are CD10+ BCL2+ B cells.
T-PLL cells have a visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs with TCL1 overexpression.

exam.answer_en: Sézary cells — high N:C lymphocytes with dense chromatin and deeply grooved, cerebriform nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍圖考官指核表面多條彎曲溝紋的淋巴球，答 cerebriform nucleus／Sézary cell；電子顯微鏡下核膜高度折疊。
Sézary syndrome 為 WHO 分類中的成熟 T 細胞腫瘤，典型 CD3+CD4+，常 CD7−、CD26−，並常表現 CCR4 與 KIR3DL2（CD158k）。
與 mycosis fungoides 同屬皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤譜系，但 SS 以紅皮症與血液侵犯為主，預後較差。
良性紅皮症（如嚴重異位性皮膚炎、藥物反應）也可見少量腦迴狀淋巴球，故需定量與克隆性證據，不能只憑形態。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 follicular lymphoma 的 cleaved cell 混淆；FL 細胞核是單一深裂（buttock-like），Sézary 細胞則為多條細溝紋的腦迴狀，且屬 CD4+ T 細胞而非 CD10+ B 細胞。

quiz.q: 這兩顆核呈腦迴狀的淋巴球，典型的免疫表型為何？
quiz.a: CD3+、CD4+，常丟失 CD7 與 CD26（Sézary cells）。

3512.recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血中可見許多小而深染、缺乏中央淡染區的球形紅血球（microspherocytes），合併偏藍的多染性紅血球與一個有核紅血球，符合 ABO 不相容所致的新生兒溶血病。
features: Numerous microspherocytes: small, dense red cells lacking central pallor
Polychromatophilic larger bluish red cells indicating reticulocytosis
Nucleated red blood cell (upper center) with dense, lobulated nucleus
Two segmented neutrophils and scattered platelets
Mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional irregular or crenated forms
3512.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous microspherocytes lacking central pallor, admixed with polychromatophilic red cells and a circulating nucleated red blood cell. Two segmented neutrophils and adequate platelets are present. No schistocytes or intraerythrocytic parasites are seen. In a neonate, findings are consistent with immune hemolysis, and the prominent spherocytes are typical of hemolytic disease of the newborn due to ABO incompatibility; confirmation with maternal and infant blood typing and DAT is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hereditary spherocytosis has a negative DAT, a positive family history, and abnormal EMA binding, whereas ABO HDN is DAT-positive with mother-infant ABO mismatch.

ddx.dx: Rh hemolytic disease of the newborn
ddx.vs: Rh disease usually shows fewer spherocytes but more nucleated red cells and more severe anemia, with a strongly positive DAT and anti-D.
Normal neonatal blood contains macrocytes and occasional nRBCs but not numerous microspherocytes.

exam.answer_en: Hemolytic disease of the newborn due to ABO incompatibility — numerous microspherocytes with polychromasia and a nucleated RBC
pearls_zh: 考法：新生兒血片指小而深染、無中央淡染區的 spherocytes，問 ABO 還是 Rh HDN，以及確認檢查（母嬰血型、DAT）。
典型組合：母親 O 型、嬰兒 A 或 B 型，母體 IgG anti-A/anti-B 通過胎盤；因抗體天然存在，第一胎即可發生。
ABO HDN 的 DAT 常只弱陽性甚至陰性（新生兒 A/B 抗原表現弱）；spherocytes 比 Rh HDN 明顯，但病程通常較輕、以黃疸為主。
處理重點：監測 bilirubin，以光照治療為主，嚴重者換血，預防 kernicterus。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤診為 hereditary spherocytosis：HS 為 DAT 陰性、有家族史、EMA binding 降低；ABO HDN 則有母嬰 ABO 不合，DAT 通常弱陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中大量無中央淡染區的小紅血球稱為什麼？最可能的母嬰血型組合為何？
quiz.a: Microspherocytes；母親 O 型、嬰兒 A 或 B 型

3448.recognize_zh: 左側中性球細胞質內有一個清楚的吞噬空泡，空泡內與其周圍含有淡紫色帶顆粒的血小板；右側中性球也含空泡與吞入的血小板，符合中性球吞噬血小板（常見於 EDTA 抗凝檢體）。
features: Left neutrophil with a well-defined phagocytic vacuole containing ingested platelet material
Additional platelet-sized granular bodies within the cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus
Right neutrophil with a small vacuole and engulfed platelet
Few free platelets in the background (apparent reduction)
Normochromic red cells with occasional elliptocytes and teardrop-like forms
3448.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with occasional elliptocytes and relatively few free platelets. The neutrophil on the left contains a distinct clear phagocytic vacuole with ingested platelet material, and additional granular platelet-sized bodies are present in its cytoplasm.
