The neutrophil on the right likewise contains a small vacuole with an engulfed platelet. Findings are consistent with leukocyte phagocytosis of platelets, an in vitro phenomenon that can falsely lower the automated platelet count; review in a citrate-anticoagulated sample is recommended.

ddx.vs: Satellite platelets encircle the neutrophil externally without phagocytic vacuoles.
Phagocytosed bacteria appear as uniform dark cocci or rods and are usually accompanied by toxic granulation and Döhle bodies.
Toxic vacuoles are multiple small empty vacuoles without contained granular platelet material.

3384.recognize_zh: 左側的巨大血小板（giant platelet）直徑比周圍紅血球還大，中央有紫色顆粒；右側中性球細胞質下方有小塊淡藍色 Döhle-like 包涵體，巨血小板加上中性球包涵體指向 May-Hegglin anomaly。
features: Giant platelet larger than adjacent red cells, with central purple granulomere and pale blue hyalomere
Segmented neutrophil with a small pale blue cytoplasmic inclusion near the lower nuclear lobes
Neutrophil cytoplasm otherwise lacks toxic granulation or vacuoles
Paucity of normal-sized platelets in the field
Normocytic red cells with central pallor
3384.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a giant platelet exceeding the diameter of neighboring red cells, with a central granular zone and pale periphery. An adjacent segmented neutrophil contains a small pale blue cytoplasmic inclusion without toxic granulation or vacuolization. Normal-sized platelets are sparse in this field and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with an inherited macrothrombocytopenia with Döhle-like inclusions, i.e., MYH9-related disorder (May-Hegglin anomaly).

ddx.vs: Bernard-Soulier giant platelets are not accompanied by neutrophil inclusions and show absent ristocetin-induced aggregation.

ddx.dx: Reactive neutrophilia with toxic Döhle bodies
ddx.vs: Toxic Döhle bodies coexist with toxic granulation and vacuoles, and platelets are normal in size.
Gray platelets are large but pale gray and agranular, whereas this platelet has a visible granular center.
Clumps are aggregates of multiple normal-sized platelets with discernible individual outlines, not a single enlarged platelet.

exam.answer_en: MYH9-related disorder (May-Hegglin anomaly) — giant platelet larger than RBCs with a Döhle-like inclusion in a neutrophil
pearls_zh: 考法：指比紅血球還大的血小板，問 giant platelet 的鑑別（MYH9-RD、Bernard-Soulier、gray platelet syndrome），再回頭找中性球包涵體。
Bernard-Soulier syndrome：GPIb-IX-V 缺乏，ristocetin 凝集缺失且加入正常血漿不能矯正，無中性球包涵體，出血傾向較明顯。
Gray platelet syndrome：α-granule 缺乏（NBEAL2），血小板大而灰白無顆粒，可伴骨髓纖維化。
MYH9-RD 確認：中性球 MYH9 免疫螢光可見異常聚集點，或做 MYH9 基因檢測；血小板功能大致正常。
exam.pitfall_zh: 巨大血小板常被自動計數儀當成紅血球而漏算，造成血小板數假性偏低、被誤判為嚴重 ITP；應人工看抹片，並以中性球包涵體與家族史判斷。

quiz.q: 圖左比紅血球還大的細胞是什麼？合併中性球淡藍包涵體時最可能的診斷為何？
quiz.a: Giant platelet；MYH9-related disorder（May-Hegglin anomaly）

3256.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量細胞質塞滿粗大橘紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球及其前驅細胞（eosinophilic myelocyte），部分顆粒混有深紫色未成熟顆粒，並可見細胞質空泡化細胞，符合嗜酸性球增多（hypereosinophilia）。
features: Numerous eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors with coarse orange-red refractile granules
Immature eosinophilic myelocytes with round nuclei and admixed dark purple (pro-eosinophilic) granules
Several cells with cytoplasmic vacuoles and partial degranulation
Free eosinophil granules scattered in the background from ruptured cells
Occasional small lymphocyte; no obvious blast excess in this field
3256.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marked increase in eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors, including myelocytes with round nuclei and coarse orange-red granules, some admixed with immature dark purple granules. Several cells show cytoplasmic vacuolization and degranulation, and free granules are scattered in the background. Blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with eosinophilia with a left-shifted eosinophil series; distinction between reactive and clonal causes requires clinical evaluation, blast count, and cytogenetic/molecular studies (PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2, BCR::ABL1).

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; FIP1L1::PDGFRA by FISH/RT-PCR, often with increased atypical mast cells and elevated tryptase, establishes the clonal diagnosis.
Inv(16) AML shows increased myeloblasts and monocytes with abnormal eosinophils containing large purple-violet basophilic granules.
CML shows marked granulocytic left shift with basophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes, confirmed by BCR::ABL1.
Mastocytosis has spindled mast cells with metachromatic granules and CD25/CD117-positive aggregates on biopsy with KIT D816V.

3192.recognize_zh: 抹片中大量大型圓形母細胞，胞核圓或略折疊、染色質細緻如花邊，胞質中等量呈灰藍色、幾乎無顆粒，符合單核母細胞（monoblast）與前單核細胞為主的急性單核球性白血病。
features: Large cells, 2-3 times the size of red cells, with moderate N:C ratio
Round to slightly folded or indented nuclei with delicate, lacy fine chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous to faint in most cells
Moderate amount of gray-blue cytoplasm without visible azurophilic granules or Auer rods
Occasional cells with cytoplasmic blebs and irregular borders
Sheets of blasts with few maturing myeloid or erythroid elements
3192.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a predominance of large blasts with moderate amounts of gray-blue, largely agranular cytoplasm. Nuclei are round to gently folded with finely dispersed, lacy chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods are identified, and background maturing granulocytes are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia; confirmation with nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD36) is recommended.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation / without maturation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have scant cytoplasm, higher N:C ratio and more distinct nucleoli, and lack the abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and folded nuclei of monoblasts; they are NSE negative.
AMML shows at least 20% neutrophilic lineage cells including granulated precursors, whereas monocytic cells here make up nearly all of the blasts.
Microgranular APL has bilobed, sliding-plate nuclei, strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA, whereas monoblasts are MPO weak/negative and NSE positive.

ddx.dx: Large cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm and coarser chromatin and lack myelomonocytic markers on flow cytometry.

exam.answer_en: Acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia — sheets of large blasts with lacy chromatin, folded nuclei and gray-blue agranular cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指胞質灰藍、核圓或折疊的大細胞，問 monoblast 或 promonocyte；promonocyte 在 WHO 中算作 blast equivalent。
細胞化學：nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate）陽性，可被 NaF 抑制；MPO 通常弱或陰性。
Flow：CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD36、CD4（dim）、HLA-DR；monoblast 常 CD34−。
臨床：易髓外侵犯，如牙齦增生、皮膚（leukemia cutis）、CNS；高白血球易 leukostasis，且 lysozyme 升高可致腎小管損傷與低血鉀。
遺傳：常見 KMT2A 重組（如 t(9;11)）；需做 cytogenetics 與 NGS 以依 WHO 5th/ICC 分類。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 AML without maturation 的 myeloblast；myeloblast 胞質少、核仁明顯、MPO+，monoblast 胞質多灰藍、NSE+。

quiz.q: 此類母細胞的細胞化學染色特徵為何？（NSE 與 MPO）
quiz.a: NSE 陽性（可被 NaF 抑制），MPO 弱或陰性

3128.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中白血球明顯增多，以大量小至中型、核深染、胞質稀少嗜鹼的淋巴球為主，僅夾雜少數嗜中性球，符合T細胞前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）的淋巴球增多表現。
features: Marked absolute lymphocytosis at low power
Monotonous small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with dark round to slightly irregular nuclei
Scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Few admixed neutrophils; no smudge cells prominent
Nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs cannot be assessed at this magnification
3128.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows marked lymphocytosis composed of monotonous small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with dark nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Only a few neutrophils are admixed, and smudge cells are not prominent. Nuclear contour, nucleoli, and cytoplasmic protrusions are not resolvable at this power. In the clinical and immunophenotypic context, findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (note: T-PLL is a mature T-cell neoplasm, not a precursor lymphoid neoplasm).

ddx.vs: CLL cells have soccer-ball chromatin with frequent smudge cells and are CD5+/CD23+/CD19+ B cells, whereas T-PLL is CD7-bright T cells with TCL1A rearrangement.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei, and are typically CD7-negative and CD26-negative with erythroderma.
ATLL shows polylobated flower cells, CD25-positive, and HTLV-1 serology positive.
T-ALL blasts have fine blastic chromatin and are TdT-positive, unlike the mature TdT-negative T-PLL cells.

3000.recognize_zh: 中央兩顆大型未成熟骨髓細胞，核偏一側、旁邊有明顯淡染的高基氏區（perinuclear hof），細胞質嗜鹼性且幾乎沒有顆粒；另有兩顆較小、染色質細緻的原始樣細胞。標題所指的「purple bodies」在此圖無法明確辨認。
features: Two large immature cells with eccentric round nuclei and a prominent pale paranuclear Golgi zone (hof)
Moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm without visible azurophilic granules
Finely granular chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Two smaller adjacent cells with high N:C ratio and fine chromatin (blast-like/early precursors)
Background of normocytic red cells; no mature neutrophils in the field
3000.describe_en: Smear shows a small cluster of immature myeloid-appearing cells in a background of red cells. Two large cells have eccentric nuclei, fine chromatin, a conspicuous paranuclear hof and basophilic cytoplasm lacking distinct granules, resembling hypogranular promyelocytes; two smaller cells with high N:C ratio and fine chromatin are also present. No mature neutrophils are seen in this field. The specific 'purple bodies' referenced in the title cannot be confidently identified in this image; findings are compatible with early myeloid precursors as seen in congenital neutropenia with maturation arrest, but correlation with the full aspirate is required.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells also show eccentric nuclei and a hof but have clumped clock-face chromatin and deeper blue cytoplasm, whereas these cells have fine chromatin.
APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei with heavy granules or Auer rod bundles, not the round nuclei and agranular cytoplasm seen here.
Myeloblasts have scant cytoplasm without a well-formed Golgi zone; a marrow blast count and flow cytometry are needed to separate a maturation arrest from AML.

2872.recognize_zh: 左側一顆巨大的後骨髓細胞/桿狀核（giant metamyelocyte/band），核呈馬蹄形、染色質開放；旁邊是染色質細緻的大型紅血球系前驅細胞，右上可見核不規則的晚期紅血球母細胞，符合巨母紅血球性變化。
features: Giant metamyelocyte/band with a large horseshoe-shaped nucleus and open chromatin
Megaloblastic erythroid precursors with finely granular, open chromatin
Polychromatic megaloblast with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony
Late erythroblast with irregular/lobulated nucleus (upper right)
Large red cells in background suggesting macrocytosis
2872.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant metamyelocyte/band form with a large horseshoe-shaped nucleus and open chromatin, a hallmark of megaloblastic granulopoiesis. Adjacent erythroid precursors are enlarged with finely dispersed chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, and a late erythroblast shows nuclear irregularity. Red cells in the background appear macrocytic. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia, here related to pyrimethamine-induced folate antagonism.

ddx.vs: MDS favors hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils and small hypolobated megakaryocytes rather than giant metamyelocytes with open chromatin.
Normal bands are about 10–12 µm with condensed chromatin, far smaller than this giant form.
Growth factor effect causes left shift with toxic granulation and Döhle bodies but not giant metamyelocytes or megaloblastic erythroids.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia (pyrimethamine-induced) — giant metamyelocyte/band with horseshoe nucleus plus megaloblastic erythroid precursors
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指那顆巨大馬蹄形核的細胞問「這是什麼」——答 giant metamyelocyte（giant band），megaloblastic granulopoiesis 的標誌，常比紅系變化更易辨認且在治療後持續較久。
Giant metamyelocyte 在骨髓出現，對應周邊血的 hypersegmented neutrophil；兩者皆反映 DNA 合成障礙。
Pyrimethamine 是 DHFR inhibitor，應以 leucovorin（folinic acid）矯正；同機轉亦見於 methotrexate 與高劑量 trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole。
其他造成 megaloblastic 型態的藥物：hydroxyurea、azathioprine、zidovudine、nitrous oxide（B12 失活）等；判讀骨髓時必問用藥史。
Megaloblastic 骨髓常呈高細胞性，易被誤以為 leukemia；檢查 B12、folate、homocysteine/MMA 可避免不必要的處置。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 giant metamyelocyte 誤認為 monocyte 或 dysplastic band：其細胞質有 neutrophilic 顆粒、體積明顯巨大、馬蹄核染色質偏開放；monocyte 細胞質灰色含細空泡、核摺疊不規則。

quiz.q: 圖中體積巨大、馬蹄形開放染色質核、細胞質含 neutrophilic 顆粒的細胞叫什麼？
quiz.a: Giant metamyelocyte（giant band form）

2808.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中成群聚集的一致性小至中型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質極少且無顆粒或 Auer 小體，正常成熟細胞稀少，形態符合 B 淋巴母細胞白血病（B-ALL）。
features: Clusters and sheets of monotonous small to intermediate blasts
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm
Round nuclei with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Few residual maturing granulocytes; scattered smudged cells
2808.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clustered sheets of relatively uniform small to intermediate blasts with scant agranular cytoplasm, round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are absent, and maturing myeloid and erythroid elements are sparse. Scattered crushed nuclei are present. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia, most likely B-lymphoblastic leukemia given the clinical context; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Agranular myeloblasts can mimic lymphoblasts; MPO cytochemistry and flow cytometry for myeloid antigens are needed to separate them.
Morphologically identical; distinguished by cytoplasmic CD3 positivity and absence of B-lineage markers.
Hematogones are admixed with normal hematopoiesis and show a maturation continuum by flow, not a monotonous replacing population.

exam.answer_en: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia, likely B-lymphoblastic — sheets of uniform small-intermediate blasts with very high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, no granules or Auer rods
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍看成片單一型態 blasts 並散在 smudged 細胞，考官問診斷與下一步——答 acute leukemia，favor ALL，送 flow cytometry、cytogenetics/FISH、分子檢查。
兒童 B-ALL 最常見的良好預後異常：high hyperdiploidy 與 t(12;21) ETV6::RUNX1；嬰兒 B-ALL 常 KMT2A 重排、CD10 陰性，預後差。
T-ALL 鑑別：cytoplasmic CD3 為 T lineage 關鍵，常見前縱膈腫塊與高白血球；型態上與 B-ALL 無法區分。
Mixed-phenotype acute leukemia 也可呈 lymphoblast 型態；flow 必須同時看 MPO、cyCD3、CD19 等以排除。
B-lymphoblastic lymphoma 與 leukemia 為同一疾病的兩種表現，臨床上常以骨髓 blasts 約 25% 作為區分慣例。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 smudged/crushed cells 當 CLL 的 smudge cell 而誤判；本片細胞為均一不成熟 blasts、染色質細緻，與 CLL 的成熟小淋巴球粗塊狀染色質不同。

quiz.q: 型態上無法區分 B-ALL 與 T-ALL，flow cytometry 中哪兩個標記分別是 B 與 T lineage 的關鍵？
quiz.a: B：CD19（搭配 cyCD79a/CD22/CD10）；T：cytoplasmic CD3

2744.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中四顆中型淋巴細胞，核質比高、染色質中度凝集，細胞質極少，且每顆細胞邊緣都有一簇細胞質小突起（cytoplasmic blebs），核輪廓略不規則，是 T-PLL 的典型形態。
features: Four intermediate-sized lymphoid cells of similar appearance
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Distinct polar cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions on each cell
Round to slightly irregular nuclear contours with moderately condensed chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous; background red cells unremarkable
2744.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows four monotonous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm forming distinct surface blebs. Nucleoli are not conspicuous in these cells. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; diagnosis requires immunophenotyping and demonstration of TCL1A or MTCP1 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have clumped soccer-ball chromatin, lack cytoplasmic blebs and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei and are CD7-negative, whereas T-PLL cells have round nuclei with blebs and strong CD7.
Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi but are B cells with more abundant cytoplasm and sometimes plasmacytoid features.

exam.answer_en: T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (small-cell pattern) — monotonous intermediate lymphoid cells with scant basophilic cytoplasm and distinct polar surface blebs
pearls_zh: 考法：四顆同型態細胞，考官要你說出「每顆都有極性的細胞質 bleb」並推論 T-PLL；並問核仁不明顯是否排除——不排除，small-cell variant 即如此。
確診需 flow（T lineage、CD7 強、多為 CD4+）加上 TCL1A 或 MTCP1 重排（FISH/karyotype）或 TCL1 IHC 陽性。
與 Sézary cell 鑑別：Sézary 常 CD7−、CD26−，核呈深溝腦回狀，臨床有 erythroderma；T-PLL CD7 強陽性、無典型 cerebriform 深溝。
Alemtuzumab（anti-CD52）為一線治療，需預防與監測 CMV reactivation 及其他伺機感染。
少數病人初期呈 indolent 無症狀期，可觀察；一旦進展，病程通常迅速。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把細胞質 bleb 當作塗片人工假象或 hairy cell 的毛狀突起：hairy cell 細胞質豐富、突起環周且細長、CD103/CD11c/CD25+；T-PLL 細胞質少、突起為鈍圓極性泡狀。

quiz.q: T-PLL 一線誘導治療使用的單株抗體標靶是什麼抗原？
quiz.a: CD52（alemtuzumab）

2680.recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴球細胞質較豐富、淡藍，箭頭處細胞質內有一根細長透明、不著色的針狀結構，靠近核緣；這種負像棒狀物是惡性淋巴球內的結晶包涵體。
features: Medium-to-large lymphoid cell with moderate N:C ratio
Oval nucleus with moderately coarse, clumped chromatin; no distinct nucleolus
Moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm
Slender, colorless needle-like crystal in the cytoplasm near the nuclear border (arrow)
No cytoplasmic granules or vacuoles; digitally enlarged image
2680.describe_en: High-power, digitally enlarged view of a peripheral blood smear shows a lymphoid cell with an oval nucleus, moderately clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm. A thin, unstained, needle-shaped crystalline inclusion is present within the cytoplasm alongside the nucleus (arrow). There are no azurophilic granules, vacuoles or Auer rods. Findings are consistent with a crystalline inclusion in a malignant lymphocyte, a feature of low-grade B-cell lymphoproliferative disorders with abnormal immunoglobulin accumulation; confirmation relies on flow cytometry and, if needed, electron microscopy.

ddx.vs: Auer rods stain pink-red to purple and occur in myeloblasts or promyelocytes with fine chromatin, not as colorless clefts in mature lymphoid cells.
Reactive lymphocytes may have similar cytoplasm but lack crystalline inclusions.
Crystal-storing histiocytes are much larger tissue cells with abundant cytoplasm packed with crystals, not a circulating lymphocyte with a single rod.

2104.recognize_zh: 視野中兩個嗜中性球胞質都含粗大紫色毒性顆粒；右側細胞核左方胞質內有一小塊淡藍色斑（Döhle body），左側細胞核分葉少、較不成熟，整體呈現感染或發炎時的嗜中性球毒性變化。
features: Two neutrophils with coarse purple toxic granulation
Small pale blue cytoplasmic patch adjacent to the nucleus in the right neutrophil (Döhle body)
Left neutrophil hyposegmented/band-like with clumped chromatin (left shift)
Increased cytoplasmic granule density compared with normal neutrophils
Red cells with occasional refractile drying artifact; crenated cell at top
2104.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows two neutrophils with coarse purple toxic granulation. The right neutrophil contains a small pale blue agranular cytoplasmic inclusion consistent with a Döhle body, and the left neutrophil is hyposegmented, suggesting a left shift. Red cells show refractile drying artifact. Findings are consistent with toxic neutrophil changes, typically reflecting infection or inflammation.

ddx.vs: Inclusions are present in most granulocytes without toxic granulation and are associated with giant platelets.
Coarse granules are also seen in lymphocytes and monocytes and persist independent of infection.
Dysplastic hyposegmentation is typically accompanied by hypogranulation, whereas these cells are hypergranular.

exam.answer_en: Toxic neutrophil changes with left shift — coarse toxic granulation, a Döhle body, and a hyposegmented band-like neutrophil
pearls_zh: 考法：同視野兩顆嗜中性球，考官會分別問「右邊的淡藍斑」（Döhle body）與「左邊核分葉少」（band，左移）的意義。
反應性左移常搭配毒性變化；與 leukemoid reaction 區分時看有無 basophilia、myelocyte bulge 與 BCR::ABL1。
毒性顆粒為較粗、深紫的 primary granules；多見於細菌感染、敗血症與 G-CSF 使用後。
嗜中性球 alkaline phosphatase（LAP）在反應性增多時升高、在 CML 降低，是傳統考點。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把核分葉少誤認為 pseudo-Pelger-Huët（發育不良）：發育不良細胞常伴顆粒減少；本圖細胞顆粒增加，屬反應性毒性變化與左移。

quiz.q: 圖中兩顆嗜中性球呈現毒性顆粒、Döhle body 與核分葉少，最可能的臨床情境為何？
quiz.a: 細菌感染/敗血症等發炎反應（反應性左移）

2040.recognize_zh: 一群大型細胞的細胞質充滿粗大紫色顆粒，顆粒甚至蓋在核上；多顆核呈雙葉或摺疊（bilobed），這是顆粒過多型急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）的異常前骨髓細胞。
features: Cluster of large cells with abundant cytoplasm
Dense coarse azurophilic granules overlying and obscuring the nucleus
Nuclei folded, reniform or bilobed in several cells
One cell shows a granular tail-like cytoplasm with a sharply demarcated nuclear lobe
Discrete Auer rod bundles not clearly identified at this resolution
Red cells with drying artifact and a nucleated/dense small cell in the background
2040.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of large abnormal cells with abundant cytoplasm heavily laden with coarse azurophilic granules that obscure the nuclear margins. Nuclei, where discernible, are folded to bilobed. Distinct Auer rod bundles are not resolved in this image. Findings are consistent with abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes of acute promyelocytic leukemia, a hematologic emergency given the risk of DIC.

ddx.dx: Reactive left shift with increased promyelocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are accompanied by myelocytes and mature neutrophils, without clustered granule-obscured bilobed cells.
t(8;21) blasts have fewer granules, a prominent hof and single slender Auer rods rather than cells packed with coarse granules and bilobed nuclei.
NPM1-mutated AML may show cup-like nuclear invaginations but usually sparse granules; separation from APL rests on PML::RARA testing and HLA-DR/CD34 pattern.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular type — cluster of abnormal promyelocytes with dense azurophilic granules and folded/bilobed nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：指著細胞群問診斷與「應立即做哪些檢查？」答：APL；PT、aPTT、fibrinogen、D-dimer 評估 DIC，並送 PML::RARA（FISH 或 RT-PCR）。
凝血：APL 的出血傾向來自 DIC 合併 hyperfibrinolysis，fibrinogen 低為典型；支持療法以輸注 cryoprecipitate/fibrinogen 及血小板維持目標值。
Flow：CD34 陰性、HLA-DR 陰性、CD33 強陽性、MPO 強陽性；這個 HLA-DR/CD34 雙陰性可快速提示 APL，但 NPM1 突變 AML 也可有此表型。
預後分層（Sanz）：以診斷時 WBC >10×10⁹/L 為高風險；高風險者早期出血死亡率高，需更積極處理。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 AML with t(8;21)：後者顆粒較少、有明顯核旁 hof 與單一細長 Auer rod；APL 則顆粒粗大遮核、雙葉核，並可見 faggot cells。

quiz.q: 圖中這群細胞做 flow cytometry，CD34 與 HLA-DR 典型結果為何？
quiz.a: 兩者皆陰性

1912.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的細胞為中小型、圓核、染色質均勻細緻、無明顯核仁，且只有極薄一圈淡藍色細胞質，混在正常成熟中的紅血球與顆粒球系前驅細胞之間，符合造血原細胞（hematogones）。
features: Small to intermediate lymphoid cells with very high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with homogeneous, smooth, finely dispersed chromatin
No conspicuous nucleoli
Scant rim of pale-to-moderately blue cytoplasm without granules
Admixed maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors (polymorphous background)
1912.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a polymorphous population of maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors with scattered small lymphocytes. The arrowed cells are small to intermediate lymphoid cells with round nuclei, homogeneous finely dispersed chromatin, absent nucleoli and a scant rim of blue cytoplasm. There is no monotonous sheet of blasts. Findings are consistent with hematogones (benign B-cell precursors); flow cytometry showing a normal maturation continuum (CD34/CD10/CD20/TdT) confirms this.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts form a monotonous population with aberrant immunophenotype (asynchronous CD10/CD20/CD34, over- or under-expression of CD45/CD58/CD38), whereas hematogones show a smooth normal maturational continuum on flow.
Mature lymphocytes have coarse, clumped chromatin, whereas hematogones have smooth homogeneous chromatin despite similar size.
Myeloblasts are larger with visible nucleoli, more cytoplasm and occasional granules or Auer rods and are MPO/CD13/CD33 positive.

exam.answer_en: Hematogones (benign B-cell precursors) — small cells with homogeneous smooth chromatin, no nucleoli and scant cytoplasm in a polymorphous marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：化療後或骨髓恢復期抹片指著箭頭細胞問「這是殘存 ALL 還是良性？」答：hematogones；確認須靠 flow 顯示正常成熟連續譜。
Flow 關鍵：hematogones 呈 CD34+/TdT+ → CD10+ → CD20+ 的連續成熟序列，CD45、CD38、CD58 表現正常；B-ALL 則為單一族群並有異常抗原表現（如 CD58 過高、CD38 降低）。
常見增多情境：幼兒、化療或幹細胞移植後恢復期、ITP、自體免疫與病毒感染；在兒童骨髓可占相當比例。
MRD 判讀：CD19/CD10/CD34 陽性不等於殘存白血病；需與診斷時的 leukemia-associated immunophenotype 比對，或以分子 MRD 輔助。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 B-lymphoblasts（殘存或復發 ALL）：兩者形態重疊；hematogones 散布於正常三系造血中、染色質更均勻且無核仁，flow 呈正常成熟曲線而非異常單一族群。

quiz.q: 如何以 flow cytometry 區分箭頭所指細胞與復發的 B-ALL？
quiz.a: Hematogones 呈正常成熟連續譜（CD34/TdT→CD10→CD20）且無異常抗原表現；B-ALL 為單一異常族群

1848.recognize_zh: 數顆成熟嗜中性球的核只有兩葉，呈眼鏡狀或花生狀（左下與下方中央的細胞最明顯），染色質粗糙濃縮，細胞質仍保有顆粒，這種雙葉低分葉的成熟顆粒球稱為假性 Pelger-Huët 細胞（pseudo-Pelger-Huët cells）。
features: Mature neutrophils with bilobed (spectacle/pince-nez) nuclei connected by a thin bridge
Coarse, markedly condensed chromatin inappropriate for a band stage
Cytoplasmic granulation retained in the hyposegmented cells
Adjacent granulocytic precursors (promyelocyte/myelocyte with coarse granules, right) and a basophilic early erythroid precursor (bottom)
Aspirate background with erythrocytes and debris
1848.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Several mature neutrophils display hyposegmented, bilobed spectacle-shaped nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin while retaining cytoplasmic granules, consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huët change. A promyelocyte/myelocyte and an early erythroid precursor are also present, and blasts are not increased in this field. In a reactive setting these cells may reflect drug effect (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus, valproate) or infection, but myelodysplastic neoplasm should be excluded clinically and with cytogenetics.

ddx.vs: Nearly all neutrophils are uniformly bilobed or non-lobed with normal granulation, the change is lifelong, and there is no cytopenia or dysplasia in other lineages.
Pseudo-Pelger cells are accompanied by hypogranulation, dysplasia in other lineages, cytopenias and often clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
Bands have a continuous non-segmented horseshoe nucleus with less condensed chromatin rather than two discrete lobes with a thin filament.
Morphology is identical to MDS-related change; resolution after withdrawal of the offending drug supports a reactive cause.

exam.answer_en: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët change — mature neutrophils with bilobed spectacle (pince-nez) nuclei and coarse condensed chromatin in marrow aspirate
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指左下/下方中央的雙葉核中性球，問「這叫什麼？要想到哪些原因？」答 pseudo-Pelger-Huët；後天原因包括 MDS 等骨髓腫瘤、藥物、感染。
藥物相關常考：mycophenolate、tacrolimus、valproate 等；停藥後可恢復，因此判讀前先查用藥史。
與遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly（LBR 突變，體染色體顯性）區分：遺傳型幾乎所有中性球均一低分葉、顆粒正常、無血球低下。
MDS 判定形態異常（dysplasia）需該系 ≥10% 細胞有異常；單一視野見到幾顆不足以診斷，需配合血球低下、母細胞、細胞遺傳學。
染色質明顯濃縮是關鍵：與同樣低分葉但染色質較鬆的 band 或 metamyelocyte 區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 band neutrophil；band 核呈 C/U 形帶狀、染色質較不濃縮，pseudo-Pelger 則是兩個圓葉以細絲相連或不分葉，染色質過度濃縮與成熟度不相稱。

quiz.q: 圖中雙葉眼鏡狀核的成熟中性球稱為什麼？列出兩個需鑑別的後天原因。
quiz.a: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët cell；MDS（或其他骨髓腫瘤）、藥物（如 mycophenolate、tacrolimus）。

1592.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆圓形白血球，核分成4葉並圍繞中央呈花瓣狀排列，染色質濃縮成塊，細胞質淡粉紅佈滿細小顆粒，無中毒顆粒或空泡，為正常分葉核中性球。
features: Round cell roughly twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Nucleus with four lobes arranged peripherally around the center, connected by thin strands
Dense clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Background normochromic red cells and scattered platelets
1592.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil with four nuclear lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments, dense clumped chromatin, and pale pink cytoplasm containing fine neutrophilic granules. Toxic granulation, Döhle bodies and cytoplasmic vacuoles are absent. The surrounding red cells are normochromic and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with a normal segmented neutrophil.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more lobes or a population with >5% five-lobed cells, whereas this cell has four lobes.
Basophils have coarse dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus, unlike the fine pale granules seen here.
Pelger-Huët cells have bilobed spectacle-shaped or non-lobed nuclei with coarse chromatin, not four well-formed lobes.

exam.answer_en: Normal segmented neutrophil — four nuclear lobes linked by thin strands, fine granular pink cytoplasm, no toxic change
pearls_zh: 考法：指這顆細胞問是否正常；需逐項說出 lobe 數、顆粒、有無 toxic granulation/Döhle body/vacuole 再下「正常」結論。
Pelger-Huët anomaly：LBR 基因異常，核多為雙葉（pince-nez）或不分葉但染色質成熟；後天型 pseudo-Pelger-Huët 是 MDS 等骨髓腫瘤的 dysplasia 線索。
Hypersegmentation 定義：≥1 顆 ≥6 葉或 5 葉 >5%；本圖 4 葉屬正常範圍。
中性球顆粒：primary（azurophilic，含 MPO）在成熟期不明顯，所見淡紫細顆粒為 secondary/specific granules。
exam.pitfall_zh: 花瓣狀排列的核容易被誤看成過度分葉或 basophil；數清楚只有 4 葉，且顆粒細小不遮蓋核，即為正常中性球。

quiz.q: 這顆細胞的核有幾葉？是否達 hypersegmentation 標準？
quiz.a: 4 葉；未達（需 ≥6 葉，或 5 葉細胞 >5%）

60280.recognize_zh: 視野中有數顆一端圓鈍、另一端拉成單一尾巴的淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocytes），尾端略鈍且方向不一，不像推片假影；背景為大致正常的紅血球，此例與 B 淋巴母細胞白血病骨髓浸潤相關。
features: Scattered red cells with a rounded body tapering to a single tail (teardrop cells)
Tails are slightly blunted and randomly oriented, supporting true dacrocytes
Background red cells mostly normocytic with mild anisocytosis
Occasional small dense cells without central pallor
No blasts, nucleated red cells or leukocytes in this field
60280.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mild anisopoikilocytosis with scattered teardrop cells, each with a rounded body and a single blunt-ended tail oriented in random directions. The remaining red cells are largely normocytic, with occasional small dense forms. No leukocytes, blasts or nucleated red cells are present in this field. Findings are consistent with dacrocytes; in this patient they reflect extensive marrow replacement by B lymphoblastic leukemia, and a search for circulating blasts and a leukoerythroblastic picture is warranted.

ddx.vs: Artifactual teardrops have very sharp tails all pointing in the same direction, whereas these tails are blunt and randomly oriented.
Myelofibrosis causes identical teardrops, so the cause is established by marrow biopsy showing fibrosis versus replacement by lymphoblasts (TdT, CD19, CD10).
Sickle cells are crescentic and taper at both ends rather than having one rounded end and a single tail.
Schistocytes are fragments with straight cut edges and sharp corners rather than intact cells with a single tail.

exam.answer_en: Dacrocytes (teardrop cells) with randomly oriented blunt tails — reflecting marrow replacement (here by B lymphoblastic leukemia)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指淚滴細胞問名稱與意義，重點是「骨髓被取代或纖維化」，不只 primary myelofibrosis，白血病、轉移癌浸潤也會。
看到 dacrocytes 要回頭找 leukoerythroblastic 血象：nucleated RBC、immature granulocytes 以及 circulating blasts。
B-ALL flow 表型：CD19+、CD22+、cytoplasmic CD79a+、TdT+、CD10 多陽性、CD34 常陽性；MPO 陰性。
成人 B-ALL 必驗 BCR::ABL1（Ph+ ALL），陽性者治療加入 TKI；也要評估 KMT2A 重組等高風險基因異常。
ALL 高白血球時有 tumor lysis syndrome 風險，誘導治療前需水分、allopurinol 或 rasburicase（先確認 G6PD）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與推片假影混淆：假影淚滴的尾巴方向一致、多為尖細；本圖尾端鈍且方向隨機，屬真正 dacrocyte。也勿與 sickle cell（兩端尖）混淆。

quiz.q: 兒童血片出現散在淚滴細胞，除了 myelofibrosis，還必須考慮骨髓被什麼取代？下一步做什麼？
quiz.a: 白血病（如 B-ALL）或腫瘤浸潤；找 circulating blasts 並做骨髓檢查（含 flow）

56.recognize_zh: 周邊血白血球顯著增加，以嗜中性球系為主並有明顯左移（骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核），放大圖可見顆粒粗大與顆粒稀少兩群嗜中性球並存；骨髓切片細胞密度接近 100%、巨核細胞核葉分離，提示伴發育不良的 MDS/MPN（aCML），需排除 BCR::ABL1。
features: Marked leukocytosis composed predominantly of neutrophils and immature granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band forms) without a conspicuous blast population in the field shown
Two neutrophil-lineage morphologies: cells with coarse, dense purple granules and cells with sparse granules and pale cytoplasm (hypogranular forms), suggesting dysgranulopoiesis
Bone marrow biopsy markedly hypercellular (near 100%) with near-total loss of fat between trabeculae
Sheets of granulocytic precursors with left-shifted maturation on high power
Megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes and bilobed granulocytes in the marrow section, supportive of dysplasia
Aspirate smear is thick and overstained, limiting cytologic assessment
56.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis due to neutrophilia with a prominent left shift including myelocytes, metamyelocytes and bands; blasts are not conspicuous in the field shown. At high power there are two distinct neutrophil populations, one with coarse, dense granulation and another that is hypogranular. The bone marrow biopsy is markedly hypercellular (approaching 100%) with sheets of granulocytic precursors showing left-shifted maturation, and a megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclear lobes is present, along with bilobed granulocytes. The aspirate smear is thick and overstained, precluding a reliable differential count. In the absence of BCR::ABL1, these findings of neutrophilic leukocytosis with left shift and granulocytic dysplasia are suggestive of atypical chronic myeloid leukemia (MDS/MPN with neutrophilia).

ddx.vs: CML shows a myelocyte peak with absolute basophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes without true dysgranulopoiesis, and is defined by BCR::ABL1, which was negative here.

CNL has mature, often toxic-granulated neutrophils with immature granulocytes under 10% and no dysplasia, whereas this case has a marked left shift and hypogranular dysplastic neutrophils; CSF3R mutation does not separate them.
CMML requires persistent absolute monocytosis (at least 0.5 x10^9/L and 10% of WBC), which is not evident in this neutrophil-dominant smear.
Reactive neutrophilia shows toxic granulation and Dohle bodies without hypogranular dysplastic neutrophils, dysplastic megakaryocytes, or a clonal karyotype such as the t(7;17) seen here.

captions: PB smear: neutrophilic leukocytosis with left shift; inset shows a coarsely granulated and a hypogranular neutrophil-lineage cell
BM biopsy, low power: markedly hypercellular marrow with loss of fat
BM biopsy, high power: sheets of granulocytic precursors
BM aspirate smear: thick, overstained preparation with limited cytologic detail
BM section, high power: megakaryocyte with separated nuclear lobes and bilobed granulocytes

120.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被背靠背、邊界模糊的腫瘤性濾泡取代；高倍下濾泡內幾乎全是成片的中心母細胞（centroblasts，核大、染色質空泡狀、多個貼近核膜的核仁），看不到中心細胞（centrocytes）混雜，加上濾泡內 BCL2 陽性與 CD21 樹突細胞網，支持濾泡性淋巴瘤 grade 3B。
features: Lymph node effaced by closely packed, back-to-back neoplastic follicles with attenuated mantles and extension into perinodal fat
Follicles composed of solid sheets of large centroblasts (nuclei ~3x a small lymphocyte) without an admixed centrocyte population
Round to oval vesicular nuclei with multiple small nucleoli applied to the nuclear membrane; scant amphophilic cytoplasm
Frequent mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies within the follicles; no tingible-body macrophage-rich starry-sky pattern
IHC: follicles strongly highlighted by membranous B-cell/germinal-center markers and nuclear markers, with cytoplasmic staining consistent with BCL2 in the follicles
Preserved CD21/CD23-type follicular dendritic cell meshworks outlining each nodule, confirming follicular (not diffuse) architecture in the depicted areas
120.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show effacement of the normal architecture by a vaguely nodular proliferation of crowded, back-to-back follicles that extends to the capsule and perinodal adipose tissue. At high power, the follicles are composed of sheets of large centroblasts with vesicular chromatin, multiple peripheral nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, with numerous mitoses and apoptotic bodies; centrocytes are not a significant component in these fields. Immunohistochemical stains highlight the neoplastic follicles with membranous and nuclear germinal-center-type staining, cytoplasmic staining consistent with BCL2 within follicles, a substantial nuclear-positive fraction, and intact follicular dendritic cell meshworks. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, grade 3B (follicular large B-cell lymphoma in WHO 5th edition); diffuse areas, reported elsewhere in this specimen, should be separately reported as diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Grade 3A follicles contain >15 centroblasts/HPF but retain admixed centrocytes, whereas 3B follicles consist of solid sheets of centroblasts as seen here.
DLBCL lacks follicular architecture, so CD21/CD23 staining shows no organized FDC meshworks around the large cells, unlike the intact nodular meshworks in this image.
Reactive follicles are polarized with tingible-body macrophages, preserved mantles and BCL2-negative germinal centers, whereas these crowded follicles are monotonous, unpolarized and BCL2-positive.

ddx.dx: Large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement
ddx.vs: This entity, usually in children or young adults in Waldeyer ring or cervical nodes, shows strong diffuse MUM1/IRF4 with often weak or absent BCL2 and requires IRF4 FISH to separate it from grade 3B FL in an older adult.

exam.answer_en: Follicular lymphoma grade 3B — back-to-back neoplastic follicles composed of solid sheets of centroblasts without centrocytes, BCL2+ with CD21 meshwork
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍指濾泡內成片中心母細胞，問分級；centroblast >15/hpf 為 grade 3，有 centrocyte 混雜為 3A，成片無 centrocyte 為 3B。
WHO 5th 將 3B 改稱 follicular large B-cell lymphoma；ICC 2022 保留 FL grade 3B。兩者都建議臨床上按 DLBCL 處理。
FL 3B 較少 t(14;18)/BCL2 表現與 CD10，較常 MUM1 陽性或 BCL6 重排，生物學較接近 DLBCL。
若有瀰漫區（CD21 網消失）應另外診斷 DLBCL 並註明比例；計數時要排除 FDC 與組織球。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為反應性濾泡增生；反應性生發中心有極性、易染體巨噬細胞、完整套區且 BCL2 陰性，本例濾泡背靠背且 BCL2 陽性。

quiz.q: 濾泡內全為成片中心母細胞而無中心細胞，應分為 FL 哪一級？
quiz.a: Grade 3B（WHO 5th: follicular large B-cell lymphoma）

3704.recognize_zh: 組織中片狀分布的中大型未成熟細胞，核卵圓至不規則、染色質細緻、有小核仁，可見多個分裂象與凋亡小體，並散在亮紅色的嗜酸性（前驅）細胞；這種混有嗜酸性髓系細胞的母細胞片狀浸潤提示骨髓外的髓系肉瘤（AML 復發）。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium to large immature cells effacing tissue architecture
Oval to irregular, sometimes folded nuclei with fine dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Frequent mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies
Scattered cells with bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm (eosinophilic myelocytes/eosinophils)
3704.describe_en: Section shows diffuse sheets of medium to large immature cells with oval to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant to moderate pale cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily identified, and scattered cells with bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm, consistent with eosinophilic myeloid precursors, are admixed. No cohesive nesting or glandular architecture is seen. In a patient with prior acute myeloid leukemia after stem cell transplantation, the findings are consistent with extramedullary relapse (myeloid sarcoma); MPO, lysozyme, CD34, CD117 and CD68 immunostains are required to exclude lymphoma and nonhematopoietic tumors.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are CD20/PAX5-positive and MPO/lysozyme-negative, typically with coarser chromatin and without admixed eosinophilic myelocytes.
PTLD is usually EBER-positive B-cell proliferation with plasmacytoid differentiation rather than MPO-positive myeloid blasts.
BPDCN shows CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCF4+ blasts that are MPO- and lysozyme-negative and often primarily involve skin.
These show cohesive growth and are keratin- or S100/SOX10-positive and CD45-negative.

1208.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（H&E）中造血細胞稀少，間質大片出血與淡粉紅色、無結構的物質，左側有骨小樑；淡染無定形沉積可能是類澱粉（amyloid），但 H&E 無法確定，需 Congo red 染色在偏光下見蘋果綠雙折射才能確診。
features: Hypocellular marrow with scattered crushed or dark small nucleated cells
Extensive interstitial hemorrhage with red cells filling the stroma
Pale pink, amorphous, acellular material in the interstitium (suggestive of but not diagnostic for amyloid)
Numerous empty fat spaces and a bony trabecula at the left
Poor preservation and low magnification limit cytologic assessment of plasma cells
1208.describe_en: Bone marrow section stained with H&E shows a hypocellular, hemorrhagic marrow with fat spaces, an adjacent bony trabecula, and scattered small, poorly preserved nucleated cells. Pale eosinophilic, amorphous, acellular material is present in the interstitium, which may represent amyloid deposition but could also reflect edema or fibrin. Plasma cells cannot be reliably identified at this magnification. A Congo red stain with polarization (apple-green birefringence) and assessment for a clonal plasma cell population by CD138 and kappa/lambda immunostaining are recommended to confirm amyloidosis.

ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation shows pale granular basophilic-to-pink ground substance that is Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative.

ddx.dx: Marrow edema or fibrin in hemorrhage
ddx.vs: Edema and fibrin lack apple-green birefringence on Congo red and do not form waxy perivascular deposits.
LCDD deposits are Congo red negative and show granular deposits by electron microscopy rather than fibrils.
Fibrosis shows fibrillar collagen or reticulin on trichrome or reticulin stain rather than amorphous glassy material.
